title.zh: 卷五十一 志第四 天文四
title.raw: 卷五十一 志第四 天文四 Volume 51 Treatises 4: Astronomy 4

translations.literal: The Twenty-eight Lodges, lower [section].
translations.idiomatic: The Twenty-eight Lodges (continued)

sentences.zh: 奎宿十六星，天之武庫，一曰天豕，一曰封豕，主以兵禁暴，又主溝瀆。

translations.literal: The Kui Lodge has sixteen stars. It is Heaven's Arsenal; one name is the Celestial Boar, another is the Sealed Boar. It governs using arms to restrain violence, and also governs ditches and waterways.
translations.idiomatic: The Kui Lodge comprises sixteen stars. Known as Heaven's Arsenal—and also as the Celestial Boar or the Sealed Boar—it presides over the use of arms to suppress violence and over ditches and waterways alike.

sentences.zh: 西南大星曰天豕目，亦曰大將。

translations.literal: The great star in the southwest is called the Eye of the Celestial Boar; it is also called the Great General.
translations.idiomatic: The bright star in the southwest is termed the Eye of the Celestial Boar, or alternatively the Great General.

translations.literal: If it is bright and moves, then armies and floods issue forth greatly.
translations.idiomatic: When it shines brightly and stirs, great armies rise and floods break out.

sentences.zh: 日食，魯國凶，邊兵起及水旱。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: Lu is ill-omened; border armies rise, and flood and drought occur.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse portends disaster for Lu, the mobilization of frontier troops, and both flood and drought.

translations.literal: A solar halo signifies armies and fire.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the sun foretells war and conflagration.

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: ministers who gather wealth have worry.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse brings anxiety to ministers who amass riches.

sentences.zh: 月暈，兵敗，糴貴，將戮，人疾疫。

translations.literal: A lunar halo: armies are defeated, grain is dear, generals are executed, and the people suffer pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the moon presages military defeat, soaring grain prices, the execution of generals, and widespread pestilence among the people.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, its allotted region is thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, the territory under its jurisdiction falls into turmoil.

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, close ministers become rebellious;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, intimate ministers turn traitorous;

sentences.zh: 守之，蟲爲災，人民饑，盜起，多獄訟；

translations.literal: if it stations there, insects become a calamity, the people hunger, bandits rise, and lawsuits are many;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, insect plagues strike, the people go hungry, banditry spreads, and lawsuits multiply;

translations.literal: if it stations there long, northern armies surrender;
translations.idiomatic: if it remains long, armies of the north submit;

translations.literal: if its color is moist and lustrous, the harvest is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: if its hue is rich and bright, the harvest is bountiful;

sentences.zh: 守二十日以上，兵起魯地；

translations.literal: if it stations there twenty days or more, armies rise in Lu;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for twenty days or longer, war breaks out in Lu;

sentences.zh: 逆行守之，君好兵，民流亡。

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and stations there, the ruler loves warfare and the people flee as refugees.
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde and stations there, the ruler grows fond of war and the people scatter into exile.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，環繞三十日以上，將相凶，大水，民流；

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses it and circles for thirty days or more, generals and chancellors are ill-omened, great floods come, and the people disperse;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon it and circles the lodge for thirty days or more, disaster befalls generals and chancellors alike, great floods inundate the land, and the people flee;

sentences.zh: 守二十日以上，魯地有兵；

translations.literal: if it stations there twenty days or more, there is warfare in Lu;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for twenty days or longer, war erupts in Lu;

translations.literal: if it trembles and advances or retreats, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it wavers and shifts forward or back, an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it lodges there, the year's harvest is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: if it comes to rest there, the year's harvest is plentiful;

translations.literal: if it stays, subordinates monopolize power and lawsuits are many;
translations.idiomatic: if it lingers, subordinates seize power and lawsuits abound;

translations.literal: if it stations there a hundred days or more, bandits are many.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for a hundred days or longer, banditry flourishes.

sentences.zh: 填星入犯，吳、越有兵，一曰齊、魯，一曰兵、喪；

translations.literal: If Saturn enters and transgresses, Wu and Yue have armies; one reading says Qi and Lu; another says armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn enters and encroaches upon it, Wu and Yue see warfare—though some texts read Qi and Lu, and others war and mourning;

translations.literal: if it stations there, a noble woman holds power;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, a woman of rank takes the reins of government;

translations.literal: if it enters and exits, springs and streams overflow.
translations.idiomatic: as it enters and departs, springs and streams burst their banks.

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，大水，有兵，霜殺物；

translations.literal: If Venus transgresses it, great floods come, armies rise, and frost kills growing things;
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon it, great floods strike, armies mobilize, and killing frost destroys the crops;

translations.literal: if it enters, foreign armies enter the state;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, foreign troops invade the realm;

translations.literal: if seen in daytime, generals and chancellors die.
translations.idiomatic: if it appears by day, generals and chancellors perish.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，江河決，有兵，爲旱，爲火。

translations.literal: If Mercury transgresses it, rivers burst their banks, armies rise, and there is drought and fire.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches upon it, rivers break their dikes, armies take the field, and both drought and fire afflict the land.

translations.literal: If it stations there, the king has worry, armies, and drought.
translations.idiomatic: If it stations there, the sovereign is beset with anxiety, war, and drought.

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, there are matters of ditches and waterways;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, works on ditches and waterways are undertaken;

sentences.zh: 守，則王者有憂，軍敗，賊臣在側；

translations.literal: if it stations there, the king has worry, the army is defeated, and treacherous ministers are at his side;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, the sovereign is troubled, the army is routed, and treacherous ministers lurk at his elbow;

translations.literal: if it enters, armies are broken and generals slain;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, armies are shattered and generals cut down;

translations.literal: if it lodges and stays without departing, the people hunger;
translations.idiomatic: if it comes to rest and does not leave, the people go hungry;

translations.literal: if it exits, plotting ministers delude the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: if it departs, scheming ministers lead the Son of Heaven astray.

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses, there is famine, armies, and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, famine strikes, and war and mourning follow;

translations.literal: if it appears, there is a flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, flood disasters ensue.

sentences.zh: 星孛之，其下兵出，民饑，國無繼嗣；

translations.literal: If a broom star assails it, below it armies issue forth, the people hunger, and the state has no heir;
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star strikes it, armies march forth beneath it, the people starve, and the realm lacks a successor;

translations.literal: if it appears, armies rise in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, warfare breaks out in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 流星入犯之，有溝瀆事，破軍殺將。

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters and transgresses it, there are matters of ditches and waterways, and armies are broken and generals slain.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters and encroaches upon it, works on ditches and waterways are launched, and armies are shattered while generals are slain.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：流星出入，色黃白光潤，文昌武偃；

translations.literal: The Yisi Occupations: when a shooting star enters and exits, its color yellow and white light lustrous, civil culture flourishes and arms are laid down;
translations.idiomatic: According to the Yisi Occupations: when a meteor enters and exits with a yellow hue and a bright, lustrous white light, literary culture thrives and arms are stilled;

sentences.zh: 赤如火光作聲，爲弓弩用；

translations.literal: if red like firelight and making sound, it is for the use of bows and crossbows;
translations.idiomatic: if crimson like firelight and sounding as it passes, bows and crossbows are brought into use;

translations.literal: one reading says if it enters, there is a matter of assembling crowds.
translations.idiomatic: another reading holds that its entry portends mass gatherings.

translations.literal: If crimson cloud vapor enters and transgresses, there is warfare;
translations.idiomatic: When crimson cloud vapor enters and encroaches, war follows;

translations.literal: if yellow, the Son of Heaven rejoices;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, the Son of Heaven has cause for joy;

translations.literal: if black, great men have worry.
translations.idiomatic: if black, great men are beset with anxiety.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以奎爲十七度，唐開元遊儀十六度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, Kui was taken as seventeen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary, sixteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Kui Lodge was measured at seventeen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gave it as sixteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極七十六度，景祐測驗同。

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was seventy-six degrees; the Jingyou survey and test were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier measurement placed it seventy-six degrees from the celestial pole; the Jingyou-era survey yielded the same result.

sentences.zh: 天溷七星，在外屏南，主天廁養豬之所，一曰天之廁溷也。

translations.literal: The Celestial Privy has seven stars, south of the Outer Screen. It governs Heaven's privy, the place for raising pigs; it is also called Heaven's latrine.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Privy comprises seven stars lying south of the Outer Screen. It presides over Heaven's privy—the place where pigs are kept—and is also known as Heaven's latrine.

translations.literal: if dim, the people are not at ease;
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the people are unsettled;

translations.literal: if it shifts position, there is worry.
translations.idiomatic: when it shifts from its place, anxiety spreads.

sentences.zh: 土司空一星，在角南，一曰天倉，主土事。

translations.literal: The Earth Director has one star, south of the Horn. It is also called the Celestial Granary and governs earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: The Earth Director is a single star south of the Horn asterism. Also known as the Celestial Granary, it presides over all matters pertaining to earth and soil.

sentences.zh: 凡營城邑、浚溝洫、修堤防、則議其利，建其功，四方小大功課，歲盡則奏其殿最而行賞罰。

translations.literal: Whenever cities and towns are laid out, ditches dredged, and dikes repaired, its benefit is deliberated and its achievement established. The minor and major achievements of the four quarters are assessed; at year's end their rankings are reported and rewards and punishments carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever walled cities are planned, canals dredged, and embankments repaired, its influence weighs the benefit and establishes the merit of the work. The lesser and greater achievements of the four quarters are tallied, and at year's end their rankings are reported so that rewards and punishments may be dispensed.

translations.literal: If the star is large and its color yellow, the realm under Heaven is at peace.
translations.idiomatic: When the star is large and its hue yellow, the realm enjoys tranquility.

sentences.zh: 五星犯之，男女不得耕織。

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, men and women cannot plow and weave.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon it, men and women alike are unable to plow the fields or tend the looms.

sentences.zh: 彗、客犯之，水旱，民流，兵大起，土功興。

translations.literal: If a comet or guest star transgresses it, flood and drought come, the people disperse, armies rise greatly, and earthworks are undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or guest star encroaches upon it, flood and drought afflict the land, the people scatter, war erupts on a grand scale, and great earthworks are launched.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，有土功、哭泣事。

translations.literal: If a guest star stations there, there are earthworks and matters of weeping.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star holds position there, major earthworks are undertaken and mourning fills the land.

sentences.zh: 黃雲氣入，土功興，移京邑。

translations.literal: If yellow cloud vapor enters, earthworks are undertaken and the capital is moved.
translations.idiomatic: When yellow cloud vapor enters the lodge, great earthworks begin and the capital is relocated.

sentences.zh: 策一星，在王良北，天子僕也，主執策御。

translations.literal: The Reins has one star, north of Wangliang. It is the Son of Heaven's groom and governs holding the reins and driving.
translations.idiomatic: The Reins is a single star north of Wangliang. It represents the Son of Heaven's groom and presides over holding the reins and managing the chariot.

sentences.zh: 流星、彗、孛、客星犯之，皆爲大兵起，天子自將于野；

translations.literal: If a shooting star, comet, broom star, or guest star transgresses it, great armies always rise and the Son of Heaven himself leads troops in the field;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor, comet, broom star, or guest star encroaches upon it, great armies invariably rise and the Son of Heaven himself takes command in the field;

translations.literal: if it draws near, below there are plotters of disorder.
translations.idiomatic: if it draws near, conspirators foment rebellion below.

sentences.zh: 附路一星附一作傅，在閣道南旁，別道也。

translations.literal: The Attached Road has one star—the name 'Attached' is also written 'Coached'—beside the south of the Palace Road; it is a separate path.
translations.idiomatic: The Attached Road is a single star—called Attached Road, though one text gives the name as Coached Road—lying south of the Palace Road; it marks a separate thoroughfare.

sentences.zh: 一曰在王良東，主太僕，主御風雨。

translations.literal: One reading places it east of Wangliang; it governs the Grandee of the Household and governs managing wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: One account places it east of Wangliang; it presides over the Grandee of the Household and over the management of wind and rain.

translations.literal: if it has rays and horns, chariots and horsemen are in the wild;
translations.idiomatic: when it shows rays and horns, chariots and cavalry fill the countryside;

translations.literal: if the star perishes, there is a change in the roads;
translations.idiomatic: when the star vanishes, the road network is disrupted;

translations.literal: if not complete, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: when it is incomplete, war breaks out.

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars enter, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars enter the lodge, war erupts.

translations.literal: If a comet or broom star transgresses it, the roads are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or broom star encroaches upon it, the roads become impassable.

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, horses are cheap.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters, horses fall in price.

translations.literal: If pale cloud vapor enters, the Grandee of the Household has worry;
translations.idiomatic: When pale cloud vapor enters, the Grandee of the Household is beset with anxiety;

translations.literal: if crimson, the Grandee of the Household is executed;
translations.idiomatic: if crimson, the Grandee of the Household is put to death;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the Grandee of the Household receives gifts;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, the Grandee of the Household receives imperial favor;

translations.literal: if black, the Grandee of the Household dies.
translations.idiomatic: if black, the Grandee of the Household meets his death.

sentences.zh: 閣道六星，在王良前，飛道也，從紫宮至河神所乘也。

translations.literal: The Palace Road has six stars, before Wangliang. It is a flying path, from the Purple Palace to where the River God rides.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Road comprises six stars before Wangliang. It is a celestial flyway stretching from the Purple Palace to the chariot of the River God.

sentences.zh: 一曰主輦閣之道，天子游別宮之道也。

translations.literal: One reading says it governs the path of the palanquin pavilion; it is the path by which the Son of Heaven visits his separate palaces.
translations.idiomatic: One account holds that it governs the route of the palanquin pavilion—the path by which the Son of Heaven travels to his detached palaces.

translations.literal: if the stars are not seen, the palanquin pavilion is impassable;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are not visible, the palanquin route is blocked;

translations.literal: if they tremble, there are armies in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: when they tremble, armed conflict erupts within the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛、客星犯之，主不安國，有喪。

translations.literal: If a comet, broom star, or guest star transgresses them, the ruler is not secure in the state and there is mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet, broom star, or guest star encroaches upon them, the ruler's hold on the realm is shaken and mourning follows.

translations.literal: If white cloud vapor enters, there is an urgent matter;
translations.idiomatic: When white cloud vapor enters, urgent affairs arise;

translations.literal: if black, the ruler has illness;
translations.idiomatic: if black, the ruler falls ill;

translations.literal: if yellow, the Son of Heaven has joy.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, the Son of Heaven has cause for celebration.

sentences.zh: 王良五星，在奎北，居河中，天子奉車御官也。

translations.literal: Wangliang has five stars, north of Kui, dwelling in the midst of the river. It is the Son of Heaven's officer who attends the chariot and drives.
translations.idiomatic: Wangliang comprises five stars north of Kui, situated amid the river. It represents the Son of Heaven's officer in charge of the imperial chariot and its drivers.

sentences.zh: 其四星曰天駟，旁一星曰王良，亦曰天馬星，動則車騎滿野。

translations.literal: Its four stars are called the Celestial Team of Four; the star at the side is called Wangliang, also called the Celestial Horse Star. If it moves, chariots and horsemen fill the wild.
translations.idiomatic: Four of its stars form the Celestial Team of Four; the star beside them is Wangliang, also known as the Celestial Horse Star. When it stirs, chariots and horsemen cover the countryside.

sentences.zh: 一曰爲天橋，主御風雨、水道。

translations.literal: One reading says it is the Celestial Bridge and governs managing wind, rain, and waterways.
translations.idiomatic: One account identifies it as the Celestial Bridge, presiding over wind, rain, and waterways.

sentences.zh: 星不具，或客星守之，津梁不通。

translations.literal: If the stars are not complete, or a guest star stations there, ferries and bridges are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars are incomplete, or a guest star holds position there, ferries and bridges cease to function.

translations.literal: If near the Palace Road, there are changes in rivers.
translations.idiomatic: When it lies close to the Palace Road, rivers undergo sudden change.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, horses are cheap;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine brightly, horses become cheap;

translations.literal: if dim, there is a horse calamity.
translations.idiomatic: when dim, horses suffer calamity.

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars enter and station there, there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars enter and hold position there, war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 彗、客犯之，爲兵、喪，天下橋樑不通。

translations.literal: If a comet or guest star transgresses it, there is warfare and mourning, and bridges throughout the realm are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or guest star encroaches upon it, war and mourning follow, and bridges throughout the realm become impassable.

translations.literal: If a shooting star transgresses, great armies are about to issue forth.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor encroaches upon it, great armies are about to march.

sentences.zh: 青雲氣入犯之，王良奉車憂墜車。

translations.literal: If azure cloud vapor enters and transgresses it, Wangliang, who attends the chariot, worries about falling from the chariot.
translations.idiomatic: When azure cloud vapor enters and encroaches upon it, the Wangliang officer who tends the chariot fears a fall from the vehicle.

translations.literal: If the cloud vapor is crimson, Wangliang has worry of axe and executioner's block.
translations.idiomatic: When the cloud vapor turns crimson, the Wangliang officer faces the threat of axe and block.

sentences.zh: 外屏七星，在奎南，主障蔽臭穢。

translations.literal: The Outer Screen has seven stars, south of Kui. It governs screening off foul and filthy things.
translations.idiomatic: The Outer Screen comprises seven stars south of Kui. It presides over screening off foul and noxious matter.

sentences.zh: 軍南門，在天大將軍南，天大將軍之南門也。

translations.literal: The Army's South Gate is south of the Celestial Great General; it is the south gate of the Celestial Great General.
translations.idiomatic: The Army's South Gate lies south of the Celestial Great General—it is the southern gate of that asterism.

translations.literal: It governs challenging and questioning those who enter and exit.
translations.idiomatic: It presides over challenging and inspecting those who pass in and out.

translations.literal: if the stars are not bright, foreign states rebel;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are dim, foreign states rebel;

translations.literal: if they tremble, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when they tremble, war breaks out;

translations.literal: if bright, distant regions come to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: when bright, distant lands send tribute.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，以上諸星俱屬奎宿。

translations.literal: According to the Song of Pacing the Heavens, all the above stars belong to the Kui Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Song of Pacing the Heavens, all the stars described above belong to the Kui Lodge.

sentences.zh: 以《晉志》考之，王良、附路、閣道、軍南門、策星，俱在天市垣，別無外屏、天溷、土司空等星，《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: Examining by the Jin Treatise, Wangliang, Attached Road, Palace Road, Army's South Gate, and the Reins star all belong to the Celestial Market Enclosure; separately there were no Outer Screen, Celestial Privy, Earth Director, and such stars—the Sui Treatise has them.
translations.idiomatic: When checked against the Jin Treatise, Wangliang, the Attached Road, the Palace Road, the Army's South Gate, and the Reins star all belonged to the Celestial Market Enclosure, and asterisms such as the Outer Screen, Celestial Privy, and Earth Director did not yet appear—the Sui Treatise is the first to record them.

sentences.zh: 而武密以王良、外屏、天溷皆屬於壁，或以外屏又屬奎。

translations.literal: But Wumu held that Wangliang, the Outer Screen, and the Celestial Privy all belonged to the Wall Lodge; some also assigned the Outer Screen to the Kui Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Wumu, however, placed Wangliang, the Outer Screen, and the Celestial Privy all within the Wall Lodge, though some authorities also assigned the Outer Screen to the Kui Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以王良西一星屬壁，東四星屬奎，外屏西一星屬壁，東六星屬奎，與《步天歌》各有不合。

translations.literal: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 assigned Wangliang's western star to the Wall Lodge and its eastern four stars to the Kui Lodge; the Outer Screen's western star to the Wall Lodge and its eastern six stars to the Kui Lodge—each differing from the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》, one star west of Wangliang belonged to the Wall Lodge and four to the east to Kui; one star west of the Outer Screen to Wall and six to the east to Kui—arrangements that diverge in each case from the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 婁三星，爲天獄，主苑牧犧牲，供給郊祀，亦爲興兵聚衆。

translations.literal: The Lou Lodge has three stars. It is Heaven's Prison; it governs parks, herds, and sacrificial victims, supplying suburban sacrifices, and also raising armies and gathering multitudes.
translations.idiomatic: The Lou Lodge comprises three stars known as Heaven's Prison. It presides over parklands, livestock, and victims for suburban rites, and also over mustering troops and assembling the people.

translations.literal: If bright and large, levies and collections are timely.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright and large, taxation and collection proceed on schedule.

translations.literal: if the stars stand straight, there is one who holds the sovereign's command;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars stand upright, someone holds the ruler's mandate;

translations.literal: if they draw together, the state is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: When they cluster close together, the realm falls into unrest.

sentences.zh: 日食于婁，宰相、大人當之，郊祀神不享。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse at the Lou Lodge: the chancellor and great men bear the omen; the deities of suburban sacrifice do not accept offerings.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in the Lou Lodge portends disaster for the chancellor and eminent officials, and the gods of suburban sacrifice will not receive the offerings.

translations.literal: A solar halo: there are armies; many great men die.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the sun foretells war and the death of many eminent men.

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: in its allotted region queens and consorts have worry; the people suffer famine.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse brings anxiety to queens and consorts in the lodge's jurisdiction and famine among the people.

sentences.zh: 月暈，在春百八十日有赦，又爲糴貴，三日內雨解之。

translations.literal: A lunar halo: in spring there is an amnesty within one hundred eighty days; it also means grain is dear to buy; rain within three days dispels it.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the moon in spring presages an amnesty within one hundred eighty days, but also soaring grain prices—rain within three days will lift the omen.

sentences.zh: 月犯，多畋獵，其分憂，將死，民流。

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, there is much hunting; its allotted region has worry; generals die; the people disperse.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, hunting increases, the lodge's territory is troubled, generals perish, and the people scatter.

translations.literal: One reading says: many wrongful imprisonments.
translations.idiomatic: Another interpretation holds that wrongful imprisonments multiply.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，牛多死，米賤，有赦；

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, many cattle die, rice is cheap, and there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, cattle die in great numbers, rice grows cheap, and an amnesty is proclaimed;

sentences.zh: 守之，國安，一曰：民多疫，六畜貴，有兵自罷。

translations.literal: if it stations there, the state is secure; one reading says: the people suffer much pestilence, the six livestock are dear, and armies cease of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the realm enjoys security—or, by another account, pestilence spreads among the people, livestock prices soar, and wars end on their own.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯守，爲旱，爲火，穀貴；

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses and stations there, there is drought, fire, and grain is dear;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars both encroaches upon and stations in the Lou Lodge, drought and fire follow and grain grows costly;

sentences.zh: 又曰：守二十日以上，大臣死。

translations.literal: Another reading says: if it stations twenty days or more, great ministers die.
translations.idiomatic: Another account adds that if Mars remains twenty days or longer, high ministers die.

translations.literal: if the star moves, many people die;
translations.idiomatic: When the star stirs, deaths among the people multiply;

sentences.zh: 若逆行入成勾巳者，國廩災。

translations.literal: if it retrogrades and enters the chenggou-si formation, disaster strikes the state granaries.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde into the chenggou-si hook configuration, the state granaries suffer calamity.

sentences.zh: 填星犯之，天子戒邊境，不可遠行，將兵凶；

translations.literal: If Saturn transgresses it, the Son of Heaven warns the border regions; he must not travel far; leading troops is inauspicious;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches upon it, the Son of Heaven is warned to secure the frontiers, refrain from distant journeys, and avoid taking the field at the head of armies;

translations.literal: if it stations there, grain is abundant and the people rejoice;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, harvests are plentiful and the people are content;

translations.literal: if it retrogrades, palace women who gain access at court go abroad;
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde, meddling women of the inner quarters come to the fore;

translations.literal: If it lingers and lodges at the Lou Lodge, foreign armies come.
translations.idiomatic: If it tarries within the Lou Lodge, armies from abroad arrive.

translations.literal: If Venus transgresses it, there are matters of gathering multitudes;
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon it, the people are mustered for collective action;

sentences.zh: 守之，期三十日有兵，民饑。

translations.literal: if it stations there, within a set term of thirty days there are armies and the people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, war breaks out within thirty days and the people go hungry.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，刑罰急，多水旱，大臣憂，王者以赦除之；

translations.literal: If Mercury transgresses it, punishments are urgent; flood and drought are many; great ministers worry; the king removes it by amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches upon it, punishments grow harsh, floods and droughts multiply, and ministers are anxious until the ruler issues an amnesty to lift the omen;

sentences.zh: 守而芒角、動搖、色赤黑者，臣下起兵。

translations.literal: If it stations there with rays, trembling, and a red-black color, subordinates raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: If it stations there showing rays, trembling, and a red-black hue, subordinates take up arms.

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, great armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, major warfare erupts;

sentences.zh: 守之，五穀不成，又曰：臣惑主，專政，歲多獄訟；

translations.literal: if it stations there, the five grains do not ripen; another reading says: ministers confuse the ruler, monopolize government, and lawsuits are many that year;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the five grains fail to mature—or, by another reading, ministers bewilder the ruler, seize power, and lawsuits abound throughout the year;

translations.literal: If it circles for three days, there is a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: If it circles the lodge for three days, a general amnesty is proclaimed.

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses it, the people starve and die;
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, the people perish in famine;

sentences.zh: 出，則先旱後水，穀大貴，六畜疾，倉庫空，又曰國有大兵。

translations.literal: When it emerges, first drought then flood; grain is greatly dear; the six livestock sicken; granaries and storehouses are empty; another reading says the state has great armies.
translations.idiomatic: As it departs, drought gives way to flood, grain prices soar, livestock fall ill, and storehouses stand empty—or, by another account, the realm mobilizes for great war.

translations.literal: A broom star: in its allotted region there are armies and famine.
translations.idiomatic: A broom star in this lodge's jurisdiction portends war and famine.

sentences.zh: 流星出犯之，有法令清獄。

translations.literal: If a shooting star emerges and transgresses it, laws are promulgated and prisons cleared.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor appears and encroaches upon it, new statutes are issued and the prisons are purged.

translations.literal: If azure and crimson cloud vapor enters, there are armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: When azure and crimson cloud vapor enters the lodge, war and mourning follow;

translations.literal: if black, there is great flood.
translations.idiomatic: If the vapor is black, great floods ensue.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以婁爲十二度，唐開元遊儀十三度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Lou Lodge was taken as twelve degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary, thirteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Lou Lodge measured twelve degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gave thirteen.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was eighty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier measurements placed it eighty degrees from the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，婁宿十二度，距中央大星去極八十度，在赤道內十一度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and test: the Lou Lodge twelve degrees; from the central great star, distance from the pole eighty degrees; within the equator eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey found the Lou Lodge at twelve degrees, its central bright star eighty degrees from the pole and eleven degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 天倉六星，在婁宿南，倉谷所藏也，待邦之用。

translations.literal: The Celestial Granary has six stars, south of the Lou Lodge. It is where stored grain is kept, awaiting the state's use.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Granary comprises six stars south of the Lou Lodge, holding the grain reserves upon which the state depends.

translations.literal: if the stars are near and numerous, the year is ripe and millet gathers;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars lie close and thick, the harvest ripens and grain accumulates;

translations.literal: if far and sparse, the opposite.
translations.idiomatic: When they are distant and sparse, the omen is reversed.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, the ruler issues grain.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, the ruler releases grain from the stores.

sentences.zh: 五星犯，兵起，歲饑，倉粟出。

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, armies rise, the year is famine, and granary grain is issued.
translations.idiomatic: When any of the five planets encroaches upon it, war breaks out, famine stalks the year, and grain is drawn from the granaries.

sentences.zh: 熒惑、太白合守，軍破將死。

translations.literal: If Mars and Venus together station there, the army is broken and the general dies.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars and Venus jointly station there, armies are shattered and generals perish.

translations.literal: If Mars enters, the army transports grain a thousand li;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars enters the asterism, armies convoy grain a thousand li;

translations.literal: if it approaches, the realm suffers drought.
translations.idiomatic: If it draws near, drought afflicts the realm.

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，外國人相食，兵起西北。

translations.literal: If Venus transgresses it, foreign peoples devour one another and armies rise in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon it, foreigners turn on one another and armies mobilize in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 辰星守之，大水、客、彗犯之，五穀不成。

translations.literal: If Mercury stations there, great flood; if a guest star or comet transgresses it, the five grains do not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury stationing there brings great floods; a guest star or comet encroaching upon it means the five grains fail to mature.

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, the year is famine and grain is dear to buy.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters, famine grips the year and grain prices soar.

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters, and the color is crimson, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters showing crimson, war follows;

translations.literal: if it transgresses it, grain is issued by armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it encroaches upon the asterism, grain is dispatched under arms;

translations.literal: if the color is yellow-white, the year is greatly ripe.
translations.idiomatic: If its hue is yellow-white, the year brings an abundant harvest.

translations.literal: If pale azure cloud vapor enters, the year is famine;
translations.idiomatic: When pale azure cloud vapor enters, famine stalks the year;

translations.literal: if crimson, there are armies and drought, and disaster at the granaries;
translations.idiomatic: If crimson, war and drought follow, and the storehouses suffer calamity;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the year is greatly ripe.
translations.idiomatic: If yellow-white, the year ripens to abundance.

sentences.zh: 右更五星，在婁西，秦爵名，主牧師官，亦主禮義。

translations.literal: The Right Elder has five stars, west of the Lou Lodge. It is a Qin noble rank name; it governs the herdsman official and also rites and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Elder comprises five stars west of the Lou Lodge. Named for a Qin noble rank, it presides over the herdsman officer and over ritual propriety.

translations.literal: If the stars are not complete, roads throughout the realm are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: When the asterism is incomplete, travel and communication across the realm are cut off.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑犯守，山澤兵起。

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars transgress and station there, armies rise in mountains and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars encroach upon and station in the Right Elder, warfare erupts in the hills and marshes.

sentences.zh: 左更五星，在婁東，亦秦爵名，山虞之官，主山澤林藪竹木蔬菜之屬，亦主仁智。

translations.literal: The Left Elder has five stars, east of the Lou Lodge. It is also a Qin noble rank name—the mountain warden's office; it governs mountains, marshes, thickets, bamboo, wood, vegetables, and such, and also benevolence and wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Elder comprises five stars east of the Lou Lodge. Also a Qin noble title for the mountain warden, it presides over forests, marshes, bamboo, timber, garden produce, and the virtues of benevolence and wisdom.

translations.literal: Portents are the same as for the Right Elder.
translations.idiomatic: Its omens match those of the Right Elder.

sentences.zh: 天大將軍十一星，在婁北，主武兵。

translations.literal: The Celestial Great General has eleven stars, north of the Lou Lodge. It governs martial armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Great General comprises eleven stars north of the Lou Lodge and presides over military forces.

translations.literal: The central great star is Heaven's great general;
translations.idiomatic: Its central bright star is Heaven's supreme commander;

translations.literal: the outer small stars are officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: the surrounding lesser stars are his officers and troops.

translations.literal: if they tremble, armies rise and the great general goes forth;
translations.idiomatic: When they tremble, war breaks out and the commander takes the field;

sentences.zh: 小星動搖，或不具，亦爲兵；

translations.literal: if the small stars tremble or are not complete, it also means armies;
translations.idiomatic: If the lesser stars quiver or the formation is incomplete, armies likewise mobilize;

translations.literal: if the banner stands straight and is raised, victory follows wherever it strikes.
translations.idiomatic: When the banner flies upright, the force prevails wherever it strikes.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress and station there, the great general has worry.
translations.idiomatic: When any of the five planets encroaches upon and stations in the asterism, the commander faces grave anxiety.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，大將不安，軍吏以饑敗。

translations.literal: If a guest star stations there, the great general is unsettled and army officers are defeated by famine.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star stations there, the commander grows uneasy and his officers are ruined by hunger.

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters, the great general has worry.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters the asterism, the commander is troubled.

translations.literal: If pale azure cloud vapor transgresses it, armies suffer much disease;
translations.idiomatic: When pale azure cloud vapor encroaches upon it, troops are ravaged by disease;

translations.literal: if crimson, armies go forth.
translations.idiomatic: If crimson, armies take the field.

sentences.zh: 天庾四星，在天倉東南，主露積。

translations.literal: The Celestial Open Granary has four stars, southeast of the Celestial Granary. It governs open-air stacking.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Open Granary comprises four stars southeast of the Celestial Granary and presides over grain stored in the open air.

translations.literal: Portents are the same as for the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Its omens match those of the Celestial Granary.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》，天倉、天庾在二十八宿之外，天大將軍屬天市垣，左更、右更惟《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: According to the Jin Treatise, the Celestial Granary and Celestial Open Granary lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges; the Celestial Great General belongs to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the Left Elder and Right Elder appear only in the Sui Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jin Treatise》 places the Celestial Granary and Celestial Open Granary beyond the Twenty-eight Lodges, assigns the Celestial Great General to the Celestial Market Enclosure, and records the Left and Right Elders only in the 《Sui Treatise》.

translations.literal: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 assigned the Celestial Granary to the Kui Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 places the Celestial Granary within the Kui Lodge.

translations.literal: Wumu also assigned it to the Kui Lodge, and also to the Lou Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Wumu likewise assigned it to Kui, and again to Lou.

translations.literal: The 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 assigns them all to the Lou Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 places them all within the Lou Lodge.

sentences.zh: 胃宿三星，天之廚藏，主倉廩，五穀府也。

translations.literal: The Stomach Lodge has three stars. It is Heaven's kitchen storehouse; it governs granaries—the treasury of the five grains.
translations.idiomatic: The Stomach Lodge comprises three stars forming Heaven's kitchen storehouse. It presides over the state granaries—the treasury of the five grains.

sentences.zh: 明，則天下和平，倉廩實，民安；

translations.literal: if bright, the realm is peaceful, granaries are full, and the people are secure;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the realm enjoys peace, the granaries are stocked, and the people rest secure;

translations.literal: if they move, there is transport and conveyance.
translations.idiomatic: When they stir, grain is transported across the land.

translations.literal: if dim, the granaries are empty;
translations.idiomatic: When dim, the storehouses stand empty;

translations.literal: if they draw together, grain is dear and the people disperse;
translations.idiomatic: When they cluster close, grain prices rise and the people scatter;

translations.literal: if the central stars are numerous, grain gathers;
translations.idiomatic: When the central stars are thick, grain accumulates;

translations.literal: if the stars are small, grain scatters;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars appear small, grain is dispersed;

translations.literal: if they show rays, there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: When they flare with rays, war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 日食，大臣誅，一曰乏食，其分多疾，穀不實，又曰有委輸事。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: great ministers are executed; one reading says food is lacking; in its allotted region there is much disease and grain does not fill the ear; another reading says there are matters of forwarding supplies.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse portends the execution of high ministers—or, by one reading, scarcity of food, widespread disease in the lodge's territory, and grain that fails to fill the ear—or, by another, the dispatch of tribute and supplies.

translations.literal: A solar halo: grain does not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the sun means the grain will not mature.

sentences.zh: 月食，王后有憂，將亡，亦爲饑，郊祀有咎。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: the queen has worry; generals perish; there is also famine; suburban sacrifices bear blame.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse brings anxiety to the queen, the death of generals, famine, and fault upon the suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 月暈，兵先動者敗，妊婦多死，又曰國主死，大多雨，或山崩，有破軍。

translations.literal: A lunar halo: the side that moves armies first is defeated; many pregnant women die; another reading says the ruler of the state dies; there is much rain, or landslides, and a broken army.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the moon means the side that strikes first will be defeated, pregnant women die in great numbers—and, by another account, the ruler perishes, heavy rains fall, hills collapse, and armies are shattered.

sentences.zh: 歲星在暈內，天子有德令。

translations.literal: If Jupiter is within the halo, the Son of Heaven has a virtuous decree.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter stands within the halo, the Son of Heaven issues benevolent edicts.

translations.literal: A lunar halo in the four first months of the seasons: there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo in the first month of each season presages an amnesty.

translations.literal: If Mars is within the halo, there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars stands within the halo, war follows.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，鄰國有暴兵，天下饑，外國憂，穀不實，民多疾；

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, neighboring states have violent armies; the realm suffers famine; foreign states worry; grain does not fill the ear; the people suffer much disease;
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, neighboring states erupt in violence, famine spreads across the realm, foreign powers are anxious, grain fails to ripen, and disease ravages the people;

translations.literal: if it changes color, generals are inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon changes color, generals meet with disaster.

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, great men worry and armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, eminent men are troubled and armies mobilize;

translations.literal: if it stations there, the state flourishes;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the realm prospers;

sentences.zh: 入，則國令變更，天下獄空；

translations.literal: if it enters, state commands change and prisons throughout the realm are empty;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, imperial orders are revised and prisons stand empty across the land;

sentences.zh: 若逆行，五穀不成，國無積蓄。

translations.literal: If it retrogrades, the five grains do not ripen and the state has no stores.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde, the five grains fail to mature and the state exhausts its reserves.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，兵亂，倉粟出，貴人憂；

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses it, armies are in disorder, granary grain is issued, and eminent persons worry;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon it, armies fall into chaos, grain is released from the stores, and the nobility are anxious;

sentences.zh: 守之，旱饑，民疫，客軍大敗；

translations.literal: if it stations there, drought and famine, pestilence among the people, and guest armies are greatly defeated;
translations.idiomatic: If it stations there, drought and famine follow, pestilence spreads among the people, and invading armies suffer crushing defeat;

translations.literal: if it enters, laws and commands are changed and prisons are empty;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, statutes are revised and the prisons stand empty;

sentences.zh: 進退環繞勾巳、淩犯及百日以上，天下倉庫並空，兵起。

translations.literal: if it advances and retreats, encircles Gou-si, encroaches and transgresses for a hundred days or more, storehouses throughout the realm are all empty and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If it advances and retreats, loops the Gou-si hook, and encroaches upon the lodge for a hundred days or longer, granaries across the land are drained bare and war breaks out.

translations.literal: If Saturn transgresses it, great ministers make rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches upon it, high ministers rise in revolt;

sentences.zh: 守之，無蓄積，有德令，歲穀大貴；

translations.literal: if it stations there, there are no stores, there is a virtuous decree, and the year's grain is very dear;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, reserves run out, benevolent edicts are issued, and grain prices soar;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and stations at Gou-si, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde and holds at the Gou-si hook, armies take the field;

translations.literal: if its color is red, armies rise and blood is shed;
translations.idiomatic: when it turns red, war erupts and blood is spilled;

translations.literal: if green, there is a virtuous decree.
translations.idiomatic: when green, the court issues benevolent edicts.

translations.literal: If Mercury transgresses it, its allotted region is not at peace;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches upon it, the territory under its jurisdiction is unsettled;

sentences.zh: 守之，有兵，國有立侯，巫咸曰：「爲旱，穀不成，有急兵。」

translations.literal: if it stations there, there are armies and the state enfeoffs lords; Wu Xian says: "There is drought, grain does not ripen, and there are pressing armies."
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, armies mobilize and new feudal lords are installed; Wu Xian says, "Drought follows, the grain fails to mature, and urgent warfare breaks out."

translations.literal: Again, if it moves retrograde and stations there, the granaries are empty and there is a flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: If it again moves retrograde and holds position there, the storehouses stand empty and floods afflict the land.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，王者憂，倉廩用；

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, the king has worry and the granaries are used;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, the sovereign is troubled and the state granaries are drawn down;

translations.literal: if it retreats and enters, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it retreats and enters the lodge, an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it stations there, powerful ministers bully the state and grain does not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, overmighty ministers dominate the realm and the crops fail to mature;

translations.literal: if it passes over it, there is fire;
translations.idiomatic: if it crosses the lodge, fire breaks out;

translations.literal: if it lodges and does not depart, the people hunger;
translations.idiomatic: if it comes to rest and does not leave, the people go hungry;

translations.literal: if it departs, the lord of its allotted region has worry.
translations.idiomatic: when it departs, the ruler of the territory under its jurisdiction is beset with anxiety.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，兵動，臣叛，有水災，穀不登。

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses it, armies move, ministers rebel, there is a flood disaster, and grain does not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, armies stir, ministers rebel, floods strike, and the harvest fails.

sentences.zh: 星孛，其分兵起，王者惡之。

translations.literal: If a broom star appears, armies rise in its allotted region and the king detests it.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star appears, war erupts in its territory and the sovereign regards it with dread.

translations.literal: If a meteor transgresses it, granaries and storehouses are empty;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor encroaches upon it, the storehouses stand empty;

translations.literal: if its color is red, there is a fire disaster.
translations.idiomatic: when it shines red, conflagration follows.

sentences.zh: 蒼白雲氣出入犯之，以喪糴粟事；

translations.literal: If pale azure cloud vapor enters and departs and transgresses it, there are matters of mourning and buying grain;
translations.idiomatic: When pale azure vapors enter, depart, and encroach upon it, mourning and grain purchases preoccupy the realm;

translations.literal: if black, granary grain spoils and rots;
translations.idiomatic: when black, grain in the storehouses spoils and rots;

translations.literal: if blue-black, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: when blue-black, war breaks out;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the granaries are full.
translations.idiomatic: when yellow-white, the granaries are well stocked.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，胃宿十五度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Stomach Lodge is fifteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Stomach Lodge measured fifteen degrees.

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and test: fourteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey gave it as fourteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 天囷十三星，如乙形，在胃南，倉廩之屬，主給御廩粢盛。

translations.literal: The Celestial Round Granary has thirteen stars, shaped like the character yi, south of the Stomach Lodge. It belongs to the granary category and governs supplying the imperial granary with sacrificial grain offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Round Granary comprises thirteen stars arranged in the form of the character yi, south of the Stomach Lodge. Of the class of storehouse asterisms, it presides over provisioning the imperial granary with sacrificial grain.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, the harvest is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright, harvests are plentiful;

translations.literal: if dim, there is famine.
translations.idiomatic: when dim, famine follows.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, there are matters of moving grain.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, grain is transported across the realm.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, granaries and storehouses are empty.
translations.idiomatic: When any of the five planets encroaches upon it, the storehouses stand empty.

sentences.zh: 客、彗入，倉庫憂，水火焚溺。

translations.literal: If a guest star or comet enters, granaries and storehouses are troubled, and fire and water bring burning and drowning.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star or comet enters, the storehouses are imperiled and fire and flood bring ruin.

sentences.zh: 青白雲氣入，歲饑，民流亡。

translations.literal: If pale azure cloud vapor enters, the year is famine and the people disperse in exile.
translations.idiomatic: When pale azure vapors enter, famine strikes and the people flee their homes.

sentences.zh: 大陵八星，在胃北，亦曰積京，主大喪也。

translations.literal: The Great Tumulus has eight stars, north of the Stomach Lodge. It is also called the Accumulated Capital and governs great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Tumulus comprises eight stars north of the Stomach Lodge. Also known as the Accumulated Capital, it presides over great funerals and widespread mourning.

sentences.zh: 中星繁，諸侯喪，民疫，兵起。

translations.literal: If the central stars are numerous, feudal lords mourn, the people suffer pestilence, and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When the central stars are thickly clustered, feudal lords go into mourning, pestilence ravages the people, and war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，爲兵，爲水、旱，天下有喪。

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, there is warfare, flood and drought, and mourning throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, war follows, flood and drought afflict the land, and mourning spreads across the realm.

translations.literal: A lunar halo on its forward foot: a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When a halo forms on the forward foot of the moon's ring, a great amnesty is proclaimed.

translations.literal: If the five planets enter, there are flood, drought, armies, and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets enter, flood, drought, war, and mourning follow.

translations.literal: If Mars stations there, there is mourning throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars stations there, mourning spreads across the realm.

translations.literal: If a guest star or comet enters, the people suffer pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star or comet enters, pestilence strikes the people.

sentences.zh: 流星出犯之，其下有積屍。

translations.literal: If a meteor emerges and transgresses it, below there are heaped corpses.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor appears and encroaches upon it, corpses pile up beneath.

sentences.zh: 蒼白雲氣犯之，天下兵、喪；

translations.literal: If pale azure cloud vapor transgresses it, throughout the realm there are armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: When pale azure vapors encroach upon it, war and mourning spread across the land;

translations.literal: if red, many people die in battle.
translations.idiomatic: when red, the slain in battle are beyond count.

translations.literal: The Accumulated Corpses is one star, within the Great Tumulus.
translations.idiomatic: The Accumulated Corpses is a single star set within the Great Tumulus.

translations.literal: If bright, there is great mourning and the dead are piled like hills.
translations.idiomatic: When bright, great mourning follows and the dead lie heaped like hills.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, there are rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, treacherous ministers arise.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, there is great pestilence throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon it, a great plague sweeps the realm.

translations.literal: If a guest star or comet transgresses it, there is great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star or comet encroaches upon it, great mourning follows.

sentences.zh: 蒼色雲氣入犯之，人多死；

translations.literal: If azure cloud vapor enters and transgresses it, many people die;
translations.idiomatic: When azure vapors enter and encroach upon it, deaths multiply among the people;

translations.literal: if black, there is pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: when black, pestilence spreads.

sentences.zh: 天船九星，在大陵北，河之中，天之船也，主通濟利涉。

translations.literal: The Celestial Boat has nine stars, north of the Great Tumulus, in the midst of the River. It is Heaven's boat and governs passage across fords and profitable crossing.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Boat comprises nine stars north of the Great Tumulus, in the midst of the celestial River. Heaven's own vessel, it presides over open crossings and safe passage over water.

sentences.zh: 石申曰：「不在漢中，津河不通。」

translations.literal: Shi Shen says: "If it is not in Hanzhong, the fords and rivers are impassable."
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shen says, "When it is not in Hanzhong, the fords and rivers cannot be crossed."

translations.literal: If bright, the realm is secure;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the realm enjoys peace;

translations.literal: if not bright and if it shifts position, throughout the realm there are armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: when dim or when it shifts from its place, war and mourning spread across the land.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，百川流溢，津梁不通。

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, the hundred streams overflow and fords and bridges are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, rivers everywhere burst their banks and bridges and fords are cut off.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, water overflows and the people move away to settle elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon it, floods rise and the people abandon their homes.

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses it, there is a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, great floods follow.

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, there is flood and there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, flood and war alike follow.

sentences.zh: 青雲氣入，天子憂，不可御船；

translations.literal: If azure cloud vapor enters, the Son of Heaven has worry and boats cannot be manned;
translations.idiomatic: When azure vapors enter, the Son of Heaven is troubled and it is unwise to take ship;

translations.literal: if red, there are armies and boats are put to use;
translations.idiomatic: when red, war breaks out and the fleet is mobilized;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven rejoices.
translations.idiomatic: when yellow-white, the Son of Heaven is gladdened.

sentences.zh: 天廩四星，在昴宿南，一曰天ＢＷ，主蓄黍稷，以供享祀。

translations.literal: The Celestial Granary has four stars, south of the Hairy Head Lodge. One name is the Celestial Millet. It governs storing millet and sorghum to supply sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Granary comprises four stars south of the Hairy Head Lodge. Also called the Celestial Millet, it presides over storing millet and panicled millet for the sacrificial rites.

translations.literal: What the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 calls the imperial granary is the image of this.
translations.idiomatic: This is the celestial counterpart of the imperial granary mentioned in the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》.

translations.literal: It also governs rewarding merit and holds the essentials of the nine grains.
translations.idiomatic: It also presides over rewarding merit and holds authority over the staples of the nine grains.

translations.literal: if bright, the state is full and the year is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, the state is well provisioned and the harvest is rich;

translations.literal: if it shifts, the state is depleted;
translations.idiomatic: when it shifts from its place, the state's reserves run low;

translations.literal: if black and sparse, millet spoils.
translations.idiomatic: when black and thinly scattered, the grain rots in store.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses it, grain is dear.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, grain prices rise.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, the year is famine.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon it, famine strikes that year.

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, granaries and storehouses are empty.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, the storehouses stand empty.

translations.literal: If a meteor enters, when its color is green there is worry;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters, a green hue brings anxiety;

translations.literal: if red, there is drought and fire;
translations.idiomatic: when red, drought and fire follow;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, throughout the realm the crop ripens.
translations.idiomatic: when yellow-white, the harvest ripens across the land.

translations.literal: If azure cloud vapor enters, there are locusts, famine, and the people disperse;
translations.idiomatic: When azure vapors enter, locusts swarm, famine spreads, and the people flee;

translations.literal: if red, there is drought;
translations.idiomatic: when red, drought follows;

translations.literal: if black, there is flood;
translations.idiomatic: when black, floods rise;

translations.literal: if yellow, the year is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: when yellow, the year brings a full harvest.

sentences.zh: 積水一星，在天船中，候水災也。

translations.literal: The Accumulated Water is one star, within the Celestial Boat, observing flood disasters.
translations.idiomatic: The Accumulated Water is a single star within the Celestial Boat, marking the approach of flood calamity.

translations.literal: If bright and moving upward, boats and ships are put to use.
translations.idiomatic: When bright and stirring upward, the fleet is brought into service.

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses it, there is flood.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon it, floods follow.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》大陵、積屍、天船、積水俱屬天市垣，天囷、天廩在二十八宿之外。

translations.literal: According to the 《Jin Treatise》, the Great Tumulus, Accumulated Corpses, Celestial Boat, and Accumulated Water all belong to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the Celestial Round Granary and Celestial Granary lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jin Treatise》 assigns the Great Tumulus, Accumulated Corpses, Celestial Boat, and Accumulated Water to the Celestial Market Enclosure, while placing the Celestial Round Granary and Celestial Granary beyond the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 武密以天囷、大陵屬婁，又屬胃；

translations.literal: Wumu assigned the Celestial Round Granary and Great Tumulus to the Lou Lodge, and also to the Stomach Lodge;
translations.idiomatic: Wumu placed the Celestial Round Granary and Great Tumulus within the Lou Lodge, and again within the Stomach Lodge;

translations.literal: the Celestial Boat he assigned to the Stomach Lodge, and also to the Hairy Head Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: he assigned the Celestial Boat to the Stomach Lodge, and again to the Hairy Head Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》，天囷五星屬婁，餘星屬胃，大陵西三星屬婁，東五星屬胃，與《步天歌》互有不同。

translations.literal: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 assigns five stars of the Celestial Round Granary to the Lou Lodge and the remaining stars to the Stomach Lodge; the three western stars of the Great Tumulus to the Lou Lodge and the five eastern stars to the Stomach Lodge—differing in turn from the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 places five stars of the Celestial Round Granary in the Lou Lodge and the rest in the Stomach Lodge, assigns the three western stars of the Great Tumulus to Lou and the five eastern stars to Stomach—each scheme at odds with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 昴宿七星，天之耳目也，主西方及獄事。

translations.literal: The Hairy Head Lodge has seven stars. It is Heaven's eyes and ears and governs the west and prison affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Hairy Head Lodge comprises seven stars—Heaven's eyes and ears. It presides over the west and over all matters of justice and imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 又爲旄頭，北星也，又主喪。

translations.literal: It is also the yak-tail banner, a northern star, and also governs mourning.
translations.idiomatic: It is also the yak-tail banner asterism, a constellation of the north, and further presides over mourning.

sentences.zh: 昴、畢間爲天街，天子出，旄頭、{罒幹}畢以前驅，此其義也。

translations.literal: Between the Hairy Head and Net Lodges is the Celestial Street. When the Son of Heaven goes forth, the yak-tail banner and Han-Net lead ahead as vanguard—this is the meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The gap between the Hairy Head and Net Lodges forms the Celestial Street. When the Son of Heaven rides forth, the yak-tail banner and the Han-Net outriders lead the way—such is the omen's meaning.

translations.literal: The yellow path passes through it.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic passes through this lodge.

translations.literal: if bright, prisons throughout the realm are settled;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, prisons across the land are at peace;

sentences.zh: 六星皆明與大星等，爲大水。

translations.literal: if all six stars are bright and equal to the great star, there is a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: when all six stars shine as brightly as the chief star, great floods follow.

translations.literal: If all seven stars are yellow, armies rise on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: When all seven stars turn yellow, war erupts on a vast scale.

translations.literal: If one star perishes, there are armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a single star vanishes, war and mourning follow.

sentences.zh: 搖動，有大臣下獄及有白衣之會。

translations.literal: If they tremble and move, great ministers are cast into prison and there is an assembly in white.
translations.idiomatic: When they tremble and stir, high ministers are thrown into prison and mourners gather in white.

sentences.zh: 大而數盡動，若跳躍者，北兵大起。

translations.literal: If large and all moving in number, as if leaping, northern armies rise on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: When they swell bright and all leap and quiver as one, armies of the north mobilize on a grand scale.

sentences.zh: 一星獨跳躍而動，北兵欲犯邊。

translations.literal: If one star alone leaps and moves, northern armies intend to encroach on the borders.
translations.idiomatic: When a single star leaps and stirs by itself, northern forces are about to raid the frontier.

sentences.zh: 日食，王者疾，宗姓自立，又占邊兵起。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: the king is ill, lineage clans establish themselves independently, and it is also read as border armies rising.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse portends illness for the sovereign, the rise of rival branches of the imperial clan, and—by another reading—the mobilization of frontier troops.

sentences.zh: 日暈，陰國失地，北主憂，趙地凶，又云大饑。

translations.literal: A solar halo: the yin state loses territory, the northern lord has worry, the Zhao region is ill-omened; another reading says great famine.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the sun means a rival power loses ground, the ruler of the north is troubled, and the Zhao region meets with disaster—or, by another account, great famine.

sentences.zh: 月食，大臣誅，女主憂，爲饑，邊兵起，將死，北地叛。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: great ministers are executed, the chief consort has worry, there is famine, border armies rise, generals die, and the northern lands rebel.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends the execution of high ministers, anxiety for the empress, famine, the mobilization of frontier armies, the death of generals, and rebellion in the northern marches.

translations.literal: If the moon halos three times in a year, crossbows are dear and the people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon is ringed three times in a single year, crossbows grow costly and the people go hungry.

translations.literal: if the halo is in the first ten days of the first month, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: when the halo appears in the first ten days of the first month, an amnesty is proclaimed;

sentences.zh: 犯之，爲饑，北主憂，天子破北兵；

translations.literal: if it encroaches upon it, there is famine, the northern lord has worry, and the Son of Heaven defeats the northern armies;
translations.idiomatic: when it encroaches upon the lodge, famine follows, the ruler of the north is troubled, and the Son of Heaven breaks the northern forces;

sentences.zh: 變色，民流，國亡，下有暴兵，有赦；

translations.literal: if it changes color, the people disperse, the state perishes, below there are violent armies, and there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if its color shifts, the people flee, the realm falls, violent armies rise below, and an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it emerges north of the Hairy Head, there is fortune throughout the realm;
translations.idiomatic: when it emerges north of the Hairy Head Lodge, good fortune spreads across the land;

sentences.zh: 乘之，法令峻，大水，穀不登。

translations.literal: if it passes over it, laws and commands are harsh, great floods come, and grain does not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: when it crosses the lodge, statutes grow severe, great floods strike, and the crops fail to mature.

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, prisons are empty;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, the prisons stand empty;

translations.literal: if it passes over it, the yin state has armies and the northern lord has worry;
translations.idiomatic: if it crosses the lodge, a rival power mobilizes and the ruler of the north is troubled;

sentences.zh: 守之，主急刑罰，獄空，一曰臣下獄有解者；

translations.literal: if it stations there, the ruler is urgent in punishments, prisons are empty; one reading says subordinates in prison are released;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, the ruler presses punishments harshly and the prisons empty—or, by another reading, imprisoned ministers are set free;

sentences.zh: 守其北，有德令，又曰水物不成；

translations.literal: if it stations to its north, there are edicts of virtue; another reading says aquatic things do not mature;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds to the north of the lodge, benevolent edicts are issued—or, by another reading, aquatic produce fails to mature;

translations.literal: if it stations long, great ministers are punished by law and the people hunger;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for long, high ministers are condemned under the law and the people go hungry;

translations.literal: if it lingers in station, armies are broken and generals slain.
translations.idiomatic: if it lingers in station, armies are shattered and generals are slain.

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses and stations, there is warfare, drought, and famine;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches and holds position, war follows, with drought and famine;

translations.literal: if it stations to the east, the Qi, Chu, and Yue regions have armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds to the east, armies mobilize in Qi, Chu, and Yue;

translations.literal: if it stations to the south, Jing and Chu have armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds to the south, Jing and Chu see warfare;

translations.literal: to the west, armies rise in Qin and Zheng;
translations.idiomatic: to the west, armies rise in Qin and Zheng;

sentences.zh: 北，則兵起燕、趙，又爲貴人多死，北地不寧；

translations.literal: to the north, armies rise in Yan and Zhao; it is also read as many nobles dying and the northern lands unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: to the north, armies rise in Yan and Zhao—or, by another reading, many of the nobility perish and the northern marches know no peace;

sentences.zh: 入則有喜，有赦，天下無兵；

translations.literal: if it enters, there is joy, an amnesty, and no armies throughout the realm;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, rejoicing follows, an amnesty is proclaimed, and the realm knows no war;

translations.literal: if it stations and encircles Gou-si, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position and loops the Gou-si hook, an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it stations long, grain bought at market is dear.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for long, grain prices soar.

sentences.zh: 填星犯，或出入守之，北地爲亂，有土功，五穀不成，水火爲災，民疫，又爲女主失勢；

translations.literal: If Saturn transgresses, or enters, exits, or stations there, the northern lands are in disorder, there are earthworks, the five grains do not mature, water and fire become disasters, the people suffer pestilence; it is also read as the chief consort losing power;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches, or enters, exits, or holds position there, the northern marches fall into turmoil, great earthworks are launched, the five grains fail, flood and fire afflict the land, and pestilence spreads among the people—or, by another reading, the empress loses her hold on power;

translations.literal: if it enters, the earth quakes and waters overflow, and the ancestral temples are ruined;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, the earth trembles, waters breach their banks, and the ancestral temples are wrecked;

translations.literal: if it lingers, the great general sets out on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: if it lingers there, the commander-in-chief takes the field.

translations.literal: If Venus enters and transgresses it, there is a great amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: When Venus enters and encroaches upon it, a great amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if to the east, the six domestic animals are harmed;
translations.idiomatic: if it stands to the east, livestock suffer harm;

translations.literal: if to the west, in the sixth month there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it stands to the west, armies mobilize in the sixth month;

sentences.zh: 又曰守之，北兵動，將下獄；

translations.literal: another reading says if it stations there, northern armies move and generals are cast into prison;
translations.idiomatic: by another reading, if it holds position there, northern forces stir and generals are thrown into prison;

translations.literal: if seen in daytime, border armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it appears by day, frontier armies mobilize;

sentences.zh: 出、入、留、舍，在南爲男喪，北爲女喪。

translations.literal: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, to the south means mourning for men, to the north mourning for women.
translations.idiomatic: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or comes to rest, its presence to the south portends men's mourning and to the north women's mourning.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯，北主憂，守之，穀不成，民饑；

translations.literal: If Mercury transgresses, the northern lord has worry; if it stations there, grain does not mature and the people hunger;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches upon it, the ruler of the north is troubled; if it holds position there, the crops fail and the people go hungry;

translations.literal: if it stations long, there is flood and there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for long, floods and warfare follow.

sentences.zh: 客星犯，貴人有急，北兵大敗，讒人在內；

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses, nobles are in peril, northern armies suffer great defeat, and slanderers are within;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, the nobility face crisis, northern armies are routed, and slanderers work within the court;

translations.literal: if it stations there, ministers rebel against the ruler and armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, ministers turn against their lord and war breaks out;

translations.literal: if it enters, its allotted region has mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, the territory under its jurisdiction meets with mourning.

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses it, great ministers make disorder;
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, high ministers rise in rebellion;

translations.literal: if it exits, border armies rise and there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: if it departs, frontier armies mobilize and an amnesty is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 星孛，其分臣下亂，有邊兵，大臣誅。

translations.literal: If a broom star appears, its allotted region's subordinates are in disorder, there are border armies, and great ministers are executed.
