translations.idiomatic: When a broom star appears, the territory under its jurisdiction falls into turmoil among the ministers, frontier armies stir, and high ministers are put to death.

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters, exits, and transgresses it, barbarian armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters, exits, and encroaches upon it, barbarian armies mobilize.

translations.literal: The 《Yisi Occupations》: "If a shooting star enters, the north comes to court;
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Yisi Occupations》: "When a meteor enters, the northern peoples come to pay court;

translations.literal: if it exits, the Son of Heaven has an amnesty edict to comfort the people."
translations.idiomatic: when it exits, the Son of Heaven issues an amnesty edict to relieve the people."

translations.literal: If azure and crimson cloud vapor transgresses it, the people suffer pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: When azure and crimson cloud vapor encroaches upon it, pestilence spreads among the people;

translations.literal: if black, the northern lord has worry;
translations.idiomatic: if the vapor is black, the ruler of the north is troubled;

translations.literal: if azure, there is flood and there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: if azure, floods and warfare follow;

translations.literal: if azure-white, many people have mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if azure-white, mourning multiplies among the people;

translations.literal: if yellow, there is rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, rejoicing follows.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，昴宿十二度，唐開元游儀十一度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Hairy Head Lodge was twelve degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary, eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Hairy Head Lodge measured twelve degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gave eleven.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was seventy-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier measurement placed it seventy-four degrees from the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，昴宿十一度，距西南星去極七十一度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and test: the Hairy Head Lodge eleven degrees; from the southwestern star, distance from the pole seventy-one degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey found the Hairy Head Lodge at eleven degrees, its southwestern star seventy-one degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 芻稾六星，在天苑西，一曰在天囷南，主積稿之屬。

translations.literal: The Forage Stars are six stars, west of the Celestial Park; one reading says south of the Celestial Round Granary. They govern the category of stacked forage.
translations.idiomatic: The Forage Stars comprise six stars west of the Celestial Park—or, by another reading, south of the Celestial Round Granary. They preside over stored hay and fodder.

translations.literal: One name is the Celestial Accumulation—the Son of Heaven's storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Accumulation, they represent the Son of Heaven's treasury storehouses.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, forage is dear;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright, fodder grows costly;

translations.literal: if the stars flourish, the stores of the hundred treasuries remain;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars blaze forth, the reserves of the hundred storehouses endure;

translations.literal: if there are no stars, the stores of the hundred treasuries are dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars vanish, the reserves of the hundred storehouses are scattered.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses them, wealth and treasures are expended.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon them, wealth and treasure are drawn forth.

sentences.zh: 辰星、熒惑犯之，芻稾有焚溺之患。

translations.literal: If Mercury and Mars transgress them, forage suffers the calamity of burning and drowning.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury and Mars encroach upon them, fodder faces the calamity of fire and flood.

translations.literal: If crimson cloud vapor transgresses them, there is fire;
translations.idiomatic: When crimson cloud vapor encroaches upon them, fire breaks out;

translations.literal: if yellow, there is rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, rejoicing follows.

sentences.zh: 天陰五星，主從天子弋獵之臣。

translations.literal: The Celestial Yin has five stars. It governs the ministers who attend the Son of Heaven in archery and hunting.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Yin comprises five stars and presides over the ministers who accompany the Son of Heaven on the hunt.

translations.literal: if not bright, it is auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: if bright, speech is forbidden from leaking.
translations.idiomatic: when bright, the court tightens its guard against leaked speech.

sentences.zh: 天河一星一作天阿，在天廩星北。

translations.literal: The Celestial River is one star—also written Celestial Ah—north of the Celestial Granary star.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial River is a single star—also written Celestial Ah—lying north of the Celestial Granary star.

sentences.zh: 《晉志》在天高星西，主察山林妖變。

translations.literal: The Jin Treatise places it west of the Celestial Height star. It governs inspecting strange transformations in mountains and forests.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jin Treatise》 places it west of the Celestial Height star, charged with detecting uncanny transformations in mountains and forests.

sentences.zh: 五星、客、彗犯之，主妖言滿路。

translations.literal: If the five planets, a guest star, or a comet transgress it, it governs demonic speech filling the roads.
translations.idiomatic: When any of the five planets, a guest star, or a comet encroaches upon it, wild rumors flood the highways.

sentences.zh: 捲舌六星，在昴北，主樞機智謀，一曰主口舌語，以知讒佞。

translations.literal: The Curled Tongue has six stars, north of the Hairy Head. It governs pivot mechanisms and stratagems; one reading says it governs mouth and tongue speech, to know flattery and slander.
translations.idiomatic: The Curled Tongue comprises six stars north of the Hairy Head Lodge. It presides over the pivots of counsel and stratagem—or, by another reading, over speech itself, revealing flattery and slander.

translations.literal: if curved and still, worthy men are promoted;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars curl and lie still, worthy men rise to office;

sentences.zh: 直而動，多讒人，兵起，天下有口舌之害。

translations.literal: if straight and moving, there are many slanderers, armies rise, and throughout the realm there is harm of mouth and tongue.
translations.idiomatic: when they stand straight and stir, slanderers multiply, armies mobilize, and the land is poisoned by calumny.

sentences.zh: 徙出漢外，則天下多妄說。

translations.literal: If they shift outside the Han River, throughout the realm there are many false sayings.
translations.idiomatic: if they shift beyond the Milky Way, falsehoods spread across the realm.

translations.literal: if the stars are numerous, many people die.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars multiply in number, death claims many.

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses them, throughout the realm there is much mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon them, mourning spreads across the land.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress them, flatterers are at the ruler's side.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon them, sycophants crowd the ruler's side.

translations.literal: If a comet or guest star transgresses them, attendant ministers have worry.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or guest star encroaches upon them, the sovereign's attendants are beset with anxiety.

sentences.zh: 天苑十六星，在昴、畢南，如環狀，天子養禽獸之苑。

translations.literal: The Celestial Park has sixteen stars, south of the Hairy Head and Net Lodges, ring-shaped. It is the park where the Son of Heaven raises birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Park comprises sixteen stars south of the Hairy Head and Net Lodges, arranged in a ring—the royal preserve where the Son of Heaven keeps birds and beasts.

translations.literal: if bright, birds, beasts, cattle, and horses are full;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, game animals, cattle, and horses abound;

translations.literal: if not bright, many die emaciated;
translations.idiomatic: when dim, many perish wasted and thin;

translations.literal: if not complete, there are matters of cutting down and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: when incomplete, slaughter and harvest fill the land.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon it, war breaks out.

translations.literal: If a guest star or comet transgresses it, there is warfare and many beasts die.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star or comet encroaches upon it, war follows and beasts die in great numbers.

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters and its color is black, birds and beasts die in great numbers;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters with a black hue, birds and beasts perish in multitudes;

translations.literal: if yellow, they multiply and thrive.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, they breed and flourish.

translations.literal: The Cloud-Vapor Occupations is the same.
translations.idiomatic: The omens match those given in the 《Cloud-Vapor Occupations》.

sentences.zh: 天讒一星，在捲舌中，主巫醫。

translations.literal: The Celestial Slander is one star, within the Curled Tongue. It governs shamans and physicians.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Slander is a single star set within the Curled Tongue and presides over shamans and physicians.

translations.literal: if dim, it is auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: if bright and flourishing, the ruler accepts flatterers' words.
translations.idiomatic: when bright and blazing, the ruler heeds the words of sycophants.

sentences.zh: 月一星，在昴宿東南，蟾蜍也，主日月之應，女主臣下之象，又主死喪之事。

translations.literal: The Moon is one star, southeast of the Hairy Head Lodge. It is a toad and governs responses of sun and moon, the image of the chief consort and subordinates, and also governs death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon is a single star southeast of the Hairy Head Lodge—the celestial toad. It presides over the responses of sun and moon, embodies the empress and her ministers, and further governs death and mourning.

translations.literal: if bright and great, the chief consort is greatly dominant.
translations.idiomatic: when bright and swollen, the empress holds power without restraint.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守之，臣下起兵爲亂。

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars station there, subordinates raise armies and make disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars hold position there, ministers raise armies in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 彗、客犯之，大臣黜，女主憂。

translations.literal: If a comet or guest star transgresses it, great ministers are dismissed and the chief consort has worry.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet or guest star encroaches upon it, high ministers are dismissed and the empress is troubled.

sentences.zh: 礪石四星，在五車星西，主百工磨礪鋒刃，亦主候伺。

translations.literal: The Whetstone has four stars, west of the Five Chariots stars. It governs the hundred crafts grinding and sharpening blades, and also governs watch and reconnaissance.
translations.idiomatic: The Whetstone comprises four stars west of the Five Chariots. It presides over artisans who grind and hone blades, and also over watch and reconnaissance.

translations.literal: if bright, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, armies mobilize;

translations.literal: if normal, it is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: when steady and unchanged, the omen is auspicious.

translations.literal: If Mars enters, border armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars enters, frontier armies mobilize;

translations.literal: if it stations there, feudal lords dispatch armies.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, the feudal lords take the field.

translations.literal: If a guest star stations there, there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star holds position there, war follows.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》，天河、捲舌、天讒俱屬天市垣，天苑在二十八宿之外，芻稾、天陰、月、礪石，《晉志》不載，《隋史》有之。

translations.literal: According to the Jin Treatise, the Celestial River, Curled Tongue, and Celestial Slander all belong to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the Celestial Park lies outside the Twenty-eight Lodges. The Forage Stars, Celestial Yin, Moon, and Whetstone are not recorded in the Jin Treatise; the Sui History has them.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jin Treatise》 assigns the Celestial River, Curled Tongue, and Celestial Slander to the Celestial Market Enclosure and places the Celestial Park beyond the Twenty-eight Lodges. The Forage Stars, Celestial Yin, Moon, and Whetstone do not appear in the 《Jin Treatise》; the 《Sui History》 is the first to record them.

sentences.zh: 武密又以芻稾屬胃，捲舌屬胃，又屬昴。

translations.literal: Wumu also assigned the Forage Stars to the Stomach Lodge, and the Curled Tongue to the Stomach Lodge and also to the Hairy Head Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Wumu likewise placed the Forage Stars within the Stomach Lodge, and assigned the Curled Tongue to Stomach and again to the Hairy Head Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以芻稾屬婁，捲舌西三星屬胃，東三星屬昴，天苑西八星屬胃，南八星屬昴。

translations.literal: The New Writings on the Celestial Appearances assigned the Forage Stars to the Lou Lodge; the Curled Tongue's three western stars to the Stomach Lodge and three eastern stars to the Hairy Head Lodge; the Celestial Park's eight western stars to the Stomach Lodge and eight southern stars to the Hairy Head Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 places the Forage Stars in the Lou Lodge, assigns the three western stars of the Curled Tongue to Stomach and the three eastern stars to the Hairy Head Lodge, and places the eight western stars of the Celestial Park in Stomach and the eight southern stars in the Hairy Head Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《步天歌》以上諸星皆屬昴宿，互有不合。

translations.literal: The Song of Pacing the Heavens assigns all the above stars to the Hairy Head Lodge, with mutual discrepancies.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 places all the stars described above within the Hairy Head Lodge—yet the schemes disagree with one another.

translations.literal: The Net Lodge has eight stars. It governs border armies, archery, and hunting.
translations.idiomatic: The Net Lodge comprises eight stars and presides over frontier armies, archery, and the hunt.

sentences.zh: 其大星曰天高，一曰邊將，主四夷之尉也。

translations.literal: Its great star is called Celestial Height; one name is Border General. It governs the commandants of the four barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief star is called Celestial Height—or, by another name, the Border General—and presides over the commandants of the four frontier peoples.

translations.literal: The Treatise on the Celestial Offices says: "The Net is the Han-Net chariot."
translations.idiomatic: The 《Treatise on the Celestial Offices》 says: "The Net stands for the Han-Net chariot."

sentences.zh: 明大，則遠人來朝，天下安；

translations.literal: If bright and great, distant peoples come to court and the realm is secure;
translations.idiomatic: when bright and swollen, distant peoples come to pay court and the realm is at peace;

translations.literal: if it loses color, border armies are in disorder;
translations.idiomatic: when it fades in color, frontier armies fall into chaos;

translations.literal: if one star perishes, there is warfare and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: when one star vanishes, war and mourning follow;

translations.literal: if they tremble and shift, border armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when they stir and sway, frontier armies mobilize;

translations.literal: if they shift and migrate, prisons throughout the realm are in disorder;
translations.idiomatic: when they shift position, prisons across the land fall into chaos;

translations.literal: if they draw together and cluster, laws and commands are harsh.
translations.idiomatic: when they cluster together, statutes grow severe.

sentences.zh: 日食，邊王死，軍自殺其主，遠國有謀亂。

translations.literal: In a solar eclipse, border kings die, armies kill their own lords, and distant states plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse portends the death of frontier kings, armies turning on their own commanders, and plots of rebellion in distant realms.

translations.literal: a solar halo: there are border armies;
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the sun means frontier armies will mobilize;

sentences.zh: 不則北主憂，又佔有風雨。

translations.literal: otherwise the northern lord has worry; it also portends wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: otherwise the ruler of the north is troubled—and the omen also foretells wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 月食，有赦，趙分有兵，或趙君憂。

translations.literal: In a lunar eclipse, there is an amnesty; the Zhao region has armies, or the lord of Zhao has worry.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse brings an amnesty, warfare in the Zhao astrological division, or anxiety for the lord of Zhao.

translations.literal: a lunar halo: armies are in disorder, famine, and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the moon portends military turmoil, famine, and mourning;

sentences.zh: 暈三重，邊有叛者，七日內風雨解之，又爲陰國有憂，天下赦。

translations.literal: if the halo is triple, there are rebels on the borders; within seven days wind and rain dissolve it; it is also read as the yin state having worry and an amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: a triple halo means rebels on the frontier; within seven days wind and rain will clear it—or, by another reading, a rival power is troubled and an amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 犯畢大星，下犯上，大將死，陰國憂；

translations.literal: if it transgresses the great star of the Net Lodge, subordinates transgress superiors, the great general dies, and the yin state has worry;
translations.idiomatic: when it encroaches upon the chief star of the Net Lodge, inferiors strike at superiors, the commander-in-chief dies, and a rival power is beset with anxiety;

translations.literal: if it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, there is much rain;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, heavy rains follow;

translations.literal: if it pierces through the Net Lodge, there is famine for the year and bandits rise;
translations.idiomatic: when it pierces the Net Lodge, famine afflicts the year and brigands take the field;

translations.literal: if it loses its proper motion and departs from the Net Lodge, then rain;
translations.idiomatic: if it strays from its course and leaves the Net Lodge, rain follows;

translations.literal: if it is centered within, the chief consort has worry;
translations.idiomatic: when it stands at the center, the empress is troubled;

translations.literal: another reading says if it transgresses to the north, the yin state has worry;
translations.idiomatic: by another reading, encroachment to the north troubles a rival power;

translations.literal: to the south, the yang state has worry.
translations.idiomatic: to the south, the ruling power is troubled.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，冬多風雨，又曰爲水；

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, in winter there is much wind and rain; another reading says it signifies water;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, winter brings wind and heavy rain—or, by another reading, flood;

sentences.zh: 入畢口，邊兵起，民饑，有赦；

translations.literal: if it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, border armies rise, the people hunger, and there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, frontier armies mobilize, the people go hungry, and an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it stations thirty days, guest armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for thirty days, invading armies take the field;

translations.literal: if it emerges on the yang side, there is drought;
translations.idiomatic: when it emerges on the sunny side, drought follows;

translations.literal: on the yin side, there is water.
translations.idiomatic: on the shady side, flood.

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses the right horn, there is great battle;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon the right horn, a great battle follows;

translations.literal: the left horn, small battle;
translations.idiomatic: the left horn brings a lesser engagement;

translations.literal: if it enters, border armies have worry;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, frontier armies are imperiled;

translations.literal: if it stations there, there is famine and an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, famine strikes and an amnesty is granted;

translations.literal: if it forms the Gou-si hook and encircles, there is a great amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it traces the Gou-si hook in a loop, a great amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: one reading says if it enters within the Net Lodge, there are armies and armies cease;
translations.idiomatic: by one reading, when it enters the Net Lodge, war breaks out and then war ends;

sentences.zh: 又曰守之，有畋獵事，北主憂，天下道路不通；

translations.literal: another reading says if it stations there, there are hunting affairs, the northern lord has worry, and roads throughout the realm are blocked;
translations.idiomatic: by another reading, if it holds position there, the court goes hunting, the ruler of the north is troubled, and highways across the land are cut;

translations.literal: if it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde to the Hairy Head, there is death and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if it retreats to the Hairy Head Lodge, death and mourning follow;

translations.literal: if having departed it returns to station, noble ministers have worry;
translations.idiomatic: if having left it turns back to hold position, high ministers are troubled;

translations.literal: if it lodges at the mouth of the Net Lodge, the state of Zhao has worry.
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges at the mouth of the Net Lodge, Zhao is beset with anxiety.

sentences.zh: 填星犯之，兵起西北，不戰；

translations.literal: If Saturn transgresses it, armies rise in the northwest but do not fight;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches upon it, armies mobilize in the northwest yet do not give battle;

sentences.zh: 守之，兵有降軍，有赦，一曰土功徭役煩，兵起；

translations.literal: if it stations there, among the armies there are surrendering troops and an amnesty; one reading says earthworks and corvée labor are burdensome and armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, enemy troops surrender and an amnesty is granted—or, by another reading, earthworks and forced labor multiply and war breaks out;

translations.literal: if it enters, the earth quakes and waters overflow;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, the earth trembles and waters breach their banks;

translations.literal: if it stations at the mouth of the Net Lodge, a great man meets the omen;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds the mouth of the Net Lodge, a great person bears the calamity;

sentences.zh: 出、入、留、舍，其野兵起，客軍死。

translations.literal: If it emerges, enters, lingers, or lodges, in its territory armies rise and guest armies perish.
translations.idiomatic: Whether it emerges, enters, lingers, or lodges, armies rise in that quarter and invading forces are destroyed.

translations.literal: If Venus transgresses the right horn, battle is lost and the general dies;
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon the right horn, defeat follows and the general perishes;

sentences.zh: 入畢口，將相爲亂，大赦，國易政令，諸侯起兵，爲水，五穀不成；

translations.literal: if it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, generals and chancellors make disorder, there is a great amnesty, the state changes its policies and commands, feudal lords raise armies, there is water, and the five grains do not mature;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, generals and ministers rebel, a great amnesty is proclaimed, the realm changes its laws, feudal lords take the field, floods strike, and the five grains fail;

translations.literal: If it pierces through the Net Lodge, granaries are empty and the four states raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: When it transits the Net Lodge, storehouses stand empty and armies rise in the four quarters.

translations.literal: If Mercury transgresses it, the borderlands suffer calamity;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches upon it, the frontier regions meet with disaster;

translations.literal: if it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, the state changes its government;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters the mouth of the Net Lodge, the government is overturned;

sentences.zh: 守之，水溢，民病，物不成，邊兵起；

translations.literal: if it stations there, waters overflow, the people are ill, things do not mature, and border armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, waters flood, the people sicken, crops fail to ripen, and frontier armies mobilize;

translations.literal: if it stations at the mouth of the Net Lodge, men make disorder.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds the mouth of the Net Lodge, the people rise in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，大人憂，無兵兵起，有兵兵罷；

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, great men have worry; if there are no armies, armies rise; if there are armies, armies cease;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, eminent men are troubled—if there is no war, war breaks out; if there is war, war ends;

translations.literal: if it enters, there are many prison affairs;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, lawsuits and imprisonments multiply;

translations.literal: if it stations there, there is famine and border armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, famine strikes and frontier armies mobilize;

translations.literal: if it emerges, chariots and horses travel in haste.
translations.idiomatic: when it emerges, chariots and horses race in urgent dispatch.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，北地爲亂，人民憂。

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses it, the northern lands are in disorder and the people have worry.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, the northern marches fall into turmoil and the people are stricken with anxiety.

sentences.zh: 星孛，其分土功興，多徭役。

translations.literal: If a broom star appears, in its allotted region earthworks rise and corvée labor is heavy.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star blazes in its astrological division, great earthworks are launched and forced labor multiplies.

translations.literal: if the color is gray-blue, there is famine and armies are broken;
translations.idiomatic: if gray-blue in hue, famine follows and armies are shattered;

translations.literal: if yellow, then women make disorder;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, women stir up trouble;

translations.literal: if white, there is warfare and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if white, war and mourning follow;

translations.literal: if black, there is water.
translations.idiomatic: if black, flood.

translations.literal: If a shooting star transgresses it, border armies fight a great battle;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor strikes the lodge, frontier armies join in great battle;

translations.literal: if crimson in color and piercing through it, Rong armies arrive in force;
translations.idiomatic: if crimson and streaking through the lodge, barbarian armies descend in great numbers;

translations.literal: if it enters and again emerges, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters and then emerges again, an amnesty is proclaimed;

sentences.zh: 入而黃白有光，外人入貢。

translations.literal: if it enters and yellow-white light appears, foreigners enter with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters shining yellow-white, foreign peoples come bearing tribute.

translations.literal: if gray-white cloud vapor enters, the year's harvest is not gathered;
translations.idiomatic: when pale cloud vapor enters the lodge, the year's harvest fails;

translations.literal: if crimson, there is warfare, drought, and fire;
translations.idiomatic: if crimson, war, drought, and fire follow;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven has joy.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven receives good tidings.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，畢十六度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Net Lodge is sixteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Net Lodge spans sixteen degrees.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was seventy-eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: By the earlier measure, its distance from the celestial pole was seventy-eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，畢宿十七度，距畢口北星去極七十七度。

translations.literal: In the Jingyou survey and test, the Net Lodge is seventeen degrees, and from the northern star at the mouth of the Net Lodge the distance from the pole is seventy-seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey found the Net Lodge to span seventeen degrees and placed the northern star at its mouth seventy-seven degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 天節八星，在畢、附耳南，主使臣持節宣威四方。

translations.literal: The Celestial Knob has eight stars, south of the Net Lodge and Attached Ear. It governs envoys who bear credentials and proclaim authority to the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Knob comprises eight stars south of the Net Lodge and Attached Ear and presides over envoys who bear the imperial staff and proclaim the court's authority to the four quarters.

translations.literal: if bright and great, envoys are loyal;
translations.idiomatic: when bright and swollen, the envoys prove faithful;

translations.literal: if not bright, those sent on mission are without proper conduct.
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the court's emissaries disgrace their commissions.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，臣有謀逆，或使臣死。

translations.literal: If Mars stations there, ministers plot treason, or an envoy dies.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars holds position there, ministers plot rebellion—or an envoy meets his death.

translations.literal: If Venus stations there, the great general goes forth.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus holds position there, the commander-in-chief takes the field.

translations.literal: If a guest star or comet transgresses it, laws and commands are not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star or comet encroaches upon it, edicts go unheeded.

translations.literal: If a guest star stations there, the credential-bearing minister has worry.
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star holds position there, the envoy bearing the staff is troubled.

sentences.zh: 九州殊口九星，在天節南下，曉方俗之官，通重譯者也。

translations.literal: The Nine Provinces, Diverse Mouths has nine stars, south of the Celestial Knob. It is the office that understands regional customs—the one who communicates through repeated translation.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Provinces, Diverse Mouths comprises nine stars south of the Celestial Knob—the office that understands local customs and communicates through repeated translation.

translations.literal: One constantly observes it in the eleventh month.
translations.idiomatic: It is regularly observed in the eleventh month.

translations.literal: if one star perishes, one state has worry;
translations.idiomatic: when one star vanishes, a single state is troubled;

translations.literal: if two stars or more, the realm is in disorder and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: if two or more stars vanish, the realm falls into chaos and war breaks out.

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars station there, it is also warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars hold position there, war likewise follows.

sentences.zh: 客星入，民憂，水負海，國不安，有兵。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, the people have worry; water backs up against the sea; the state is not secure; there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters, the people are anxious, coastal waters surge inland, the realm is unsettled, and war follows.

sentences.zh: 附耳一星，在畢下，主聽得失，伺愆邪，察不祥也。

translations.literal: Attached Ear is one star, below the Net Lodge. It governs hearing gain and loss, watching for faults and wickedness, and detecting ill omens.
translations.idiomatic: Attached Ear is a single star below the Net Lodge, charged with hearing what is gained and lost, watching for error and wickedness, and detecting ill omens.

sentences.zh: 星盛，則中國微，有盜賊，邊候警，外國反。

translations.literal: if the star flourishes, China is weakened, there are bandits and thieves, border watches are alarmed, and foreign states rebel.
translations.idiomatic: when the star blazes forth, the central realm is enfeebled, bandits arise, frontier posts sound the alarm, and foreign states revolt.

translations.literal: if it trembles and shifts, slanderous ministers are at the ruler's side.
translations.idiomatic: when it stirs and sways, slanderers crowd the ruler's side.

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, there is warfare and generals and chancellors perish.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, war follows and generals and ministers die.

translations.literal: If Venus transgresses it, flatterers are at the side.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon it, sycophants press close to the throne.

sentences.zh: 九斿九星，在玉井西南，一曰在九州殊口東，南北列，主天下兵旗，又曰天子之旗也。

translations.literal: The Nine Pennants has nine stars, southwest of the Jade Well—one reading says east of the Nine Provinces, Diverse Mouths, arrayed north and south. It governs the military banners throughout the realm; it is also said to be the Son of Heaven's banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Pennants comprises nine stars southwest of the Jade Well—or, by one reading, east of the Nine Provinces, Diverse Mouths, ranged north and south. It presides over the realm's battle standards and is also called the Son of Heaven's banner.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑犯之，兵騎滿野。

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars transgress it, armed horsemen fill the fields.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars encroach upon it, cavalry cover the countryside.

sentences.zh: 客星犯，諸侯兵起，禽獸多疾。

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, feudal lords raise armies and birds and beasts suffer many illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, feudal lords take the field and birds and beasts fall prey to disease.

sentences.zh: 天街二星，在昴、畢間，一曰在畢宿北，爲陰陽之所分。

translations.literal: The Celestial Street has two stars, between the Hairy Head and Net Lodges—one reading says north of the Net Lodge, the place where yin and yang divide.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Street comprises two stars between the Hairy Head and Net Lodges—or, by one reading, north of the Net Lodge—marking the boundary where yin and yang divide.

sentences.zh: 《大象占》：近月星西，街南爲華夏，街北爲外邦。

translations.literal: The Great Appearances Occupations says: near the moon-star to the west, south of the Street is Huaxia and north of the Street is the outer states.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Great Appearances Occupations》 says: near the moon-star to the west, south of the Street is the Central Realm and north of the Street is the outer domains.

sentences.zh: 又曰三光之道，主伺候關梁中外之境。

translations.literal: It also says the path of the three luminaries governs watching the passes and bridges at the border between inner and outer realms.
translations.idiomatic: It also holds that the path of the sun, moon, and stars presides over watching the passes and bridges that mark the border between the inner and outer realms.

translations.literal: if bright, the kingly Way is correct.
translations.idiomatic: when bright, the royal Way stands upright.

sentences.zh: 月犯天街中，爲中平，天下安寧；

translations.literal: If the moon transgresses the center of the Celestial Street, it is central balance and the realm is secure and tranquil;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon encroaches upon the center of the Celestial Street, the realm is in balance and all under Heaven is at peace;

sentences.zh: 街外，爲漏泄，讒夫當事，民不得志；

translations.literal: outside the Street, there is leakage; slanderers hold affairs and the people do not attain their aims;
translations.idiomatic: outside the Street, secrets leak out, slanderers seize power, and the people cannot fulfill their aims;

translations.literal: if it does not pass by the Celestial Street, it governs policies and commands not being carried out.
translations.idiomatic: if it does not transit the Celestial Street, edicts and commands go unenforced.

translations.literal: If the moon halos its lodge, passes and bridges are not open.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon halos the lodge, frontier passes and bridges are blocked.

translations.literal: If Mars stations there, roads are cut off;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars holds position there, highways are severed;

translations.literal: if it stations long, the state cuts off ritual.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position for long, the state abandons ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 歲星居之，色赤，爲殃，或大旱。

translations.literal: If Jupiter dwells there and its color is crimson, there is calamity or great drought.
translations.idiomatic: when Jupiter dwells there glowing crimson, calamity follows—or great drought.

sentences.zh: 太白守之，兵塞道路，六夷旄頭滅，一曰民饑。

translations.literal: If Venus stations there, armies block the roads, the Six Yi and Mao-tou are extinguished; one reading says the people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: when Venus holds position there, armies choke the highways, the Six Yi and Mao-tou peoples are destroyed—or, by another reading, the people go hungry.

sentences.zh: 天高四星，在坐旗西，《乾象新書》：在畢口東北。

translations.literal: Celestial Height has four stars, west of the Seated Banner. The New Writings on the Celestial Appearances places them northeast of the mouth of the Net Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Height comprises four stars west of the Seated Banner—the 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 places them northeast of the mouth of the Net Lodge.

sentences.zh: 台榭之高，主望八方雲霧氛氣，今仰觀台也。

translations.literal: Its terrace and pavilion height governs gazing upon cloud, mist, and vapor from the eight directions—the present Observing-the-Heavens Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Raised like a terrace and pavilion, it presides over surveying cloud, mist, and vapor from the eight directions—the celestial counterpart of the Observing-the-Heavens Terrace.

translations.literal: if it is not visible, the ruler loses ritual propriety;
translations.idiomatic: when invisible, the sovereign forfeits ritual propriety;

translations.literal: if it keeps constant, then auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds steady, fortune follows;

translations.literal: if dim, yin and yang are not in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: when faintly dim, yin and yang fall out of harmony.

sentences.zh: 月、五星犯之，則水旱不時；

translations.literal: if the moon and five planets transgress it, flood and drought come untimely;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon or five planets encroach upon it, floods and droughts arrive at the wrong seasons;

translations.literal: if it is transited, outer ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: if it is crossed, outer ministers are put to death.

translations.literal: if the moon halos it, within six months there is mourning.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon halos it, mourning comes within six months.

translations.literal: if Mars enters and remains ten days, there is a minor amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars enters and stays ten days, a minor amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if it stations thirty days, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position thirty days, a great amnesty follows.

translations.literal: if a guest star and comet station there, great drought.
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star and comet hold position there, great drought ensues.

translations.literal: if pale cloud vapor transgresses it, likewise.
translations.idiomatic: when pale cloud vapor encroaches upon it, the same portent applies.

sentences.zh: 諸王六星，在五車南，主察諸侯存亡。

translations.literal: The Princes of the States are six stars, south of the Five Chariots. They govern inspecting whether feudal lords survive or perish.
translations.idiomatic: The Princes of the States comprise six stars south of the Five Chariots, charged with observing whether the feudal lords endure or perish.

translations.literal: if bright, inferiors attach to superiors;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, subordinates attach themselves to their superiors;

translations.literal: if not bright, inferiors rebel;
translations.idiomatic: when dim, subordinates rebel;

translations.literal: if not visible, ancestral temples are imperiled and armies rise in the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: when invisible, the ancestral temples are endangered and armies rise on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入之，諸王妃恣，爲下所謀；

translations.literal: if Mars enters, princes' consorts are unrestrained and are plotted against by inferiors;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars enters, consorts of the feudal princes grow dissolute and are schemed against by their subordinates;

translations.literal: if it stations there, inferiors do not trust superiors.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, subordinates cease to trust their superiors.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑犯，諸王當之，一曰宗臣憂。

translations.literal: if Venus and Mars transgress it, feudal princes bear the omen; one reading says clan ministers worry.
translations.idiomatic: when Venus and Mars encroach upon it, the feudal princes bear the omen—or, by one reading, the clan ministers are anxious.

translations.literal: if a guest star and comet station there, feudal lords are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star and comet hold position there, feudal lords are removed from office.

sentences.zh: 五車五星、三柱九星，在畢宿北，五帝坐也，又五帝之車舍也。

translations.literal: The Five Chariots are five stars and the Three Pillars nine stars, north of the Net Lodge—the seats of the Five Emperors and also the resting places of their chariots.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Chariots comprise five stars and the Three Pillars nine stars north of the Net Lodge—the seats of the Five Emperors and the lodges where their chariots rest.

sentences.zh: 主天子五兵，又主五穀豐耗。

translations.literal: They govern the Son of Heaven's five weapons and also govern abundance or scarcity of the five grains.
translations.idiomatic: They preside over the Son of Heaven's five armaments and over whether the five grains flourish or fail.

sentences.zh: 一車主蕡麻，一車主麥，一車主豆，一車主黍，一車主稻米。

translations.literal: One chariot governs hemp, one wheat, one beans, one millet, and one rice.
translations.idiomatic: One chariot presides over hemp, another over wheat, another over beans, another over millet, and another over rice.

sentences.zh: 西北大星曰天庫，主太白，秦分及雍州，主豆。

translations.literal: The great star in the northwest is called the Celestial Storehouse. It governs Venus, the Qin allotment and Yong Province, and beans.
translations.idiomatic: The great star in the northwest is the Celestial Storehouse; it governs Venus, the Qin astrological region and Yong Province, and presides over beans.

sentences.zh: 東北一星曰天獄，主辰星，燕、趙分及幽、冀，主稻。

translations.literal: The star in the northeast is called the Celestial Prison. It governs Mercury, the Yan and Zhao allotments and You and Ji, and rice.
translations.idiomatic: The northeastern star is the Celestial Prison; it governs Mercury, the Yan and Zhao regions together with You and Ji, and presides over rice.

sentences.zh: 東南一星曰天倉，主歲星，魯分徐州，衛分并州，主麻。

translations.literal: The star in the southeast is called the Celestial Granary. It governs Jupiter, the Lu allotment (Xuzhou) and the Wei allotment (Bingzhou), and hemp.
translations.idiomatic: The southeastern star is the Celestial Granary; it governs Jupiter, the Lu region (Xuzhou) and the Wei region (Bingzhou), and presides over hemp.

sentences.zh: 次東南一星曰司空，主填星，楚分荊州，主黍粟。

translations.literal: The next star southeast is called the Minister of Works. It governs Saturn, the Chu allotment (Jingzhou), and millet and panicled millet.
translations.idiomatic: The next star to the southeast is the Minister of Works; it governs Saturn, the Chu region (Jingzhou), and presides over millet and panicled millet.

sentences.zh: 次西南一星曰卿，主熒惑，魏分益州，主麥。

translations.literal: The next star southwest is called the Minister Star. It governs Mars, the Wei allotment (Yizhou), and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: The next star to the southwest is the Minister Star; it governs Mars, the Wei region (Yizhou), and presides over wheat.

sentences.zh: 《天文錄》曰：「太白，其神令尉，辰星，其神風伯；

translations.literal: The Records of Astronomy says: "Venus—its deity is Lingwei; Mercury—its deity is the Wind Lord;
translations.idiomatic: The 《Records of Astronomy》 says, "Venus—its deity is Lingwei; Mercury—its deity is the Wind Lord;

translations.literal: Jupiter—its deity is the Rain Master;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter—its deity is the Rain Master;

translations.literal: Mars—its deity is Fenglong;
translations.idiomatic: Mars—its deity is Fenglong;

translations.literal: Saturn—its deity is the Thunder Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn—its deity is the Thunder Lord.

sentences.zh: 此五車有變，各以所主占之。」

translations.literal: When any of these Five Chariots shows change, each is interpreted by what it governs.
translations.idiomatic: When any of the Five Chariots changes, read the omen by what that chariot governs.

sentences.zh: 三柱，一曰天淵，一曰天休，一曰天旂，欲其均明闊狹有常，星繁，則兵大起。

translations.literal: The Three Pillars—one called the Celestial Abyss, one the Celestial Rest, one the Celestial Banner—should be evenly bright with constant breadth and narrowness; if the stars grow numerous, armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Pillars—one called the Celestial Abyss, one the Celestial Rest, one the Celestial Banner—should shine evenly with spacing held constant; when the stars grow numerous, war erupts on a grand scale.

sentences.zh: 石申曰：「天庫星中河而見，天下多死人，河津絕。」

translations.literal: Shi Shen says: "When the Celestial Storehouse star is seen straddling the river, the dead multiply under Heaven and river crossings are severed."
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shen says, "When the Celestial Storehouse star appears amid the river, the dead multiply throughout the realm and river crossings are cut off."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「天子得靈台之禮，則五車、三柱均明有常。」

translations.literal: He also says: "When the Son of Heaven receives the Spirit Terrace rites, the Five Chariots and Three Pillars shine evenly and hold constant."
translations.idiomatic: He also says, "When the Son of Heaven receives the Spirit Terrace rites, the Five Chariots and Three Pillars shine evenly and remain constant."

sentences.zh: 天旂星不見，則大風折木；

translations.literal: When the Celestial Banner star is not visible, great winds snap trees;
translations.idiomatic: When the Celestial Banner star is not visible, great winds break trees;

translations.literal: when the Celestial Rest stirs, the four quarters rebel.
translations.idiomatic: when the Celestial Rest stirs, the four quarters rebel.

translations.literal: when one pillar emerges—or when one is not visible—half the armies mobilize;
translations.idiomatic: when one pillar protrudes, or when one vanishes, half the realm's armies take the field;

sentences.zh: 三柱盡出，及不見，兵亦盡出。

translations.literal: when all three pillars have emerged, or when none are visible, the armies mobilize in full.
translations.idiomatic: when all three pillars have fully emerged, or when none are visible, the armies mobilize in full.

translations.literal: when a pillar protrudes outward for one month, grain grows three times as dear;
translations.idiomatic: when a pillar extends outward for one month, grain becomes three times as costly;

translations.literal: after two or three months outward, the price doubles again in succession;
translations.idiomatic: after two or three months, the price doubles again in turn;

translations.literal: if they protrude outward without fully spanning two intervals, great floods are foretold.
translations.idiomatic: if they extend outward without fully spanning two gaps, great floods are foretold.

translations.literal: when the moon transgresses the Celestial Storehouse, armies rise and roads are blocked;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon encroaches upon the Celestial Storehouse, war breaks out and the roads are impassable;

translations.literal: when it transgresses the Celestial Abyss, eminent persons die and ministers overstep their lord.
translations.idiomatic: when it encroaches upon the Celestial Abyss, nobles die and ministers overstep their sovereign.

translations.literal: when the moon halos it, the empress dreads the omen;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon halos the asterism, the empress dreads the omen;

translations.literal: if in the first month, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if in the first month, an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if the halo touches one chariot, minor offenses are pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: if the halo encloses one chariot, minor offenses are pardoned;

translations.literal: if all five chariots are haloed, exceptional crimes are pardoned;
translations.idiomatic: if all five chariots are haloed, capital and exceptional crimes are pardoned;

translations.literal: halos in the fourth, seventh, or tenth months foretell flood;
translations.idiomatic: halos in the fourth, seventh, or tenth months portend flood;

translations.literal: halos in the eleventh or twelfth months mean dear grain.
translations.idiomatic: halos in the eleventh or twelfth months mean costly grain.

translations.literal: when the five planets transgress it, drought and mourning follow;
translations.idiomatic: when the five planets encroach upon it, drought and mourning follow;

translations.literal: transgression of the Storehouse star means armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: encroachment upon the Storehouse star means war.

translations.literal: when Jupiter enters, grain bought at market grows dear.
translations.idiomatic: when Jupiter enters, grain prices at market soar.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入之，爲火，或與歲星占同。

translations.literal: when Mars enters, fire breaks out—or the omen may match Jupiter's reading.
translations.idiomatic: when Mars enters, fire breaks out—or the omen may be read the same as for Jupiter.

translations.literal: when Saturn enters the Celestial Storehouse, there is warfare and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: when Saturn enters the Celestial Storehouse, war and mourning follow;

sentences.zh: 舍中央，爲大旱，燕、代之地當之；

translations.literal: if it lodges in the center, great drought strikes, borne by the Yan and Dai regions;
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges in the center, great drought strikes, borne by the Yan and Dai regions;

translations.literal: if it lodges in the northeast, livestock multiply and silk falls cheap;
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges in the northeast, livestock multiply and silk grows cheap;

translations.literal: if it lodges in the northwest, all under Heaven is at peace.
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges in the northwest, all under Heaven is at peace.

translations.literal: when Venus enters, armies rise greatly;
translations.idiomatic: when Venus enters, war erupts on a grand scale;

sentences.zh: 守五車，中國兵所向慴伏；

translations.literal: if it stations at the Five Chariots, the armies of the central domains wherever they go make foes cower and submit;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds the Five Chariots, the armies of the central domains wherever they march make enemies cower and submit;

sentences.zh: 舍西北，爲疾疫，牛馬死，應酒泉分。

translations.literal: if it lodges in the northwest, there is pestilence, cattle and horses die, and the Jiuquan astrological division bears the omen.
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges in the northwest, pestilence arises, cattle and horses die, and the Jiuquan region bears the omen.

translations.literal: when Mercury enters and lodges there, floods follow;
translations.idiomatic: when Mercury enters and lodges there, floods follow;

translations.literal: if it transgresses it, armies rise amid deluge and inundation.
translations.idiomatic: if it encroaches upon the asterism, armies mobilize amid flood and inundation.

translations.literal: when a guest star transgresses it, the people are worn down with labor;
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star encroaches upon it, the people are worn down with toil;

sentences.zh: 庚寅日候近之，爲金車，主兵；

translations.literal: if on a gengyin day it is observed drawing near, it is a Metal Chariot and presages armies;
translations.idiomatic: if on a gengyin day it is observed drawing near, it is a Metal Chariot and presages war;

sentences.zh: 甲寅日候近之，爲木車，主槥增價；

translations.literal: on a jiayin day if observed drawing near, it is a Wood Chariot and coffin timber grows costly;
translations.idiomatic: on a jiayin day if observed drawing near, it is a Wood Chariot and coffin planks rise in price;

sentences.zh: 戊寅日候近之，爲土車，主土功；

translations.literal: on a wuyin day if observed drawing near, it is an Earth Chariot and presages earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: on a wuyin day if observed drawing near, it is an Earth Chariot and presages earthworks;

sentences.zh: 丙寅日候近之，爲火車，主旱；

translations.literal: on a bingyin day if observed drawing near, it is a Fire Chariot and presages drought;
translations.idiomatic: on a bingyin day if observed drawing near, it is a Fire Chariot and presages drought;

sentences.zh: 壬寅日候近之，爲水車，主水溢；

translations.literal: on a renyin day if observed drawing near, it is a Water Chariot and presages inundation;
translations.idiomatic: on a renyin day if observed drawing near, it is a Water Chariot and presages inundation;

translations.literal: when it enters, green portends anxiety, crimson portends armies;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters, green portends anxiety and crimson portends war;

translations.literal: if it stations at the Celestial Abyss, great floods follow;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds the Celestial Abyss, great floods follow;

translations.literal: if it stations at the Celestial Rest, to the left means armies and to the right mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds the Celestial Rest, to the left means war and to the right mourning;

translations.literal: yellow is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: yellow is auspicious.

translations.literal: when a comet or broom star transgresses it, armies rise and the people scatter.
translations.idiomatic: when a comet or broom star encroaches upon it, war breaks out and the people flee.

translations.literal: when a shooting star enters, on a jiazi day it governs grain;
translations.idiomatic: when a meteor enters, on a jiazi day it governs grain;

translations.literal: on a bingwu day it governs wheat;
translations.idiomatic: on a bingwu day it governs wheat;

translations.literal: on a wuyin day it governs beans;
translations.idiomatic: on a wuyin day it governs beans;

sentences.zh: 庚申日，主蕡，壬戌日，主黍：各以其日占之，而粟麥等價增。

translations.literal: on a gengshen day it governs panicled millet, on a renxu day millet: read each by its day, and the prices of grain, wheat, and the rest increase.
translations.idiomatic: on a gengshen day it governs panicled millet and on a renxu day millet—read each by its day, and the prices of grain, wheat, and the rest rise.

translations.literal: when white cloud vapor enters, the people are unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: when white cloud vapor enters, the people are unsettled;

translations.literal: if crimson, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: if crimson, war breaks out.

translations.literal: The Celestial Ford comprises five stars within the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Ford comprises five stars within the Five Chariots.

translations.literal: It governs river bridges and ferry crossings.
translations.idiomatic: It presides over river bridges and ferry crossings.

translations.literal: when the stars are not visible, ferries and crossings are not open.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are not visible, ferries and crossings cease to function.

translations.literal: when the moon enters the Celestial Ford, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon enters the Celestial Ford, war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 五星失度，留守之，皆爲兵。

translations.literal: when the five planets lose their proper motion and enter to station there, all portend armies.
translations.idiomatic: when the five planets stray from their courses and enter to hold position there, all portend war.

sentences.zh: 熒惑、填星入之，爲大旱，爲火。

translations.literal: when Mars and Saturn enter, there is great drought and fire.
translations.idiomatic: when Mars and Saturn enter, great drought and fire follow.

translations.literal: when Mars lodges there, cattle and horses suffer pestilence and there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: when Mars lodges there, cattle and horses suffer pestilence and war follows.

translations.literal: when Mercury emerges from the Celestial Ford, there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: when Mercury emerges from the Celestial Ford, an amnesty is proclaimed.

translations.literal: when a guest star enters, there is warfare;
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star enters, war follows;

translations.literal: if it enters and stations there, there is flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters and holds position, flood damage ensues.

translations.literal: when pale or black cloud vapor enters, there is mourning;
translations.idiomatic: when pale or black cloud vapor enters, mourning follows;

translations.literal: if crimson, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: if crimson, war breaks out;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven has joy.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven has cause for rejoicing.

sentences.zh: 咸池三星，在天潢南，主陂澤池沼魚鱉鳧雁。

translations.literal: The Salty Pool comprises three stars south of the Celestial Ford. It governs embankments, marshes, ponds, fish, turtles, ducks, and wild geese.
translations.idiomatic: The Salty Pool comprises three stars south of the Celestial Ford and presides over embankments, marshes, ponds, fish, turtles, ducks, and wild geese.

translations.literal: when bright and large, dragons appear and tigers and wolves do harm;
translations.idiomatic: when bright and large, dragons are seen and tigers and wolves bring harm;

translations.literal: when the stars are not complete, river channels are not open.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are incomplete, river channels are impassable.

translations.literal: when the moon enters, there are sudden armies.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon enters, sudden warfare erupts.

sentences.zh: 五星入，爲兵，爲旱，失忠臣，君易政；

translations.literal: when the five planets enter, there is warfare and drought, loyal ministers are lost, and the ruler changes his government;
translations.idiomatic: when the five planets enter, war and drought follow, loyal ministers are lost, and the ruler changes his policies;

translations.literal: if they station there, there is famine and warfare.
translations.idiomatic: if they hold position there, famine and war ensue.

translations.literal: when a guest star enters, great flood throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star enters, floods inundate all under Heaven.

translations.literal: when a shooting star enters, there is mourning;
translations.idiomatic: when a meteor enters, mourning follows;

translations.literal: when it emerges, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: when it emerges, war breaks out.

translations.literal: when cloud vapor enters, if pale many fish die;
translations.idiomatic: when cloud vapor enters, if pale many fish perish;

translations.literal: if crimson, there is drought;
translations.idiomatic: if crimson, drought follows;

translations.literal: if white, divine fish appear;
translations.idiomatic: if white, divine fish are seen;

translations.literal: if black, there is great flood.
translations.idiomatic: if black, great floods rise.

sentences.zh: 參旗九星，一曰天旗，一曰天弓，司弓弩，候變禦難。

translations.literal: Banner of Three Stars comprises nine stars—also called the Celestial Banner, also the Celestial Bow. It governs bows and crossbows and watches for change to ward off calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The Banner of Three Stars comprises nine stars—also called the Celestial Banner and the Celestial Bow—and presides over bows and crossbows, watching for change to ward off calamity.

translations.literal: if the stars are like a drawn bow, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars resemble a strung bow, war breaks out;

translations.literal: if bright, frontier raiders stir;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, frontier raiders stir;

translations.literal: if dim, it is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the omen is auspicious.

sentences.zh: 又曰天弓不具，天下有兵。

translations.literal: It is also said: if the Celestial Bow is incomplete, there is warfare throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that when the Celestial Bow is incomplete, war engulfs all under Heaven.

translations.literal: If the five planets transgress it, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets encroach upon it, war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，下謀上，諸侯起兵；

translations.literal: If Mars stations there, subordinates plot against the ruler and feudal lords raise armies;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars holds position there, subordinates plot against the ruler and the feudal lords raise armies;

translations.literal: one reading says there are frontier armies.
translations.idiomatic: by one reading, frontier armies mobilize.

translations.literal: If Venus stations there, armies are in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus holds position there, the armies fall into disorder.

translations.literal: If a guest star stations there, the realm is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star holds position there, anxiety spreads across the realm.

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters, armies rise in the northern lands.
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor enters, armies rise in the northern territories.

sentences.zh: 雲氣犯之，色青，入自西北，兵來，期三年。

translations.literal: If cloud vapor transgresses it and is green, entering from the northwest, armies come—the term is three years.
translations.idiomatic: When green cloud vapor encroaches upon it, entering from the northwest, armies advance—the term is three years.

sentences.zh: 天關一星，在五車南，亦曰天門，日月之所行，主邊方，主關閉。

translations.literal: Celestial Gate is one star south of the Five Chariots. It is also called Heavenly Gate, where sun and moon travel. It governs the frontier regions and governs passes and barriers.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Gate is a single star south of the Five Chariots—also called the Heavenly Gate, along the path of sun and moon—and presides over the frontier and over passes and barriers.

translations.literal: If the star shows rays and horns, there is warfare;
translations.idiomatic: when the star shows rays and horns, war follows;

translations.literal: if it does not align with the Five Chariots, the great general goes forth.
translations.idiomatic: when it fails to align with the Five Chariots, the commander-in-chief takes the field.

translations.literal: If the moon or Jupiter shows a triple halo, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon or Jupiter is ringed threefold, an amnesty is proclaimed;

translations.literal: if they transgress it, rebellious ministers change the laws.
translations.idiomatic: when they encroach upon it, rebellious ministers alter the laws.

translations.literal: If the five planets station there, many nobles die.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets hold position there, many among the nobility perish.

sentences.zh: 歲星、熒惑守之，臣謀主，爲水，爲饑。

translations.literal: If Jupiter and Mars station there, ministers plot against the ruler; there is flood and famine.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter and Mars hold position there, ministers plot against the ruler, floods rise, and famine follows.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守之，大赦，關梁有兵。

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars station there, a great amnesty; warfare at passes and bridges.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus and Mars hold position there, a great amnesty is proclaimed and war breaks out at passes and bridges.

translations.literal: If Venus enters, great disorder follows.
translations.idiomatic: when Venus enters, great disorder ensues.

translations.literal: If Saturn stations there, the king is obstructed;
translations.idiomatic: when Saturn holds position there, the sovereign is cut off from counsel;

translations.literal: if they transgress it, ministers plot against the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: when they encroach upon it, ministers plot against the ruler.

translations.literal: If Venus loses its proper motion, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: when Venus strays from its course, war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，民多疾，關市不通；

translations.literal: If a guest star transgresses it, the people suffer much pestilence and frontier markets are blocked;
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star encroaches upon it, pestilence spreads among the people and frontier markets are shut;

translations.literal: It is also said: the feudal lords do not communicate and the people attack one another.
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that the feudal lords cease communication and the people turn upon one another.

translations.literal: If a guest star enters, there is much banditry.
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star enters, banditry multiplies.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，天下有急，關梁不通，民憂，多盜。

translations.literal: If a shooting star transgresses it, the realm has urgent crisis; passes and bridges are blocked, the people are troubled, and banditry is rife.
translations.idiomatic: when a meteor encroaches upon it, crisis grips the realm—passes and bridges are severed, the people are anxious, and banditry flourishes.

translations.literal: If yellow cloud vapor transgresses it, the four quarters send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: when yellow cloud vapor encroaches upon it, the four quarters present tribute.

sentences.zh: 天園十三星，在天苑南，植菜果之處。

translations.literal: Celestial Garden has thirteen stars south of the Celestial Park—the place where fruits and vegetables are planted.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Garden comprises thirteen stars south of the Celestial Park, where fruits and vegetables are cultivated.

translations.literal: If curved and hooked, fruits and vegetables ripen.
translations.idiomatic: when curved and hooked, fruits and vegetables ripen.

translations.literal: If white cloud vapor transgresses it, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: when white cloud vapor encroaches upon it, war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，以上諸星皆屬畢宿。

translations.literal: According to the Song of Pacing the Heavens, all the stars above belong to the Net Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 assigns all the stars described above to the Net Lodge.

sentences.zh: 武密書以天節屬昴，參旗、天關、五車、三柱皆屬觜，與《步天歌》不同。

translations.literal: The Wumu treatise assigns the Celestial Knob to the Hairy Head Lodge and the Banner of Three Stars, Celestial Gate, Five Chariots, and Three Pillars all to Turtle Beak—differing from the Song of Pacing the Heavens.
translations.idiomatic: The Wumu treatise places the Celestial Knob in the Hairy Head Lodge and the Banner of Three Stars, Celestial Gate, Five Chariots, and Three Pillars all in Turtle Beak—at odds with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以天節、參旗皆屬畢；

translations.literal: The New Writings on the Celestial Appearances assigns both the Celestial Knob and the Banner of Three Stars to the Net Lodge;
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 places both the Celestial Knob and the Banner of Three Stars in the Net Lodge;

sentences.zh: 天園西八星屬昴，東五星亦屬畢；

translations.literal: the eight western stars of the Celestial Garden belong to the Hairy Head Lodge, and the five eastern stars also belong to the Net Lodge;
translations.idiomatic: the eight western stars of the Celestial Garden belong to the Hairy Head Lodge, and the five eastern stars to the Net Lodge;

sentences.zh: 五車北西南三大星屬畢，東二星及三柱屬參。

translations.literal: the three great stars southwest of the Five Chariots belong to the Net Lodge; the two eastern stars and the Three Pillars belong to Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: the three great stars southwest of the Five Chariots belong to the Net Lodge, while the two eastern stars and the Three Pillars belong to Three Stars.

translations.literal: The accounts all differ; all are preserved here.
translations.idiomatic: The schemes all disagree; each is recorded here.

sentences.zh: 觜觿三星，爲三軍之候，行軍之藏府，葆旅收，斂萬物。

translations.literal: Turtle Beak has three stars. It is the outpost of the three armies, the storehouse of marching armies, governing encampments and gathering troops, gathering in all things.
translations.idiomatic: Turtle Beak comprises three stars—the outpost of the three armies and the marching storehouse, presiding over encampments and musters and gathering all things in.

translations.literal: If bright, army grain is ample and generals gain power;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, army provisions are ample and generals gain power;

translations.literal: if they move, bandits roam and encampments rise;
translations.idiomatic: when they shift, bandits roam and encampments spring up;

translations.literal: if dim, armies may not be deployed.
translations.idiomatic: when dim, armies must not be deployed.

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: ministers transgress the ruler; the warning falls on generals and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse means ministers encroach upon the ruler—the warning falls upon commanders and ministers.

sentences.zh: 暈及三重，其下穀不登，民疫；

translations.literal: A halo and triple rings: below, grain does not ripen and the people suffer pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: a halo and triple rings presage failed harvests below and pestilence among the people;

translations.literal: five rings: a great amnesty—the term is sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: five rings presage a great amnesty within sixty days.

sentences.zh: 月食，爲旱，大將憂，有叛主者。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: drought; the great general is troubled; there is one who rebels against the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends drought, anxiety for the commander-in-chief, and rebellion against the ruler.

sentences.zh: 正月月暈，有赦，外軍不勝，大將憂，偏裨有死者。

translations.literal: A lunar halo in the first month: an amnesty; the outer armies do not prevail; the great general is troubled; among the lieutenants some die.
translations.idiomatic: A halo around the moon in the first month presages an amnesty, defeat for armies in the field, anxiety for the commander-in-chief, and death among the subordinate officers.

translations.literal: If Jupiter transgresses it, armies rise in its allotted region;
translations.idiomatic: when Jupiter encroaches upon it, war breaks out in its astrological territory;

sentences.zh: 守，則農夫失業，後有憂，丁壯多暴死，下有叛者，民多疾疫；

translations.literal: if it stations there, farmers lose their livelihood; afterward there is trouble; many able-bodied men die suddenly; below there are rebels; the people suffer much pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, farmers lose their livelihood, trouble follows, many able-bodied men die suddenly, rebels arise below, and pestilence spreads among the people;

translations.literal: if it enters, banditry is rife and the seasons are out of harmony;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, banditry flourishes and the seasons fall out of harmony;

translations.literal: if the ruler's punishments are improper, it moves retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: if the ruler's punishments are unjust, it moves retrograde.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，其分有叛者，爲旱，爲火，爲兵起，爲糴貴；

translations.literal: If Mars transgresses it, its allotted region has rebels; there is drought, fire, rising armies, and dear grain;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars encroaches upon it, its territory sees rebellion, drought, fire, war, and soaring grain prices;

translations.literal: if it joins Turtle Beak, the Zhao allotment is mutually troubled;
translations.idiomatic: when it joins Turtle Beak, the Zhao territory is mutually afflicted;

translations.literal: if it enters, below there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: when it enters, armies mobilize below.

sentences.zh: 填星入犯，爲兵，爲土功，其分失地；

translations.literal: If Saturn enters and transgresses, there is warfare and earthworks; its allotted region loses territory;
translations.idiomatic: when Saturn enters and encroaches, war and earthworks follow and its territory loses ground;

sentences.zh: 女主恣，則填星逆行而色黃。

translations.literal: if the chief consort is unrestrained, Saturn moves retrograde and turns yellow.
translations.idiomatic: when the empress acts without restraint, Saturn moves retrograde and turns yellow.

translations.literal: If Venus transgresses it, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when Venus encroaches upon it, war breaks out;

sentences.zh: 守之，其分易令，大臣叛，物不成，民疫。

translations.literal: if it stations there, its allotted region changes its laws, great ministers rebel, things do not come to completion, and the people suffer pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, its territory alters its ordinances, great ministers rebel, undertakings fail to ripen, and pestilence spreads among the people.

translations.literal: If Mercury transgresses it, armies must not be raised;
translations.idiomatic: when Mercury encroaches upon it, armies must not be mobilized;

translations.literal: one reading says flooding in Zhao territory and rebels;
translations.idiomatic: by one reading, floods afflict the Zhao territory and rebels arise;

translations.literal: if it stations there, the Zhao allotment suffers famine.
translations.idiomatic: when it holds position there, famine stalks the Zhao territory.

sentences.zh: 客星出入其宿，青爲憂，赤爲兵，黑爲水，白爲喪，黃白爲吉。

translations.literal: If a guest star enters or leaves this lodge: green means trouble; crimson means armies; black means flood; white means mourning; yellow-white means auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters or leaves this lodge, green portends anxiety, crimson war, black flood, white mourning, and yellow-white good fortune.

translations.literal: If a comet transgresses it, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when a comet encroaches upon it, war breaks out;

translations.literal: entering or leaving its allotted region: loss of territory and the people disperse.
translations.idiomatic: entering or leaving its astrological territory means lost ground and a dispersing populace.

sentences.zh: 星孛之，爲兵亂，軍破，其色與客星同占。

translations.literal: If a broom star assails it, armies are in disorder and armies are broken; its color is read by the same rules as a guest star.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star strikes it, armies fall into disorder and are shattered; its color is read by the same rules as for a guest star.

sentences.zh: 流星入犯之，有叛者，有破軍。

translations.literal: If a shooting star enters and transgresses it, there are rebels and a shattered army.
translations.idiomatic: when a meteor enters and encroaches upon it, rebels arise and an army is shattered.

translations.literal: If cloud vapor transgresses it, crimson means armies;
translations.idiomatic: when cloud vapor encroaches upon it, crimson means war;

translations.literal: pale means armies and trouble;
translations.idiomatic: pale means war and anxiety;

translations.literal: black means great men in Zhao territory have trouble;
translations.idiomatic: black means great men in the Zhao territory face calamity;

translations.literal: if the color is yellow, divine treasure enters.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow in color, divine treasure is brought in.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀、唐開元遊儀，皆以觜觿爲三度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary, Turtle Beak was reckoned at three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere and the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary, Turtle Beak measured three degrees.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was eighty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly its distance from the pole was eighty-four degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，觜宿三星一度，距西南星去極八十四度，在赤道內七度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and test: the Turtle Beak lodge's three stars span one degree; from the southwestern star the distance from the pole is eighty-four degrees, seven degrees within the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey found the Turtle Beak lodge's three stars to span one degree, its southwestern star eighty-four degrees from the pole and seven degrees within the equator.

sentences.zh: 坐旗九星，在司怪西北，君臣設位之表也。

translations.literal: Seated Banner has nine stars northwest of the Director of Omens—the chart of how ruler and ministers take their places.
translations.idiomatic: The Seated Banner comprises nine stars northwest of the Director of Omens—the model by which ruler and ministers take their stations.

translations.literal: If the stars are bright, the state has ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright, the state observes ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 司怪四星，在井鉞星前，主候天地、日月、星辰變異，鳥獸、草木之妖，明主聞災，修德保福。

translations.literal: Director of Omens has four stars before the Well's Battle-axe star. It governs watching Heaven and Earth, sun, moon, and stars for change, and omens among birds, beasts, plants, and trees. An enlightened ruler hearing of disaster cultivates virtue and preserves blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Omens comprises four stars before the Well's Battle-axe and presides over watching Heaven and Earth, sun, moon, and stars for change, and omens among birds, beasts, plants, and trees—so that an enlightened ruler who hears of disaster may cultivate virtue and preserve blessing.

sentences.zh: 星不成行列，宮中及天下多怪。

translations.literal: If the stars do not form ranks and files, within the palace and throughout the realm omens multiply.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars fail to form proper ranks, omens multiply within the palace and throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，坐旗、司怪俱屬觜宿，武密書及《乾象新書》皆屬於參。

translations.literal: According to the Song of Pacing the Heavens, Seated Banner and Director of Omens both belong to the Turtle Beak lodge; the Wumu treatise and the New Writings on the Celestial Appearances both assign them to Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 places the Seated Banner and Director of Omens in the Turtle Beak lodge, while the Wumu treatise and the 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 both assign them to Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 參宿十星，一曰參伐，一曰天市，一曰大辰，一曰鈇鉞，主斬刈萬物，以助陰氣；
