translations.literal: The Three Stars lodge has ten stars—also called Three Stars' Punishment, also the Celestial Market, also the Great Mark, also Axe and Halberd. It governs cutting down and reaping all things to assist yin qi;
translations.idiomatic: The Three Stars lodge comprises ten stars—also called Three Stars' Punishment, the Celestial Market, the Great Mark, and Axe and Halberd—and presides over cutting down and reaping all things to assist the yin force;

sentences.zh: 又爲天獄，主殺，秉威行罰也；

translations.literal: it is also the Celestial Prison, governing execution; it wields authority and carries out punishment;
translations.idiomatic: it is also the Celestial Prison, governing execution and wielding authority to carry out punishment;

translations.literal: it also governs the balance, by which things are weighed and settled;
translations.idiomatic: it also holds the balance by which affairs are weighed and settled;

sentences.zh: 又主邊城，爲九譯，故不欲其動。

translations.literal: it also governs the frontier city and the nine interpreters—therefore one does not wish it to move.
translations.idiomatic: it also presides over frontier cities and the nine interpreters—hence it should not shift.

sentences.zh: 參爲白虎之體，其中三星橫列者，三將也；

translations.literal: Three Stars is the body of the White Tiger; among them the three stars arrayed crosswise are the three generals;
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars forms the body of the White Tiger; the three stars arrayed crosswise within it are the three generals;

translations.literal: the northeast is called the Left Shoulder, governing the Left General;
translations.idiomatic: the northeast is the Left Shoulder, governing the Left General;

translations.literal: the northwest is called the Right Shoulder, governing the Right General;
translations.idiomatic: the northwest is the Right Shoulder, governing the Right General;

translations.literal: the southeast is called the Left Foot, governing the Rear General;
translations.idiomatic: the southeast is the Left Foot, governing the Rear General;

translations.literal: the southwest is called the Right Foot, governing the Lieutenant General.
translations.idiomatic: the southwest is the Right Foot, governing the Lieutenant General.

sentences.zh: 參應七將，中央三小星曰伐，天之都尉，主鮮卑外國，不欲其明。

translations.literal: Three Stars corresponds to seven generals; the three small stars in the center are called Punishment—the celestial commandant, governing the Xianbei and foreign states. One does not wish them bright.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stars corresponds to seven generals; the three small stars at the center are called Punishment—the celestial commandant, presiding over the Xianbei and foreign states—and should not shine bright.

translations.literal: If all seven generals are bright and large, armies throughout the realm are keen;
translations.idiomatic: when all seven generals shine bright and large, armies throughout the realm are at full strength;

translations.literal: if the royal Way is deficient, rays and horns spread;
translations.idiomatic: when the royal Way is deficient, rays and horns spread;

sentences.zh: 伐星明與參等，大臣有謀，兵起；

translations.literal: if the Punishment stars are as bright as Three Stars, great ministers plot and armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when the Punishment stars shine as bright as Three Stars, great ministers plot and war breaks out;

translations.literal: if their color fades, armies scatter in defeat;
translations.idiomatic: when their color fades, armies scatter in defeat;

sentences.zh: 芒角動，邊有急，兵起，有斬伐之事；

translations.literal: if rays and horns stir, the frontier has urgency, armies rise, and there are executions and punitive campaigns;
translations.idiomatic: when rays and horns stir, the frontier faces crisis, armies mobilize, and executions and punitive campaigns follow;

translations.literal: if the stars shift, guests attack the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shift, subordinates attack the ruler;

translations.literal: if the shoulders are fine and slight, armies throughout the realm are weak;
translations.idiomatic: when the shoulders grow fine and slight, armies throughout the realm are enfeebled;

sentences.zh: 左足入玉井中，兵起，秦有大水，有喪，山石爲怪；

translations.literal: if the left foot enters the Jade Well, armies rise, Qin has great floods, there is mourning, and mountains and stones become portents;
translations.idiomatic: when the left foot star enters the Jade Well, war breaks out, Qin suffers great floods and mourning, and mountains and stones show uncanny omens;

translations.literal: if the stars are erratic and disobedient, the king's ministers are disloyal;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars grow erratic and skewed, royal ministers turn disloyal;

sentences.zh: 左股星亡，東南不可舉兵；

translations.literal: if the left thigh star vanishes, one must not raise armies in the southeast;
translations.idiomatic: when the left thigh star disappears, armies must not be mobilized in the southeast;

translations.literal: the right thigh governs the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: the right thigh star governs the northwest.

sentences.zh: 又曰參足移北爲進，將出有功；

translations.literal: it is also said: if Three Stars' feet shift northward, that is advance, and the general who goes forth will have merit;
translations.idiomatic: another account holds that when the feet of Three Stars shift northward, it signifies advance, and the general who takes the field wins distinction;

translations.literal: if they shift southward, that is retreat, and the general loses power.
translations.idiomatic: shifting southward means retreat, and the general loses influence.

translations.literal: if the three stars are sparse, laws and decrees are urgent.
translations.idiomatic: when the three stars grow sparse, laws and decrees grow harsh.

sentences.zh: 日食，大臣憂，臣下相殘，陰國強。

translations.literal: a solar eclipse: great ministers worry, subordinates harm one another, and yin states grow strong.
translations.idiomatic: a solar eclipse brings anxiety to great ministers, mutual slaughter among subordinates, and the rise of northern powers.

sentences.zh: 日暈，有來和親者，一曰大饑。

translations.literal: a solar halo: there will be one who comes to seek marriage alliance; another reading says great famine.
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the sun foretells marriage envoys—or, by another reading, severe famine.

sentences.zh: 月食其度，爲兵，臣下有謀，貴臣誅，其分大饑，外兵大將死，天下更令。

translations.literal: a lunar eclipse in its degree: there is warfare, subordinates have plots, noble ministers are executed, its allotted region has great famine, foreign armies and great generals die, and the realm's ordinances change.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse in its allotted degree brings war, intrigue among subordinates, and the execution of noble ministers; its territory suffers famine, foreign armies clash and great generals perish, and the laws of the realm are overturned.

sentences.zh: 月暈，將死，人殃亂，戰不利。

translations.literal: a lunar halo: generals die, the people suffer calamity and disorder, and warfare is unfavorable.
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the moon presages the death of generals, popular calamity and unrest, and ill fortune in battle.

translations.literal: if the moon transgresses it, noble ministers worry, armies rise, and the people hunger;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon encroaches upon it, noble ministers grow anxious, war erupts, and the people go hungry;

translations.literal: if it transgresses Three Stars' Punishment, lieutenant generals die.
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon Three Stars' Punishment brings the death of lieutenant generals.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，水旱不時，大疫，爲饑；

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, flood and drought come untimely, great pestilence comes, and there is famine;
translations.idiomatic: when Jupiter encroaches upon it, floods and droughts strike out of season, plague spreads, and famine follows;

translations.literal: if it stations there, armies rise and the people suffer pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: if it holds position there, war breaks out and pestilence afflicts the people;

translations.literal: if it enters, the realm's government changes.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the lodge, government throughout the realm is overturned.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，爲兵，爲內亂，秦、燕地凶；

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, there is warfare and internal disorder, and the regions of Qin and Yan are ill-omened;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars encroaches upon it, war and civil strife follow, and Qin and Yan are stricken with ill omens;

sentences.zh: 守之，爲旱，爲兵，四方不寧；

translations.literal: if it stations there, there is drought and warfare, and the four quarters are unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: stationing there brings drought and war, and unrest in all directions;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and enters, there is great famine.
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde and enters the lodge, severe famine ensues.

translations.literal: if Saturn transgresses it, there are rebellious ministers;
translations.idiomatic: when Saturn encroaches upon it, traitorous ministers appear;

sentences.zh: 守之，其下國亡，奸臣謀逆，一云有喪，後、夫人當之；

translations.literal: if it stations there, the state below perishes, treacherous ministers plot rebellion; one reading says there is mourning, for which the empress and consorts are responsible;
translations.idiomatic: holding position there means the subordinate state perishes and treacherous ministers plot rebellion—or, by one reading, mourning falls upon the empress and consorts;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and stations there in defense, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: moving retrograde and remaining on station there presages mobilization for war.

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses it, armies are raised throughout the realm;
translations.idiomatic: when Venus encroaches upon it, armies mobilize throughout the realm;

sentences.zh: 守之，大人爲亂，國易政，邊民大戰。

translations.literal: if it stations there, great men make disorder, the state changes its government, and border peoples fight greatly.
translations.idiomatic: stationing there brings turmoil among the great, a change of regime, and fierce warfare among frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，爲水，爲兵，貴臣黜。

translations.literal: if Mercury transgresses it, there are floods and armies, and noble ministers are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: when Mercury encroaches upon it, floods and war follow and noble ministers are removed from office.

sentences.zh: 辰星與參出西方，爲旱，大臣誅。

translations.literal: if Mercury and Three Stars appear in the west, there is drought and great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: when Mercury and Three Stars appear together in the west, drought strikes and great ministers are put to death.

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and stations there, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: moving retrograde and holding station there presages war.

sentences.zh: 客星入犯之，國內有斬刈事；

translations.literal: if a guest star enters and transgresses it, within the state there are executions and punitive campaigns;
translations.idiomatic: when a guest star enters and encroaches upon it, executions and punitive campaigns occur within the realm;

translations.literal: if it stations there, border prefectures lose territory;
translations.idiomatic: holding position there means border prefectures lose ground;

translations.literal: if it circles around, border generals have executions and punitive campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: when it circles the lodge, frontier generals face executions and punitive campaigns.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，邊兵敗，君亡，遠期三年；

translations.literal: if a comet transgresses it, border armies are defeated, the ruler perishes, and the portent extends three years into the future;
translations.idiomatic: when a comet encroaches upon it, frontier armies are routed, the ruler dies, and the omen lingers for three years;

translations.literal: if it pierces through it and its color is white, there are warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: piercing through the lodge in white portends war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 星孛於參，君臣俱憂，國兵敗。

translations.literal: if a broom star appears at Three Stars, ruler and ministers alike worry, and the state's armies are defeated.
translations.idiomatic: when a broom star manifests at Three Stars, ruler and ministers alike are troubled and the state's armies suffer defeat.

sentences.zh: 流星入犯之，先起兵者亡。

translations.literal: if a shooting star enters and transgresses it, whoever first raises armies perishes.
translations.idiomatic: when a shooting star enters and encroaches upon it, whoever strikes first is destroyed.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》曰：「流星出而光潤，邊安，有赦，獄空。」

translations.literal: The Yisi Treatise on Astrology says: "If a shooting star appears and its light is moist and lustrous, the frontier is secure, there is an amnesty, and the prisons are empty."
translations.idiomatic: The 《Yisi Treatise on Astrology》 says, "When a shooting star appears with moist, lustrous light, the frontier is secure, an amnesty is proclaimed, and the prisons stand empty."

sentences.zh: 青雲氣入犯之，天子起邊城；

translations.literal: if green cloud vapor enters and transgresses it, the Son of Heaven raises border fortresses;
translations.idiomatic: when blue-green cloud vapor enters and encroaches upon it, the Son of Heaven raises fortifications along the frontiers;

translations.literal: pale blue-white signifies disorder among ministers;
translations.idiomatic: a pale blue-white hue portends ministerial rebellion;

translations.literal: red signifies internal warfare;
translations.idiomatic: red foretells civil war;

translations.literal: if the color is yellow, moist and lustrous, great generals receive rewards;
translations.idiomatic: a moist, lustrous yellow means great generals receive imperial favors;

translations.literal: black signifies flood disaster, and great ministers worry.
translations.idiomatic: black presages flood disaster and anxiety among great ministers.

sentences.zh: 白雲氣出貫之，將死，天子疾。

translations.literal: if white cloud vapor emerges and pierces through it, generals die and the Son of Heaven falls ill.
translations.idiomatic: when white cloud vapor rises and pierces through the lodge, generals perish and the Son of Heaven falls sick.

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, Three Stars was eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Three Stars lodge measured eight degrees.

translations.literal: formerly its distance from the pole was ninety-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: the earlier measurement placed it ninety-four degrees from the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，參宿十星十度，右足入畢十三度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey and test: the Three Stars lodge, ten stars, ten degrees; the right foot enters the Net thirteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey found the Three Stars lodge to comprise ten stars spanning ten degrees, with the right foot star thirteen degrees into the Net Lodge.

sentences.zh: 玉井四星，在參左足下，主水泉，以給庖廚。

translations.literal: The Jade Well has four stars, beneath the left foot of Three Stars. It governs springs and wells, to supply the kitchens.
translations.idiomatic: The Jade Well comprises four stars beneath the left foot of Three Stars. It presides over springs and wells that supply the kitchens.

translations.literal: if it trembles and stirs, there is anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: when it trembles and shifts, trouble is portended.

sentences.zh: 客星入，爲水，爲喪國失地；

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, there are floods, mourning, loss of state and territory;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star's entry brings floods, mourning, and the loss of territory and sovereignty;

translations.literal: if it emerges, the state gains territory; one reading says a general will go forth.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, the state gains ground—or, by one reading, a general will take the field.

translations.literal: if a shooting star enters, there is great flood.
translations.idiomatic: when a shooting star enters, great floods follow.

sentences.zh: 雲氣入而色青，井水不可食。

translations.literal: if cloud vapor enters and the color is green, well water cannot be drunk.
translations.idiomatic: when cloud vapor enters with a blue-green tinge, well water becomes undrinkable.

sentences.zh: 屏二星，一作天屏，在玉井南，一云在參右足。

translations.literal: Screen has two stars—also called the Celestial Screen—south of the Jade Well; one reading says at Three Stars' right foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Screen comprises two stars—also called the Celestial Screen—south of the Jade Well, though one reading places them at the right foot of Three Stars.

translations.literal: if the stars are not complete, many people fall ill.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are incomplete, sickness spreads among the people.

translations.literal: if they are not bright, great men fall gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: when they dim, the mighty fall gravely sick.

translations.literal: if the stars vanish, the ruler has many illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars disappear, the ruler suffers frequent illness.

translations.literal: if the moon and the five planets transgress it, there are floods.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon or the five planets encroach upon it, floods follow.

sentences.zh: 客星出於屏，亦爲大人有疾。

translations.literal: if a guest star appears from Screen, great men also have illness.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star appearing at the Screen likewise portends sickness among the mighty.

translations.literal: if a comet transgresses it, flood and drought come untimely.
translations.idiomatic: when a comet encroaches upon it, floods and droughts strike out of season.

sentences.zh: 軍井四星，在玉井東南，軍營之井，主給師，濟疲乏。

translations.literal: Army Well has four stars, southeast of the Jade Well—the camp well of the army. It governs supplying the hosts and relieving weariness and exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: The Army Well comprises four stars southeast of the Jade Well—the army camp's well, presiding over supplies for the troops and relief for the weary.

translations.literal: if the moon transgresses it, fodder and straw and treasure are expended.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon encroaches upon it, fodder and treasure are drained.

translations.literal: if Mars enters, there are floods and many soldiers die.
translations.idiomatic: when Mars enters, floods come and soldiers die in great numbers.

translations.literal: if Venus enters, armies stir and the people are unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: when Venus enters, armies mobilize and the people grow restless.

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, there is anxiety over water harm.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star's entry raises fear of flood damage.

sentences.zh: 廁四星，在屏星東，一曰在參右腳南，主溷。

translations.literal: Privy has four stars, east of the Screen star—one reading says south of Three Stars' right foot. It governs filth.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy comprises four stars east of the Screen—or, by one reading, south of Three Stars' right foot—and presides over ordure and filth.

translations.literal: if the color is yellow, it is auspicious and the year's harvest is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: a yellow hue is auspicious and the harvest is plentiful;

translations.literal: if blue-black, the ruler has illness below the waist.
translations.idiomatic: a blue-black tint portends illness in the ruler's lower body.

translations.literal: if the stars are not complete, many nobles fall ill.
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are incomplete, the nobility suffer widespread sickness.

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, grain is dear.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star's entry drives up grain prices.

translations.literal: if a comet or broom star enters, the year is famine.
translations.idiomatic: when a comet or broom star enters, famine strikes that year.

translations.literal: if green cloud vapor enters, there is warfare;
translations.idiomatic: blue-green cloud vapor entering presages war;

translations.literal: black signifies anxiety;
translations.idiomatic: black portends trouble and grief;

translations.literal: if yellow, the Son of Heaven has joy.
translations.idiomatic: yellow brings joy to the Son of Heaven.

translations.literal: Celestial Excrement is one star, south of the Celestial Privy.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Excrement is a single star south of the Celestial Privy.

translations.literal: if the color is yellow, the year is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: a yellow hue promises a bountiful year.

sentences.zh: 凡變色，爲蝗，爲水旱，爲霜殺物。

translations.literal: whenever the color changes, there are locusts, flood and drought, and frost that kills growing things.
translations.idiomatic: any change of color portends locust plagues, floods or droughts, and killing frost.

translations.literal: one always observes it at the autumn equinox.
translations.idiomatic: it is regularly observed at the autumn equinox.

translations.literal: if the star vanishes and is not seen, the realm falls into desolation;
translations.idiomatic: when the star vanishes from sight, the land falls into ruin;

translations.literal: if the star is faint, many of the people flee as refugees.
translations.idiomatic: when the star fades, the people scatter in exile.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，玉井、軍井、廁各四星，屏二星，天屎一星，俱屬參宿。

translations.literal: According to the Song of Pacing the Heavens, the Jade Well, Army Well, and Privy each have four stars; Screen has two stars; Celestial Excrement has one star—all belonging to the Three Stars lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 assigns the Jade Well, Army Well, and Privy four stars each, the Screen two stars, and Celestial Excrement one—all subordinate to the Three Stars lodge.

sentences.zh: 《晉志》玉井在參左足，武密書屬觜，《乾象新書》屬畢；

translations.literal: The Jin Treatise places the Jade Well at Three Stars' left foot; the Wumu treatise assigns it to Turtle Beak; the New Writings on the Celestial Appearances assigns it to the Net Lodge;
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Treatise places the Jade Well at Three Stars' left foot, the Wumu treatise assigns it to Turtle Beak, and the 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 places it in the Net Lodge;

sentences.zh: 軍井，《晉志》在玉井南，武密亦屬觜，《乾象新書》亦屬畢，唐開元遊儀在玉井東南；

translations.literal: Army Well: the Jin Treatise places it south of the Jade Well; Wumu also assigns it to Turtle Beak; the New Writings also to the Net Lodge; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary places it southeast of the Jade Well;
translations.idiomatic: The Army Well: the Jin Treatise locates it south of the Jade Well; Wumu likewise assigns it to Turtle Beak; the 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 also to the Net; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary places it southeast of the Jade Well;

sentences.zh: 屏、廁、天屎，《晉志》皆不載，《隋志》屏在玉井南，開元遊儀在觜，《隋志》廁在屏東，屎在廁南，《乾象新書》皆屬參，與《步天歌》互有不合。

translations.literal: Screen, Privy, and Celestial Excrement—the Jin Treatise records none of them; the Sui Treatise places Screen south of the Jade Well; the Kaiyuan itinerant armillary places it in Turtle Beak; the Sui Treatise places Privy east of Screen and Excrement south of Privy; the New Writings assigns all to Three Stars—each at odds with the Song of Pacing the Heavens.
translations.idiomatic: Screen, Privy, and Celestial Excrement do not appear in the Jin Treatise; the Sui Treatise places the Screen south of the Jade Well, while the Kaiyuan itinerant armillary puts it in Turtle Beak; the Sui Treatise locates the Privy east of the Screen and Excrement south of the Privy; the 《New Writings on the Celestial Appearances》 assigns all three to Three Stars—each arrangement conflicting with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 in one respect or another.

sentences.zh: 東井八星，天之南門，黃道所經，七曜常行其中，爲天之亭候，主水衡事，法令所取平也。

translations.literal: The Well Lodge has eight stars—it is Heaven's south gate, where the Yellow Path passes; the seven luminaries constantly travel within it. It is Heaven's lookout post, governing water-balance affairs and the leveling of laws and decrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Well Lodge comprises eight stars forming Heaven's south gate, through which the ecliptic passes and the seven luminaries regularly move. It serves as Heaven's lookout tower, presiding over water administration and the fair dispensation of law.

sentences.zh: 武密占曰：井中爲三光正道，五緯留守若經之，皆爲天下無道。

translations.literal: Wumu astrology says: within the Well is the correct path of the three lights; if the five regulators station there or pass through it, all are signs that the realm is without the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Wumu astrology holds that the Well marks the true path of sun, moon, and stars; when any of the five planets stations there or passes through, it signals that the realm has lost the Way.

translations.literal: one does not wish it bright; if bright, there is great flood.
translations.idiomatic: the lodge should not shine too brightly—brightness brings great floods.

translations.literal: another prognostication says: if law is applied fairly, the Well lodge is bright.
translations.idiomatic: another omen reads that when justice is even-handed, the Well lodge shines clear.

sentences.zh: 鉞一星，附井宿前，主伺奢淫而斬之；

translations.literal: the Halberd is one star, attached before the Well lodge, governing to watch for extravagance and licentiousness and to execute those guilty;
translations.idiomatic: the Halberd is a single star affixed before the Well lodge, charged with detecting extravagance and debauchery and punishing the guilty;

sentences.zh: 明大與井宿齊，則用鉞于大臣。

translations.literal: if bright and large, matching the Well lodge, then the halberd is used upon great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: when it shines as large and bright as the Well lodge itself, the halberd is turned upon great ministers.

translations.literal: when the moon lodges there, its allotted region has wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon stations in the Well, its territory sees wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 日食，秦地旱，民流，有不臣者；

translations.literal: a solar eclipse: the Qin region is dry, the people flee as refugees, and there are those who are not loyal subjects;
translations.idiomatic: a solar eclipse dries out the Qin region, drives the people into exile, and breeds disloyal subjects;

translations.literal: a halo means much wind and rain;
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the sun brings abundant wind and rain;

sentences.zh: 有青赤氣在日，爲冠，天子立侯王。

translations.literal: if there is blue-green and red vapor at the sun, it forms a crown—the Son of Heaven enfeoffs marquises and kings.
translations.idiomatic: blue-green and red vapors about the sun form a crown-like halo, presaging the Son of Heaven's enfeoffment of nobles.

sentences.zh: 月食，有內亂，大臣黜，後不安，五穀不登，分有兵、喪。

translations.literal: a lunar eclipse: there is internal disorder, great ministers are dismissed, the empress is unsettled, the five grains do not mature, and its allotted region has warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse brings civil strife, the dismissal of ministers, unrest in the palace, crop failure, and war and mourning in its territory.

sentences.zh: 月暈，爲旱，爲兵，爲民流，國有憂，一曰有赦。

translations.literal: a lunar halo signifies drought, warfare, and the people fleeing as refugees; the state has anxiety; one reading says there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the moon portends drought, war, and popular exile; the state faces trouble—or, by one reading, a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 陰陽不和則暈，暈及三重，在三月爲大水，在十二月日壬癸爲大赦。

translations.literal: when yin and yang are not in harmony there is a halo; if the halo reaches triple layers, in the third month there is great flood; in the twelfth month, on a day of ren or gui, there is a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: yin-yang discord produces halos; a triple halo in the third month brings floods, while in the twelfth month, on a day ruled by Water (ren or gui), a grand amnesty is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，將死于兵，水官黜，刑不平；

translations.literal: if the moon transgresses it, generals die in warfare, water officials are dismissed, and punishments are not fair;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon encroaches upon the Well, generals perish in battle, water officials are ousted, and justice grows uneven;

translations.literal: if it transgresses the Well Halberd, great ministers are executed and there are water affairs.
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon the Well Halberd brings the execution of ministers and flood-related crises.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，主急法，多獄訟，水溢，將軍惡之；

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, it governs urgent laws, many prison lawsuits, overflowing water, and generals find it ill-omened;
translations.idiomatic: when Jupiter encroaches upon the Well, laws grow harsh, lawsuits multiply, waters overflow, and disaster befalls the generals;

translations.literal: if it transgresses the Well Halberd, close attendants make disorder and armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon the Well Halberd stirs rebellion among close attendants and war breaks out;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and enters the Well, streams and rivers are obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: moving retrograde into the Well chokes rivers and streams.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，兵先起者殃，又曰天子以水敗；

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, whoever first raises armies suffers calamity; another reading says the Son of Heaven is defeated by water;
translations.idiomatic: when Mars encroaches upon the Well, whoever strikes first meets disaster—or, by another reading, the Son of Heaven suffers defeat through flood;

sentences.zh: 入守經旬，下有兵，貴人不安；

translations.literal: if it enters and stations for ten days or more, armies arise below and nobles are uneasy;
translations.idiomatic: entering and holding position for ten days or longer raises armies beneath and unsettles the great and noble;

sentences.zh: 守三十日，成勾巳，角動，色赤黑，貴人當之，百川溢，兵起。

translations.literal: if it stations thirty days, forms Gou-si, the horns stir, color red-black, nobles meet calamity, the hundred streams overflow, and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: holding for thirty days and tracing the Gou-si hook, with stirring horns and a red-black hue, brings disaster upon the elite, floods every river, and war breaks out.

sentences.zh: 填星入犯之，兵起東北，大臣憂；

translations.literal: if Saturn enters and transgresses it, armies rise in the northeast and great ministers worry;
translations.idiomatic: when Saturn encroaches upon the Well from within, war erupts in the northeast and anxiety grips the great ministers;

translations.literal: if it enters the Well Halberd, the sovereign finds it ill-omened;
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon the Well Halberd is baleful for the sovereign;

sentences.zh: 在觜而去東井，其下亡地。

translations.literal: if it is at Turtle Beak and departs the eastern Well, below loses territory.
translations.idiomatic: passing through Turtle Beak and leaving the eastern Well brings loss of territory below.

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses it, blame lies with the generals;
translations.idiomatic: when Venus encroaches upon the Well, disaster falls upon the generals;

sentences.zh: 久守，其分君失政，臣爲亂。

translations.literal: if it stations long, in its allotted region the lord loses governance and ministers make disorder.
translations.idiomatic: prolonged holding within its jurisdiction means the lord forfeits good rule and ministers rise in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，星進則兵進，退則兵退，刑法平，又曰北兵起，歲惡。

translations.literal: if Mercury transgresses it, when the star advances armies advance and when it retreats armies retreat, punishments are fair; another reading says northern armies rise and the year is ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: when Mercury encroaches upon the Well, an advancing star brings advancing armies and a retreating star brings retreat; punishments grow equitable—or, by another reading, northern armies mobilize and the year turns malign.

sentences.zh: 芒角、動搖，色赤黑，爲水，爲兵起。

translations.literal: rays and trembling, color red-black, mean flood and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: rays and trembling with a red-black hue portend flood and war alike.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，穀不登，大臣誅，有土功，小兒妖言。

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses it, grain does not ripen, great ministers are executed, there is earthwork, and children speak sinister words.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon the Well brings failed harvests, the execution of great ministers, earthworks, and eerie speech from children.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，民讒言，國失政，一曰大臣誅，其分兵災。

translations.literal: if a comet transgresses it, the people slander and the state loses governance; one reading says great ministers are executed and its allotted region suffers military calamity.
translations.idiomatic: a comet encroaching upon it stirs popular calumny and governmental collapse—or, by one reading, ministers are put to death and its jurisdiction suffers military disaster.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，在春夏則秦地謀叛，在秋冬則宮中有憂。

translations.literal: if a shooting star transgresses it, in spring and summer Qin territory plots rebellion; in autumn and winter there is worry in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: a meteor striking the Well: in spring and summer Qin plots rebellion; in autumn and winter anxiety grips the palace.

translations.literal: The Yisi Divination: if a shooting star's color is yellow and moist, the state is secure;
translations.idiomatic: According to the Yisi Divination: a meteor of yellow, lustrous hue means the realm is at peace;

translations.literal: if red-black, Qin's allotted region sees the people drift and water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: a red-black hue brings a drifting populace in Qin's jurisdiction and flood disaster.

sentences.zh: 蒼黑雲氣入犯之，民有疾疫；

translations.literal: if blue-black cloud qi enters and transgresses it, the people suffer pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: blue-black vapors encroaching upon the Well bring pestilence among the people;

sentences.zh: 黃白潤澤，有客來言水澤事。

translations.literal: if yellow-white and moist lustrous, a guest comes speaking of marshes and waterways.
translations.idiomatic: yellow-white, lustrous clouds mean visitors bearing news of floods and marshes.

translations.literal: if black qi enters, there is great flood.
translations.idiomatic: black vapors entering portend great floods.

sentences.zh: 常以正月朔日入時候之，井宿上有雲，歲多水潦。

translations.literal: one should always at the first day of the first month observe it at the hour of ingress; if there are clouds above the Well Lodge, the year has much flooding.
translations.idiomatic: at the first new moon of the first month, observe the Well at the hour of ingress: clouds above the lodge mean a year of abundant flooding.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，井宿三十度，唐開元遊儀三十三度，去極七十度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Well Lodge is thirty degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gives thirty-three degrees, seventy degrees from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Well measures thirty degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gives thirty-three degrees, seventy degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，亦三十三度，距西北星去極六十九度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey also gives thirty-three degrees; from the northwestern star it is sixty-nine degrees from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: the Jingyou survey likewise records thirty-three degrees, sixty-nine degrees from the pole to the northwestern star.

sentences.zh: 五諸侯五星，在東井北，主斷疑、刺舉、戒不虞、理陰陽、察得失，亦曰主帝心。

translations.literal: The Five Feudal Lords are five stars north of the eastern Well; they govern resolving doubts, impeachment, warning against the unforeseen, regulating yin and yang, and examining gain and loss; it is also said they govern the emperor's heart.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Feudal Lords comprise five stars north of the eastern Well, presiding over judgment of doubts, impeachment, vigilance against the unforeseen, harmony of yin and yang, and scrutiny of right and wrong—and also, it is said, the emperor's inmost mind.

sentences.zh: 一曰帝師，二曰帝友，三曰三公，四曰博士，五曰太史，五者常爲帝定疑議。

translations.literal: the first is called Imperial Tutor, the second Imperial Friend, the third the Three Excellencies, the fourth Erudite, and the fifth Grand Clerk—the five who constantly resolve doubt and deliberation for the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: the first is Imperial Tutor, the second Imperial Friend, the third the Three Excellencies, the fourth Erudite, and the fifth Grand Clerk—the five who regularly resolve the emperor's doubts.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, large, and moist lustrous, the realm is governed.
translations.idiomatic: when they shine bright, large, and lustrous, the realm is well governed.

sentences.zh: 五禮備，則光明，不相侵陵；

translations.literal: if the five rites are complete, they are bright and do not encroach upon one another;
translations.idiomatic: when the five rites are complete they shine forth without encroaching upon one another;

translations.literal: if dim, nobles plot against the sovereign;
translations.idiomatic: dimness means the great plot against their lord;

translations.literal: if rays appear, calamity is at the center.
translations.idiomatic: rays mean calamity at the heart of the realm.

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses them, armies rise for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter's encroachment raises war for three years.

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses them, great ministers rebel but do not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon them brings ministerial rebellion that fails to succeed.

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，諸侯興兵亡國；

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses them, feudal lords raise armies and states perish;
translations.idiomatic: Venus encroaching upon them sets feudal lords to arms and brings kingdoms to ruin;

translations.literal: if it passes through heaven and is visible by day, feudal lords receive execution.
translations.idiomatic: passing through heaven and visible by day means feudal lords are put to death.

sentences.zh: 客星犯，王室亂，諸侯亡地，秦國殃；

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses them, the royal house is in disorder, feudal lords lose territory, and Qin suffers calamity;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star's encroachment throws the royal house into turmoil, strips feudal lords of land, and brings calamity to Qin;

translations.literal: if it stations there, the kin of feudal lords lose position.
translations.idiomatic: holding position there deprives the kin of feudal lords of their stations.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛犯之，執法臣誅，又曰貴臣當之，期一年。

translations.literal: if a comet or broom-star transgresses them, law-enforcing ministers are executed; another reading says noble ministers meet calamity, within one year.
translations.idiomatic: comets and broom-stars encroaching upon them bring execution of law officers—or, by another reading, noble ministers bear the calamity within one year.

sentences.zh: 雲氣犯之，色蒼白，諸侯有喪；

translations.literal: if cloud qi transgresses them and the color is pale blue-white, feudal lords have mourning;
translations.idiomatic: vapors encroaching with a pale hue mean mourning among the feudal lords;

translations.literal: if not, ministers face execution and slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: otherwise ministers face execution.

translations.literal: great floods manifest throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: great floods manifest across the realm.

sentences.zh: 積水一星，在北河西北，所以供酒食之正也。

translations.literal: Accumulated Water is one star northwest of the Northern River; it supplies the correctness of wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated Water is a single star northwest of the Northern River, governing the proper provision of wine and food.

translations.literal: if it is not seen, there is calamity.
translations.idiomatic: when it is invisible, calamity follows.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，水物不成，魚鹽貴，民饑。

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, water products do not mature, fish and salt are dear, and the people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon it spoils aquatic harvests, drives up the price of fish and salt, and brings famine.

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, there are armies and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon it portends war and flood alike.

translations.literal: if Mercury transgresses it, there is flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury encroaching upon it brings both flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，兵起，大水，大臣憂，期一年。

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses it, armies rise, there is great flood, great ministers worry, within one year.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon it raises armies and floods alike, fills great ministers with anxiety, all within one year.

sentences.zh: 蒼白雲氣入犯之，天下有水。

translations.literal: if pale blue-white cloud qi enters and transgresses it, the realm has flooding.
translations.idiomatic: pale vapors encroaching upon it mean flooding throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 積薪一星，在積水東北，供庖廚之正也。

translations.literal: Accumulated Firewood is one star northeast of Accumulated Water; it supplies the correctness of the kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated Firewood is a single star northeast of Accumulated Water, governing the proper provisioning of the royal kitchen.

translations.literal: if the star is not bright, the five grains do not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: when the star dims, the five grains fail to ripen.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，爲旱，爲兵，爲火災。

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, there is drought, armies, and fire disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon it portends drought, war, and conflagration.

translations.literal: if a guest star stations there, firewood is dear.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star holding there drives up the price of firewood.

translations.literal: if red cloud qi enters and transgresses it, there is water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: red vapors encroaching upon it bring flood disaster.

sentences.zh: 南河三星，與北河夾東井，一曰天之關門也，主關梁。

translations.literal: The Southern River has three stars; with the Northern River it flanks the eastern Well; it is also called Heaven's gate bar and governs passes and bridges.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern River comprises three stars flanking the eastern Well together with the Northern River—also called Heaven's Gate—and presides over passes and bridges.

sentences.zh: 南河曰南戍，一曰南宮，一曰陽門，一曰越門，一曰權星，主火。

translations.literal: The Southern River is called the Southern Garrison; it is also called the Southern Palace, the Yang Gate, the Yue Gate, and the Balance Star; it governs fire.
translations.idiomatic: the Southern River is termed the Southern Garrison, also the Southern Palace, the Yang Gate, the Yue Gate, and the Balance Star—it presides over fire.

sentences.zh: 兩河戍間，日、月、五星之常道也。

translations.literal: Between the two river garrisons is the constant path of the sun, moon, and five stars.
translations.idiomatic: between the two river garrisons lies the regular path of sun, moon, and five planets.

translations.literal: if the river garrisons tremble, armies rise in the central states.
translations.idiomatic: when the river garrisons stir, the central states mobilize for war.

translations.literal: if the river stars are not complete, roads are not passable.
translations.idiomatic: when the river stars are incomplete, roads are blocked.

translations.literal: waters overflow widely.
translations.idiomatic: floods spread far and wide.

sentences.zh: 月出入兩河間中道，民安，歲美，無兵；

translations.literal: if the moon exits and enters on the central path between the two rivers, the people are secure, the year is fine, and there are no armies;
translations.idiomatic: when the moon passes the central path between the two rivers, the people are secure, the harvest is ample, and war does not arise;

sentences.zh: 出中道之南，君惡之，大臣不附。

translations.literal: if it exits south of the central path, the sovereign finds it ill-omened and great ministers do not attach.
translations.idiomatic: departing south of the central path bodes ill for the sovereign and sets great ministers at odds with him.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, it is auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: bright stars are auspicious;

sentences.zh: 昏昧動搖，則邊兵起，遠人叛，主憂。

translations.literal: if dim, obscure, and trembling, border armies rise, distant peoples rebel, and the sovereign worries.
translations.idiomatic: dimness and trembling raise border armies, distant peoples rebel, and the sovereign is filled with worry.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，爲中邦憂，一曰爲兵，爲喪，爲旱，爲疫；

translations.literal: if the moon transgresses it, there is worry for the central states; one reading says armies, mourning, drought, and pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: the moon encroaching upon the Southern River brings anxiety to the central states—or, by one reading, war, mourning, drought, and pestilence;

translations.literal: if it travels southwest, there are armies and drought;
translations.idiomatic: moving southwest portends war and drought;

translations.literal: if it enters the Southern Garrison, the people suffer pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: entering the Southern Garrison brings pestilence among the people;

translations.literal: if there is a halo, there are earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: a halo means earthworks;

translations.literal: if it rides upon it, armies rise in the four directions;
translations.idiomatic: occultation raises armies on every side;

translations.literal: if it passes south of the Southern Garrison to the south, punishments fail.
translations.idiomatic: passing south of the Southern Garrison southward means punishments grow unjust.

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, the northern lord worries.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon it brings worry to the ruler of the north.

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses the two rivers, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon both rivers portends war;

translations.literal: if it stations thirty days or more, streams overflow;
translations.idiomatic: holding for thirty days or longer brings rivers overflowing their banks;

translations.literal: if it stations at the Southern River, grain does not ripen and the chief consort worries;
translations.idiomatic: holding at the Southern River means failed harvests and anxiety for the chief consort;

translations.literal: if it stations west of the Southern Garrison, fruit does not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: holding west of the Southern Garrison means fruit fails to ripen;

translations.literal: if in the east, there is attack and battle.
translations.idiomatic: holding to the east brings attack and battle.

translations.literal: if Saturn rides the Southern River, there is drought and the people worry;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn occulting the Southern River portends drought and popular anxiety;

translations.literal: if it stations there, there are armies and roads are not passable.
translations.idiomatic: holding there brings war and blocked roads.

translations.literal: if Venus lodges thirty days, streams overflow;
translations.idiomatic: Venus lodging for thirty days makes rivers overflow;

translations.literal: one reading says there is treacherous plotting;
translations.idiomatic: or, by one reading, treacherous plots arise;

translations.literal: if it stations at the two rivers, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: holding at both rivers raises armies.

translations.literal: if a guest star stations there, there is drought and pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star holding there brings drought and pestilence.

translations.literal: if a comet or broom-star emerges, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: comets and broom-stars appearing portend war;

translations.literal: if it stations, there is drought.
translations.idiomatic: holding position there means drought.

sentences.zh: 流星出，爲兵、喪，邊戍有憂。

translations.literal: if a shooting star emerges, there are armies and mourning and border garrisons have worry.
translations.idiomatic: a meteor emerging portends war and mourning and anxiety along the frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 蒼白雲氣入之，河道不通；

translations.literal: if pale blue-white cloud qi enters, river routes are not passable;
translations.idiomatic: pale vapors entering choke the waterways;

sentences.zh: 出而色赤，天子兵向諸侯。

translations.literal: if it emerges and the color is red, the Son of Heaven's armies advance against the feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: emerging red, the Son of Heaven's armies advance against the feudal lords.

translations.literal: if yellow qi enters, there are virtuous decrees;
translations.idiomatic: yellow vapors entering mean virtuous edicts are issued;

translations.literal: if it emerges, there is calamity.
translations.idiomatic: emerging brings calamity.

sentences.zh: 北河亦三星，北河曰北戍，一曰北宮，一曰陰門，一曰胡門，一曰衡星，主水。

translations.literal: The Northern River also has three stars; the Northern River is called the Northern Garrison; it is also called the Northern Palace, the Yin Gate, the Hu Gate, and the Balance Star; it governs water.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern River likewise comprises three stars—the Northern Garrison, also the Northern Palace, the Yin Gate, the Hu Gate, and the Balance Star—and presides over water.

sentences.zh: 五星出、入、留、守之，爲兵起；

translations.literal: if the five stars exit, enter, linger, or station there, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when the five planets exit, enter, linger, or hold there, armies rise;

translations.literal: if they transgress it, there is mourning for women;
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon the Northern River brings mourning for women;

translations.literal: if they ride upon it, the northern lord worries.
translations.idiomatic: occulting it brings worry to the ruler of the north.

translations.literal: if Jupiter enters the Northern Garrison, great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter entering the Northern Garrison brings execution of great ministers.

sentences.zh: 熒惑從西入北戍，六十日有喪；

translations.literal: if Mars enters the Northern Garrison from the west, within sixty days there is mourning;
translations.idiomatic: Mars entering the Northern Garrison from the west brings mourning within sixty days;

translations.literal: if it enters from the east, within ninety days there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: entering from the east brings armies within ninety days;

sentences.zh: 一曰出北戍北守之，邊將有不請於上而用兵外國者勝。

translations.literal: one reading says if it exits north of the Northern Garrison and stations there, border generals who do not request from above but use armies against foreign states prevail.
translations.idiomatic: or, by one reading, when it exits north of the Northern Garrison and holds there, frontier generals who act without imperial sanction yet campaign abroad will prevail.

sentences.zh: 填星守之，兵起，六十日內有赦，一曰有土功；

translations.literal: if Saturn stations there, armies rise; within sixty days there is an amnesty; one reading says there are earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn holding there raises armies and brings an amnesty within sixty days—or, by one reading, earthworks;

translations.literal: if it stations west of the garrison, the five grains do not fill out.
translations.idiomatic: holding west of the garrison means the five grains fail to fill out.

sentences.zh: 太白舍北戍，三十日爲女喪，有內謀；

translations.literal: if Venus lodges at the Northern Garrison thirty days, there is mourning for women and internal plotting;
translations.idiomatic: Venus lodging at the Northern Garrison for thirty days brings mourning for women and internal conspiracy;

sentences.zh: 守陰門，不出百日天下兵悉起。

translations.literal: if it stations at the Yin Gate, within one hundred days armies throughout the realm all rise.
translations.idiomatic: holding at the Yin Gate means within a hundred days war erupts everywhere under heaven.

sentences.zh: 辰星守之，外兵起，邊臣有謀；

translations.literal: if Mercury stations there, external armies rise and border officials plot;
translations.idiomatic: Mercury holding there raises armies abroad and plots among frontier officials;

translations.literal: if it lingers and stops, armies rise in the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: lingering there raises armies on every side.

sentences.zh: 客星入犯之，有喪於外，奸人在中；

translations.literal: if a guest star enters and transgresses it, there is mourning outside and treacherous persons within;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering and encroaching upon it brings mourning abroad and traitors at court;

translations.literal: if it enters from the east, armies rise, within ninety days;
translations.idiomatic: entering from the east raises armies within ninety days;

translations.literal: if it enters from the west, there is mourning, within sixty days;
translations.idiomatic: entering from the west brings mourning within sixty days;

translations.literal: if it stations there, there is great flood.
translations.idiomatic: holding there brings great flood.

sentences.zh: 流星經兩河間，天下有難；

translations.literal: if a meteor passes between the Two Rivers, trouble arises under heaven;
translations.idiomatic: a meteor crossing the space between the Two Rivers foretells trouble throughout the realm;

sentences.zh: 入，爲北兵入中國，關梁不通。

translations.literal: if it enters, northern armies enter China, passes and bridges are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: entering means northern armies invade the Central Realm and passes and bridges are cut off.

sentences.zh: 雲氣蒼白入犯之，邊有兵，疾疫，又爲北主憂。

translations.literal: if pale white cloud vapors enter and transgress it, there are armies at the border, pestilence, and also worry for the northern lord.
translations.idiomatic: pale white vapors entering and encroaching upon it bring border warfare, pestilence, and anxiety for the ruler of the north.

sentences.zh: 四瀆四星，在東井南垣之東，江、河、淮、濟之精也。

translations.literal: The Four Streams are four stars east of the southern wall of the eastern Well—the essences of the Yangtze, Yellow River, Huai, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The Four Streams comprise four stars east of the southern rampart of the eastern Well—the spiritual essences of the Yangtze, Yellow River, Huai, and Ji.

translations.literal: if bright and large, the hundred streams burst their banks.
translations.idiomatic: when they shine bright and large, rivers everywhere break their banks.

sentences.zh: 水位四星，在積薪東，一曰在東井東北，主水衡。

translations.literal: Water Level has four stars east of Accumulated Firewood; one reading places them northeast of the eastern Well; they govern the water commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Water Level comprises four stars east of Accumulated Firewood—or, by one reading, northeast of the eastern Well—and presides over the office of water regulation.

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses them, there is great flood;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon them brings great flood;

translations.literal: one reading says if it exits south, there is drought.
translations.idiomatic: or, by one reading, exiting south brings drought.

translations.literal: if Mars stations there, fields are not cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: Mars holding there leaves the fields untilled.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，水道不通，伏兵在水中；

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses them, waterways are blocked and hidden soldiers are in the water;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon them blocks the waterways and sets ambush troops upon the waters;

sentences.zh: 一曰客星若水、火，守犯之，百川流溢。

translations.literal: one reading says if the guest star is like water or fire and stations or transgresses them, the hundred streams overflow.
translations.idiomatic: or, by one reading, when the guest star resembles water or fire and holds or encroaches upon them, rivers everywhere spill over their banks.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛出，爲大水，爲兵，穀不成。

translations.literal: if a comet or broom star appears, there is great flood, armies, and grain does not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: the appearance of a comet or broom star brings flood, war, and failed harvests.

sentences.zh: 流星入之，天下有水，穀敗民饑。

translations.literal: if a meteor enters them, the realm has floodwater, grain spoils, and the people hunger.
translations.idiomatic: a meteor entering them floods the realm, spoils the grain, and leaves the people starving.

translations.literal: if red vapors enter, there is drought and famine.
translations.idiomatic: red vapors entering bring drought and famine.

sentences.zh: 天樽三星，在五諸侯南，一曰在東井北，樽，器也，主盛饘粥，以給貧餒。

translations.literal: Heavenly Jar has three stars south of the Five Feudal Lords; one reading places them north of the eastern Well; the jar is a vessel governing the provision of thick gruel to supply the poor and hungry.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Jar comprises three stars south of the Five Feudal Lords—or, by one reading, north of the eastern Well. The jar is a vessel presiding over the serving of thick gruel to relieve poverty and hunger.

translations.literal: if bright, abundance;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, abundance;

translations.literal: if dim, the year is bad.
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the harvest year is poor.

sentences.zh: 闕丘二星，在南河南，天子雙闕，諸侯兩觀也。

translations.literal: Que Hill has two stars south of the Southern River—the Son of Heaven's paired gate towers, the feudal lords' paired watchtowers.
translations.idiomatic: Que Hill comprises two stars south of the Southern River—the Son of Heaven's twin gate towers and the feudal lords' paired watchtowers.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守之，兵戰闕下。

translations.literal: if Venus or Mars station there, armies battle below the gate towers.
translations.idiomatic: Venus or Mars holding there brings battle beneath the gate towers.

sentences.zh: 軍市十三星，狀如天錢，天軍貿易之市，有無相通也。

translations.literal: Army Market has thirteen stars shaped like heaven's coins—the heavenly army's trading market where having and lacking are exchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Army Market comprises thirteen stars shaped like heaven's coins—the celestial army's marketplace where surplus and want are bartered.

translations.literal: if the central stars are numerous, the army has surplus grain;
translations.idiomatic: when the central stars are abundant, the army has surplus provisions;

translations.literal: if small, the army hungers.
translations.idiomatic: when they are faint, the army goes hungry.

translations.literal: if the moon enters, armies rise and the ruler is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: the moon entering raises armies and unsettles the sovereign.

translations.literal: if the five planets station there, army provisions are cut off.
translations.idiomatic: the five planets holding there cut off army supplies.

sentences.zh: 客星入，則有刺客起，將離卒亡。

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, assassins arise, generals depart, and soldiers perish.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering raises assassins, drives generals away, and costs the army its men.

translations.literal: if a meteor exits, a great general goes forth.
translations.idiomatic: a meteor departing means a great general takes the field.

sentences.zh: 野雞一星，在軍市中，主變怪。

translations.literal: Wild Chicken is one star in the Army Market, governing strange transformations.
translations.idiomatic: Wild Chicken is a single star within Army Market, presiding over uncanny transformations.

translations.literal: if it exits outside the market, armies rise under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: leaving the market brings war throughout the realm.

translations.literal: if it holds still and is tranquil, auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: holding still in tranquility is auspicious;

translations.literal: if it has rays and horns, inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: rays and horns are inauspicious.

sentences.zh: 狼一星，在東井東南，爲野將，主侵掠。

translations.literal: Wolf is one star southeast of the eastern Well, a commander in the field governing invasion and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf is a single star southeast of the eastern Well—a field commander presiding over invasion and plunder.

translations.literal: its color should be constant; it should not move.
translations.idiomatic: its color should remain steady; it ought not to stir.

translations.literal: if it has rays and horns and sways, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: rays, horns, and trembling raise armies;

translations.literal: if bright and flourishing, weapons are costly;
translations.idiomatic: when bright and resplendent, weapons grow costly;

translations.literal: if it shifts position, people eat one another;
translations.idiomatic: shifting position drives people to cannibalism;

translations.literal: yellow-white color is inauspicious;
translations.idiomatic: a yellow-white hue is ill-omened;

translations.literal: red means armies.
translations.idiomatic: red portends war.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，有兵不戰，一曰有水事。

translations.literal: if the moon transgresses it, there are armies but no battle; one reading says there are water affairs.
translations.idiomatic: the moon encroaching upon it brings armies that do not fight—or, by one reading, flood affairs.

translations.literal: if the moon is eclipsed at the Wolf, foreign states plot.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse at the Wolf means foreign powers are plotting.

translations.literal: if the five planets transgress it, armies rise greatly and bandits are many.
translations.idiomatic: the five planets encroaching upon it raise great armies and widespread banditry.

translations.literal: if a comet or broom star transgresses it, bandits rise.
translations.idiomatic: a comet or broom star encroaching upon it stirs up bandits.

translations.literal: if a guest star stations there and the color is yellow and moist, joy;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star holding there with a yellow, lustrous hue brings joy;

translations.literal: if black, there is worry.
translations.idiomatic: black brings anxiety.

translations.literal: if red vapors enter, there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: red vapors entering bring war.

sentences.zh: 弧矢九星，在狼星東南，天弓也，主行陰謀以備盜，常屬矢以向狼。

translations.literal: Bow and Arrows has nine stars southeast of the Wolf Star—Heaven's bow, governing covert schemes against bandits; the arrows are always attached pointing toward the Wolf.
translations.idiomatic: Bow and Arrows comprises nine stars southeast of the Wolf—Heaven's bow, which presides over covert stratagems against robbers; its arrows are always strung toward the Wolf.

sentences.zh: 武密曰：「天弓張，則北兵起。」

translations.literal: Wumu says: "When Heaven's bow is drawn, northern armies rise."
translations.idiomatic: Wumu says: "When Heaven's bow is drawn, northern armies rise."

translations.literal: It also says: "Armies fill all under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Armies fill all under heaven."

translations.literal: If it sways and is bright and large, bandits are many;
translations.idiomatic: When it trembles and shines large, bandits multiply;

translations.literal: if the arrows do not point straight at the Wolf, bandits are many;
translations.idiomatic: when the arrows do not aim straight at the Wolf, bandits abound;

translations.literal: if fully drawn, all under heaven become bandits.
translations.idiomatic: drawn to the full, the whole realm turns to banditry.

translations.literal: if the moon enters Bow and Arrows, ministers surpass their lord.
translations.idiomatic: the moon entering Bow and Arrows means ministers overstep their sovereign.

translations.literal: if the moon halos its lodge, armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: a halo around the moon at this lodge raises armies on a great scale.

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, southern barbarians come to surrender;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering brings the southern tribes to submit;

sentences.zh: 若舍，其分秋雨雪，穀不成；

translations.literal: if it lodges there, that allotted region has autumn rain and snow, and grain does not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges there, that jurisdiction suffers autumn rain and snow and the grain fails;

translations.literal: if it stations there, outer barbarians hunger;
translations.idiomatic: holding there brings famine among the outer tribes;

translations.literal: if it enters and exits, armies enter and exit.
translations.idiomatic: entering and leaving means armies march in and out.

sentences.zh: 流星入，北兵起，屠城殺將。

translations.literal: if a meteor enters, northern armies rise, cities are slaughtered, and generals are killed.
translations.idiomatic: a meteor entering raises northern armies, sacks cities, and kills generals.

sentences.zh: 赤雲氣入之，民驚，一曰北兵入中國。

translations.literal: if red vapors enter them, the people are alarmed; one reading says northern armies enter China.
translations.idiomatic: red vapors entering alarm the people—or, by one reading, northern armies invade the Central Realm.

sentences.zh: 老人一星，在孤矢南，一名南極。

translations.literal: Old Man is one star south of Bow and Arrows, also called the South Pole.
translations.idiomatic: Old Man is a single star south of Bow and Arrows, also known as the South Pole.

sentences.zh: 常以秋分之旦見於丙，候之南郊，春分之夕沒于丁。

translations.literal: it regularly appears at dawn on the autumn equinox in the bing direction, observed at the southern suburb, and sets at dusk on the spring equinox in the ding direction.
translations.idiomatic: it regularly appears at dawn on the autumn equinox in the bing quarter, where it is observed at the southern suburb, and sets at dusk on the spring equinox in the ding quarter.

translations.literal: when visible, governance is peaceful and the Son of Heaven enjoys long life and prosperity;
translations.idiomatic: when it appears, rule is tranquil and the Son of Heaven enjoys long life and flourishing reign;

translations.literal: when not visible, armies rise, the year is barren, and the ruler worries.
translations.idiomatic: when it vanishes, armies rise, harvests fail, and the sovereign is troubled.

sentences.zh: 客星入，爲民疫，一曰兵起，老者憂。

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, there is pestilence among the people; one reading says armies rise and the aged worry.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering brings pestilence among the people—or, by one reading, war and anxiety for the elderly.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，老人多疾，一曰兵起。

translations.literal: if a meteor transgresses it, the aged fall ill; one reading says armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: a meteor encroaching upon it sickens the elderly—or, by one reading, raises armies.

translations.literal: if white cloud vapors enter it, the state faces extinction.
translations.idiomatic: white vapors entering portend the state's extinction.

sentences.zh: 丈人二星，在軍市西南，主壽考，悼耄矜寡，以哀窮人。

translations.literal: The Elder has two stars southwest of Army Market, governing longevity, mourning the aged and pitying widows and orphans, grieving for the poor.
translations.idiomatic: The Elder comprises two stars southwest of Army Market, presiding over long life, mourning the very old, pitying widows and orphans, and grieving for the destitute.

translations.literal: if the star vanishes, ministers cannot gain access on their own.
translations.idiomatic: when the star disappears, officials cannot reach the throne of their own accord.

sentences.zh: 子二星，在丈人東，主侍丈人則。

translations.literal: The Son has two stars east of the Elder, governing attendance at the Elder's side.
translations.idiomatic: The Son comprises two stars east of the Elder, presiding over attendance at the Elder's side.

translations.literal: if not visible, there is calamity.
translations.idiomatic: when it is not seen, calamity follows.

sentences.zh: 孫二星，在子星東，以天孫侍丈人側，相扶而居以孝慈。

translations.literal: The Grandson has two stars east of the Son; as Heaven's Grandson he attends at the Elder's side, supporting and dwelling together in filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: The Grandson comprises two stars east of the Son; as Heaven's Grandson he waits at the Elder's side, supporting him and dwelling together in filial devotion.

translations.literal: if not visible, there is calamity;
translations.idiomatic: when it is not seen, calamity follows;

translations.literal: if it holds its place, there is no blame.
translations.idiomatic: holding its place brings no harm.

sentences.zh: 水府四星，在東井西南，水官也，主堤塘、道路、梁溝，以設堤防之備。

translations.literal: Water Office has four stars southwest of the eastern Well—the water official governing dikes, ponds, roads, bridges, and ditches, establishing preparations for flood control.
translations.idiomatic: Water Office comprises four stars southwest of the eastern Well—the office of water, presiding over dikes, ponds, roads, bridges, and canals and setting defenses against flood.

translations.literal: if Mars enters them, there are plotting ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entering them brings scheming ministers.

translations.literal: if Mercury enters, there is water [disaster].
translations.idiomatic: Mercury entering brings flood.

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, great flood under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering floods the realm.

sentences.zh: 流星入，色青，所主之邑大水；

translations.literal: if a meteor enters, color azure—the governed district has great flood;
translations.idiomatic: a meteor entering with an azure hue floods the district under its jurisdiction;

translations.literal: red means drought.
translations.idiomatic: red portends drought.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》自五諸侯至水府常星一十八坐，俱屬東井。

translations.literal: According to the Pace of Heaven song, from the Five Feudal Lords to Water Office, eighteen fixed star seats all belong to the eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Pace of Heaven song, the eighteen fixed seats from the Five Feudal Lords through Water Office all belong to the eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 武密書以丈人二星、子、孫各一星屬牛宿。

translations.literal: Wumu's book assigns the two Elder stars, the Son, and the Grandson (one star each) to the Ox lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Wumu's treatise assigns the two Elder stars and one star each of the Son and Grandson to the Ox lodge.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以丈人與子屬參、孫屬井；

translations.literal: The New Book of the Qian Image assigns the Elder and Son to Shen and the Grandson to Jing;
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of the Qian Image assigns the Elder and Son to Shen and the Grandson to Jing;

translations.literal: it also assigns the four Water Office stars to Shen.
translations.idiomatic: it also assigns the four Water Office stars to Shen.

translations.literal: Wumu assigns Water Office to Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Wumu assigns Water Office to Jing.

translations.literal: the remainder all agree with the Pace of Heaven song.
translations.idiomatic: all the rest accord with the Pace of Heaven song.

sentences.zh: 輿鬼五星，主觀察奸謀，天目也。

translations.literal: Chariot Ghost has five stars, governing observation of treacherous plots—the celestial eye.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot Ghost comprises five stars that watch for treacherous designs—it is the celestial eye.

sentences.zh: 東北星主積馬，東南星主積兵，西南星主積布帛，西北星主積金玉，隨變占之。

translations.literal: the northeast star governs accumulated horses, the southeast accumulated armies, the southwest accumulated silks and cloth, the northwest accumulated gold and jade—read according to changes.
translations.idiomatic: the northeast star presides over stockpiled horses, the southeast over stockpiled troops, the southwest over stockpiled silks, the northwest over stockpiled gold and jade—omens are read according to their changes.

sentences.zh: 中央星爲積屍，主死喪祠祀；

translations.literal: the central star is Accumulated Corpses, governing death, mourning, and sacrifice;
translations.idiomatic: the central star is Accumulated Corpses, presiding over death, mourning, and rites of sacrifice;

translations.literal: one reading says it is the axe and halberd, governing execution.
translations.idiomatic: or, by one reading, it is the axe-halberd, governing execution and decapitation.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright and large, grain does not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright and large, the grain fails;

translations.literal: if not bright, the people scatter.
translations.idiomatic: when they are dim, the people disperse.

sentences.zh: 鑕欲其忽忽不明，明則兵起，大臣誅；

translations.literal: the halberd should be hazy and indistinct; if bright, armies rise and great ministers are executed;
translations.idiomatic: the halberd ought to remain faint and obscure; brightness raises armies and brings the execution of great ministers;

sentences.zh: 動而光，賦重役煩，民懷嗟怨。

translations.literal: if it stirs and shines, taxes and corvée are heavy, and the people harbor sighs of resentment.
translations.idiomatic: stirring and shining means heavy levies and onerous labor service, and the people nurse bitter complaint.

sentences.zh: 日食，國不安，有大喪，貴人憂。

translations.literal: solar eclipse: the state is unsettled, there is great mourning, and nobles worry.
translations.idiomatic: a solar eclipse unsettles the state, brings great mourning, and troubles the nobility.

sentences.zh: 暈，則其分有兵，大臣有誅廢者。

translations.literal: halo: that allotted region has armies, and great ministers are executed or deposed.
translations.idiomatic: a halo means war in its jurisdiction and the execution or deposition of great ministers.

sentences.zh: 月食，貴臣、皇后憂，期一年。

translations.literal: lunar eclipse: noble ministers and the empress worry, term one year.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse brings anxiety to noble ministers and the empress within the year.

translations.literal: halo: drought and amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: a halo portends drought and an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，秦分君憂，一曰軍將死，貴臣、女主憂，民疫。

translations.literal: if the moon transgresses it, the ruler of the Qin allotment worries; one reading says army generals die, noble ministers and the empress dowager worry, and the people suffer pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: the moon encroaching upon it troubles the lord of the Qin region—or, by one reading, kills army generals, alarms noble ministers and the empress dowager, and brings pestilence among the people.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，穀傷民饑，君不聽事；

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, grain is damaged, the people hunger, and the ruler does not attend to affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon it damages the harvest, starves the people, and leaves the ruler neglectful of state affairs;

translations.literal: transgressing the Ghost's halberd: the minister of justice is executed.
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon the Ghost's halberd brings the execution of the minister charged with punishment.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，忠臣誅，一曰兵起，後失勢；

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, loyal ministers are executed; one reading says armies rise and the empress loses influence;
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon it brings the execution of loyal ministers—or, by one reading, raises armies and strips the empress of her power;

sentences.zh: 入，則後及相憂，一曰賊在君側，有兵、喪；

translations.literal: if it enters, the empress and chancellor worry; one reading says bandits are at the ruler's side, with armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters, the empress and chancellor are troubled—or, by one reading, bandits lurk beside the throne, and war and mourning follow;

translations.literal: Gou-si: the state has an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: tracing the Gou-si hook brings an amnesty to the realm;

translations.literal: if it stations ten days, feudal lords meet calamity;
translations.idiomatic: holding position for ten days means feudal lords bear the omen;

translations.literal: twenty days: the heir apparent meets calamity;
translations.idiomatic: twenty days means the heir apparent bears it;

translations.literal: Gou-si encirclement: the Son of Heaven loses his ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: looping the Gou-si hook means the Son of Heaven loses his ancestral temple.

translations.literal: if Saturn transgresses it, great ministers and the empress dowager worry;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn encroaching upon it troubles great ministers and the empress dowager;

sentences.zh: 守之，憂在後宮，爲旱，爲土功；

translations.literal: if it stations there, anxiety is in the inner palace, with drought and earthen works;
translations.idiomatic: holding there brings anxiety to the inner palace, drought, and great earthen works;

translations.literal: if it enters the halberd, the king faces ill omen;
translations.idiomatic: entering the halberd bodes ill for the king;

sentences.zh: 犯積屍，在陽爲君，在陰爲後，在爲太子，右爲貴臣，隨所守惡之。

translations.literal: transgressing Accumulated Corpses: in the yang sector is the ruler, in yin the empress, in the center the heir apparent, on the right noble ministers—calamity follows whichever part it holds.
translations.idiomatic: encroaching upon Accumulated Corpses: the yang sector signifies the ruler, the yin the empress, the center the heir apparent, the right noble ministers—whichever part it holds, that party suffers the omen.

sentences.zh: 太白入犯之，爲兵，亂臣在內，一曰將有誅；

translations.literal: if Venus enters and transgresses it, there are armies, rebellious ministers within; one reading says generals face execution;
translations.idiomatic: Venus entering and encroaching upon it brings war and treacherous ministers within the court—or, by one reading, the execution of generals;

translations.literal: if it pierces through in wrath, below are rebellious ministers;
translations.idiomatic: piercing through it in fury means rebellious ministers below;

sentences.zh: 久守之，下有兵，爲旱，爲火，萬物不成。

translations.literal: if it stations long, below are armies, drought, fire, and the myriad things do not mature.
translations.idiomatic: a long station brings armies below, drought, fire, and the failure of all growing things.

translations.literal: if Mercury transgresses it, the five grains do not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: Mercury encroaching upon it prevents the five grains from ripening;

translations.literal: if it stations: mourning; anxiety among the nobility.
translations.idiomatic: holding position portends mourning and trouble for the nobility.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，國有自立者敗，一曰多土功；

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses it, those who declare themselves rulers within the state are defeated; one reading says many earthen works;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon it defeats those who set themselves up as rulers within the state—or, by one reading, brings many earthen works;

translations.literal: if it enters: curses, oaths, sacrifices, and ghostly rites.
translations.idiomatic: entering brings curses, sworn oaths, sacrifices, and dealings with ghosts.

translations.literal: if a comet transgresses it, armies rise and the state is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: a comet encroaching upon it raises armies and unsettles the realm.

sentences.zh: 星孛，其下有喪，兵起，宜修德禳之。

translations.literal: a broom star: mourning below, armies rise; virtue should be cultivated to avert it.
translations.idiomatic: a broom star brings mourning below and raises armies; virtue ought to be cultivated to avert the omen.

translations.literal: if a meteor transgresses the Ghost's halberd, there are those executed by blade;
translations.idiomatic: a meteor striking the Ghost's halberd means deaths by execution;
