translations.literal: if it enters, the four quarters come bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: entering means the four quarters come bearing tribute.

translations.literal: if white cloud vapor enters, there is pestilence;
translations.idiomatic: white cloud vapor entering brings pestilence;

translations.literal: black: the empress has anxiety;
translations.idiomatic: black portends anxiety for the empress;

translations.literal: red: drought;
translations.idiomatic: red means drought;

translations.literal: yellow: earthen works;
translations.idiomatic: yellow means earthen works;

translations.literal: if it enters and transgresses Accumulated Corpses, noble ministers worry;
translations.idiomatic: entering and encroaching upon Accumulated Corpses troubles noble ministers;

translations.literal: green: disease.
translations.idiomatic: green portends disease.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，輿鬼四度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, Chariot Ghost spans four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, Chariot Ghost spans four degrees.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was sixty-eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly its distance from the celestial pole was sixty-eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，輿鬼三度，距西南星去極六十八度。

translations.literal: Jingyou surveying: Chariot Ghost three degrees; from the southwest star to the pole, sixty-eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey found Chariot Ghost at three degrees, with the southwest star sixty-eight degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 爟四星，在鬼宿西北，一曰在軒轅西，主烽火，備邊亭之警急。

translations.literal: Beacon four stars, northwest of the Ghost Lodge—or west of Chariot Hub—govern beacon fires, guarding frontier posts in emergency.
translations.idiomatic: The Beacon asterism of four stars lies northwest of the Ghost Lodge—or, by one account, west of Chariot Hub—and presides over beacon fires that guard frontier posts in times of alarm.

sentences.zh: 以不明爲安，明大則邊有警。

translations.literal: Dimness means peace; bright and large means alarm on the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Dimness betokens peace; brightness and size betoken frontier alarm.

sentences.zh: 赤雲氣入，天下烽火皆動。

translations.literal: If red cloud vapor enters, beacon fires throughout the realm all flare.
translations.idiomatic: Red cloud vapor entering sets every beacon fire in the realm ablaze.

sentences.zh: 天狗七星，在狼星北，主守財。

translations.literal: Celestial Dog seven stars, north of the Wolf Star, govern guarding wealth.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Dog comprises seven stars north of the Wolf Star and presides over the guarding of wealth.

sentences.zh: 動移，爲兵，爲饑，多寇盜，有亂兵。

translations.literal: If they shift: armies, famine, many bandits, and rebellious troops.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting brings war, famine, many bandits, and mutinous armies.

translations.literal: If Saturn stations there, men eat one another.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn holding there drives men to devour one another.

translations.literal: If a guest star or comet stations there, bands of robbers arise.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star or comet holding there raises bands of robbers.

sentences.zh: 外廚六星，爲天子之外廚，主烹宰，以供宗廟。

translations.literal: Outer Kitchen six stars are the Son of Heaven's outer kitchen, governing boiling and slaughter to supply the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Outer Kitchen comprises six stars—the Son of Heaven's outer kitchen—presiding over boiling and slaughter for the ancestral temple.

translations.literal: Its readings are the same as the Celestial Kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: Its omens match those of the Celestial Kitchen.

sentences.zh: 積屍氣一星，在鬼宿中，孛孛然入鬼一度半，去極六十九度，在赤道內二十二度，主死喪祠祀。

translations.literal: Accumulated Corpses nebula one star, within the Ghost Lodge, comet-like entering Ghost by one and a half degrees, sixty-nine from the pole, twenty-two within the equator, governing death, mourning, and sacrificial rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Accumulated Corpses nebula is a single star within the Ghost Lodge, comet-like and entering Ghost by one and a half degrees, sixty-nine degrees from the pole and twenty-two within the equator; it presides over death, mourning, and sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 天紀一星，在外廚南，主禽獸之齒。

translations.literal: Celestial Pivot one star, south of the Outer Kitchen, governs the teeth of birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Pivot is a single star south of the Outer Kitchen and presides over the teeth of birds and beasts.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守犯之，禽獸死，民不安。

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars station and transgress it, birds and beasts die and the people are unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mars holding or encroaching upon it kill birds and beasts and unsettle the people.

translations.literal: If a guest star stations there, government collapses.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star holding there brings the collapse of government.

translations.literal: Celestial Altars six stars, south of Bow and Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Altars comprise six stars south of Bow and Arrow.

sentences.zh: 昔共工氏之勾龍能平水土，故祀之以配社，其精上爲星。

translations.literal: Formerly Gonggong's minister Goulong could level water and earth, so he was sacrificed to as counterpart to the earth altar; his essence rose to become stars.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity Goulong, minister of the Gonggong clan, could tame flood and earth; he was therefore sacrificed to as counterpart to the earth altar, and his essence ascended to become these stars.

translations.literal: if bright, the altars of soil and grain are secure;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, the altars of state are secure;

translations.literal: if dim or shaking, subordinates plot against superiors.
translations.idiomatic: when dim or unsteady, subordinates plot against their superiors.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑犯之，社稷不安。

translations.literal: If Venus and Mars transgress them, the altars of state are unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Venus and Mars encroaching upon them unsettle the altars of state.

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, there are sacrificial affairs within the state;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering brings sacrificial rites within the realm;

translations.literal: if it exits, there are sacrificial affairs outside the state.
translations.idiomatic: exiting brings sacrificial rites beyond the borders.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》，爟四星屬天市垣，天狗七星在七星北。

translations.literal: According to the Jin Annals, Beacon four stars belong to the Celestial Market Enclosure; Celestial Dog seven stars are north of the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Jin Annals, the four Beacon stars belong to the Celestial Market Enclosure, and the seven Celestial Dog stars lie north of the Seven Stars lodge.

sentences.zh: 武密以天狗屬牛宿，又屬輿鬼，《乾象新書》屬井。

translations.literal: Wumi assigned Celestial Dog to the Ox Lodge and also to Chariot Ghost; the New Book of Hexagram Heaven assigns it to Well.
translations.idiomatic: Wumi assigned the Celestial Dog to the Ox Lodge and also to Chariot Ghost, while the New Book of Hexagram Heaven assigns it to Well.

sentences.zh: 外廚六星，《晉志》在柳宿南，武密書亦屬柳，《乾象新書》與《步天歌》皆屬輿鬼。

translations.literal: Outer Kitchen six stars: the Jin Annals places them south of Willow Lodge; Wumi's text also assigns Willow; the New Book of Hexagram Heaven and Steps through Heaven both assign Chariot Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: The Outer Kitchen's six stars: the Jin Annals places them south of Willow Lodge, Wumi's text likewise assigns Willow, and both the New Book of Hexagram Heaven and Steps through Heaven assign them to Chariot Ghost.

sentences.zh: 天紀一星，武密書及《乾象新書》皆屬柳，惟《步天歌》屬鬼宿。

translations.literal: Celestial Pivot one star: Wumi's text and the New Book of Hexagram Heaven both assign Willow; only Steps through Heaven assigns the Ghost Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Pivot: Wumi's text and the New Book of Hexagram Heaven both assign it to Willow, while only Steps through Heaven assigns it to the Ghost Lodge.

sentences.zh: 天社六星，武密書屬井，又屬鬼。

translations.literal: Celestial Altars six stars: Wumi's text assigns Well and also Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Altars: Wumi's text assigns them to Well and also to Ghost.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以西一星屬井，中一星屬鬼，末一星屬柳。

translations.literal: The New Book of Hexagram Heaven assigns the western star to Well, the middle to Ghost, and the eastern to Willow.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Hexagram Heaven assigns the western star to Well, the middle star to Ghost, and the eastern star to Willow.

sentences.zh: 今從《步天歌》，以諸星俱屬輿鬼，而備存衆說。

translations.literal: Now following Steps through Heaven, all stars are assigned to Chariot Ghost, while preserving the various traditions.
translations.idiomatic: The present text follows Steps through Heaven in assigning all these stars to Chariot Ghost, while preserving the various alternate traditions.

sentences.zh: 柳宿八星，天之廚宰也，主尚食，和滋味，又主雷雨。

translations.literal: Willow Lodge eight stars are Heaven's kitchen steward, governing royal food, harmonizing flavors, and also thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: The Willow Lodge comprises eight stars—Heaven's kitchen steward—presiding over royal cuisine, the blending of flavors, and thunder and rain alike.

translations.literal: The Erya says: "The beak is called willow.
translations.idiomatic: The Erya says: "The beak is called willow.

translations.literal: Willow is the Quail Fire asterism."
translations.idiomatic: Willow is the Quail Fire asterism."

translations.literal: It also governs woodwork.
translations.idiomatic: It also presides over woodwork.

sentences.zh: 一曰天庫，又爲鳥喙，主草木。

translations.literal: One name is Celestial Storehouse; it is also the bird's beak, governing grasses and trees.
translations.idiomatic: It is also called the Celestial Storehouse and the bird's beak, and presides over grasses and trees.

sentences.zh: 明，則大臣謹重，國家廚食具；

translations.literal: if bright, great ministers are prudent and the state's kitchens are provisioned;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, ministers are prudent and the state kitchens are well provisioned;

translations.literal: if spread open, people starve to death;
translations.idiomatic: when spread open, people starve;

translations.literal: if lost, capitals tremble;
translations.idiomatic: when lost, the capitals are shaken;

translations.literal: if straight, there is war.
translations.idiomatic: when straight, war follows.

sentences.zh: 日食，宮室不安，王者惡之，廚官、橋道、堤防有憂。

translations.literal: solar eclipse: palaces are unsettled, the king faces ill omen, and kitchen officials, bridges, roads, and dikes are anxious.
translations.idiomatic: a solar eclipse unsettles the palaces, bodes ill for the king, and troubles kitchen officials, bridges, roads, and dikes alike.

sentences.zh: 日暈，飛鳥多死，五穀不成；

translations.literal: solar halo: many birds die and the five grains do not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: a solar halo kills many birds and prevents the five grains from ripening;

translations.literal: if it triple-embraces and crowns, the ruler has joy.
translations.idiomatic: a triple embrace crowned above brings joy to the ruler.

translations.literal: lunar eclipse: palaces are unsettled and great ministers worry.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse unsettles the palaces and troubles great ministers.

sentences.zh: 月暈，林苑有兵，天下有土功，廚獄官憂，又爲兵，爲饑，爲旱、疫。

translations.literal: lunar halo: armies in parks and gardens, earthen works throughout the realm, anxiety for kitchen and prison officials; also armies, famine, drought, and pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar halo brings war to the royal parks, earthen works across the land, and anxiety to kitchen and prison officials; it also portends war, famine, drought, and pestilence.

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, the state has many righteous armies.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon it fills the realm with righteous armies.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，色赤而芒角，其下君死，一曰宮中憂火災；

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, red in color with horned rays, below the ruler dies; one reading says anxiety for fire in the palace;
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon it, red and horned, means the ruler below dies—or, by one reading, fire in the palace;

translations.literal: if it stations there, there are armies and traitorous ministers at the ruler's side;
translations.idiomatic: holding there brings armies and traitors at the ruler's side;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and stations there, the king is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: moving retrograde and holding there leaves the king unsettled.

sentences.zh: 填星犯守，君臣和，天下喜；

translations.literal: if Saturn transgresses and stations, ruler and ministers are harmonious and the realm rejoices;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn encroaching and holding brings harmony between ruler and ministers and joy throughout the realm;

sentences.zh: 石申曰：「天子戒飲食之官。」

translations.literal: Shi Shen says: "The Son of Heaven warns the food officials."
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shen says: "The Son of Heaven should warn the officials charged with food and drink."

translations.literal: entering, exiting, lingering, and lodging bring urgent edicts.
translations.idiomatic: its entering, exiting, lingering, and lodging bring urgent edicts.

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses it, there are urgent armies.
translations.idiomatic: Venus encroaching upon it raises urgent armies.

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde in Gou-si, ministers plot against the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: moving retrograde in the Gou-si hook means ministers plot against the ruler;

translations.literal: if visible by day, there is war.
translations.idiomatic: visibility by day means war.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，民相仇，歲旱，君戒在酒食。

translations.literal: if Mercury transgresses it, the people feud with one another, the year is dry, and the ruler is warned over food and wine.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury encroaching upon it sets the people at one another's throats, brings a dry year, and warns the ruler to guard against excess in food and wine.

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses it, blame falls on the Zhou territory;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon it brings blame upon the Zhou region;

translations.literal: if it stations, silk, cloth, fish, and salt grow dear.
translations.idiomatic: holding there makes silk, cloth, fish, and salt costly.

translations.literal: if the color is pale, frontier lords are slain.
translations.idiomatic: a pale hue slays the frontier lords.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，大臣誅，爲兵，爲喪。

translations.literal: if a comet transgresses it, great ministers are executed; there are armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: a comet encroaching upon it brings the execution of great ministers, war, and mourning.

sentences.zh: 星孛于柳，南夷叛，甘德曰：「爲兵，爲喪。」

translations.literal: a broom star at Willow: the southern barbarians rebel; Gan De says: "armies and mourning."
translations.idiomatic: a broom star at Willow means the southern barbarians rebel; Gan De says it portends war and mourning.

translations.literal: if a meteor emerges and transgresses it, the Zhou allotment worries;
translations.idiomatic: a meteor emerging and encroaching upon it troubles the Zhou region;

translations.literal: if the color is yellow, there is joy;
translations.idiomatic: a yellow hue brings joy;

translations.literal: if it enters, the king's inner quarters have fire;
translations.idiomatic: entering brings fire within the royal inner quarters;

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：「出，則宗廟有喜，賢人用；

translations.literal: The Book of Yisi says: "If it exits, the ancestral temple has joy and worthies are employed;
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Yisi says: "Exiting brings joy to the ancestral temple and the employment of worthies;

sentences.zh: 入，爲天廚官有憂，木功廢。」

translations.literal: if it enters, the Celestial Kitchen officials worry and woodwork is abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: entering troubles the Celestial Kitchen officials and halts woodwork."

translations.literal: if red cloud vapor enters, there is fire;
translations.idiomatic: red cloud vapor entering brings fire;

translations.literal: yellow: amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: yellow means an amnesty;

sentences.zh: 黃白，爲天子有喜，起宮室。

translations.literal: yellow-white: the Son of Heaven has joy and palaces are raised.
translations.idiomatic: yellow-white brings joy to the Son of Heaven and the raising of palaces.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以柳爲十四度，唐開元遊儀十五度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, Willow was fourteen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring instrument, fifteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, Willow spanned fourteen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring instrument measured fifteen.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was seventy-seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly its distance from the celestial pole was seventy-seven degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，柳八星一十五度，距西頭第三星去極八十三度。

translations.literal: Jingyou surveying: Willow eight stars fifteen degrees; from the third star at the western end to the pole, eighty-three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey found the Willow's eight stars spanning fifteen degrees, with the third star from the western end eighty-three degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 酒旗三星，在軒轅右角南，酒官之旗也，主宴享飲食。

translations.literal: Wine Banner three stars, south of Chariot Hub's right horn, are the wine officials' banner, governing feasts and drink.
translations.idiomatic: The Wine Banner comprises three stars south of Chariot Hub's right horn—the banner of the wine officials—presiding over feasts and libations.

sentences.zh: 星不具，則天下有大喪，帝王宴飲，沉昏非禮，以酒亡國；

translations.literal: if the stars are incomplete, there is great mourning throughout the realm; the emperor feasts and drinks, sinks into drunken impropriety, and the state perishes through wine;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars are incomplete, the realm suffers great mourning; the emperor feasts and drinks, sinks into drunken excess contrary to ritual, and the state is lost to wine;

translations.literal: if bright, feasts and music are conducted with propriety;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, feasts and music are conducted with due propriety;

sentences.zh: 五星守之，天下大酺，有酒肉賜宗室。

translations.literal: if the five planets station there, the realm holds great communal feasts and wine and meat are bestowed upon the imperial clan;
translations.idiomatic: when the five planets hold position there, the realm holds great communal feasts and wine and meat are bestowed upon the imperial clan;

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, food and drink lose proper measure;
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon it brings immoderation in food and drink;

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，三公九卿有謀。

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses it, the Three Excellencies and Nine Ministers plot;
translations.idiomatic: Venus encroaching upon it means the Three Excellencies and Nine Ministers are plotting;

sentences.zh: 客、彗犯，主以酒過爲相所害。

translations.literal: if a guest star or comet transgresses, the ruler, through excess in wine, is harmed by the chancellor;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star or comet encroaching upon it means the ruler, through excess in wine, is harmed by the chancellor;

translations.literal: if red cloud vapor enters, the ruler fails through wine;
translations.idiomatic: red cloud vapor entering means the ruler is undone through wine;

translations.literal: according to the Jin Treatise on Astronomy, the Wine Banner lies within the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Jin Treatise on Astronomy, the Wine Banner lies within the Celestial Market Enclosure.

translations.literal: the Song of the Steps of Heaven assigns the Wine Banner to the Willow lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The Song of the Steps of Heaven assigns the Wine Banner to the Willow lodge.

sentences.zh: 以《通占鏡》考之，亦屬柳，又屬七星。

translations.literal: examining it against the Comprehensive Mirror of Astrology, it also belongs to the Willow, and again to the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Examined against the Comprehensive Mirror of Astrology, it belongs to the Willow as well—and again to the Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》亦屬七星，與《步天歌》不同，今並存之。

translations.literal: the New Book of Heavenly Images also assigns it to the Seven Stars, differing from the Song of the Steps of Heaven; both readings are preserved here.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Images also assigns it to the Seven Stars, differing from the Song of the Steps of Heaven; both readings are preserved here.

sentences.zh: 七星七星，一名天都，主衣裳文繡，又主急兵。

translations.literal: the Seven Stars, also called the Heavenly Metropolis, govern robes and patterned brocades, and also urgent warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The Seven Stars, also called the Heavenly Metropolis, govern robes and patterned brocades—and also urgent warfare.

translations.literal: therefore when the stars are bright, the royal Way flourishes;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright, the royal Way flourishes;

translations.literal: when dim, the worthy depart and the realm is left empty;
translations.idiomatic: when dim, the worthy depart and the realm is left empty;

translations.literal: when they stir, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: when they stir, armies rise;

translations.literal: when they separate, government changes hands.
translations.idiomatic: when they separate, government changes hands.

translations.literal: the Canopy-Heaven theory says: the Seven Stars are the neck of the Vermilion Bird.
translations.idiomatic: The Canopy-Heaven theory holds that the Seven Stars are the neck of the Vermilion Bird.

sentences.zh: 頸者，文明之粹，羽儀所承。

translations.literal: the neck is the quintessence of civilization, bearing the ceremonial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: The neck is the quintessence of civilization, bearing the ceremonial regalia.

sentences.zh: 日食其宿，主不安，刑在門戶之神。

translations.literal: a solar eclipse in this lodge: the ruler is unsettled; punishment falls upon the gods of gates and doorways.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in this lodge unsettles the ruler; punishment falls upon the gods of gates and doorways.

sentences.zh: 又曰：文章士受誅，其分兵起，臣爲亂。

translations.literal: it is also said: literary gentlemen are executed; in its allotted region armies rise and ministers make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that literary gentlemen are executed, armies rise in its allotted region, and ministers rebel.

translations.literal: a solar halo: the lord of Zhou's state is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: a solar halo troubles the lord of Zhou's state;

sentences.zh: 青色抱而順，在兵爲東軍吉。

translations.literal: green color embracing and compliant—in warfare, the eastern army is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: green embracing and compliant—in warfare, the eastern army is auspicious.

sentences.zh: 月食，後及大臣有憂，又爲歲饑，民流，其國更政。

translations.literal: a lunar eclipse: the empress and great ministers have anxiety; also famine in the year's harvest, the people scatter, and that state changes its government.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse brings anxiety to the empress and great ministers, famine in the year's harvest, a scattering of the people, and a change of government in that state;

translations.literal: a halo: that region suffers drought; prison officials face ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: a halo means drought in that region and ill omen for prison officials;

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，主憂兵，五穀多傷。

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, the ruler frets over war and the five grains suffer much damage.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon it makes the ruler fret over war and damages the five grains;

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses it, bridges and roads cannot be traversed;
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching upon it blocks bridges and roads;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde, the earth quakes and fire disasters break out;
translations.idiomatic: retrograde motion brings earthquakes and fire disasters;

sentences.zh: 出、入、留、舍，其國失地，水決。

translations.literal: emerging, entering, stationing, or lodging—its state loses territory and rivers burst their banks.
translations.idiomatic: whether it emerges, enters, stations, or lodges, its state loses territory and rivers burst their banks.

sentences.zh: 填星犯守，世治平，王道興，後、夫人喜。

translations.literal: if Saturn transgresses and stations, the age is well governed, the royal Way rises, and empress and consorts rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn encroaching and holding position means an age of good government, the royal Way ascendant, and joy for empress and consorts;

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，兵暴起，大臣爲亂；

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses it, armies suddenly rise and great ministers rebel;
translations.idiomatic: Venus encroaching upon it raises armies in sudden outbreak and sets great ministers to rebellion;

translations.literal: crossing heaven: guard against fraud and deceit.
translations.idiomatic: crossing heaven calls for vigilance against fraud and deceit.

translations.literal: if Mercury transgresses it, treacherous ministers are at one's side;
translations.idiomatic: Mercury encroaching upon it means treacherous ministers at one's side;

sentences.zh: 守，則其分有憂，萬物不成，兵從中起，貴臣有罪，民疫流亡。

translations.literal: if it stations, its allotted region has anxiety, the myriad things do not come to fruition, armies arise from within, noble officials are guilty, and the people suffer pestilence and exile.
translations.idiomatic: holding position brings anxiety to its allotted region, failure of the myriad things, armies rising from within, guilt among noble officials, and pestilence and exile among the people.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，爲兵，《荊州占》云：「河水決，民流。」

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses it, there is war; the Jingzhou Account says: "The Yellow River breaks its banks and the people scatter."
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon it presages war; the Jingzhou Account says, "The Yellow River breaks its banks and the people scatter."

translations.literal: if a comet transgresses, rebellious armies rise and noble officials are executed;
translations.idiomatic: A comet encroaching raises rebellious armies and brings the execution of noble officials;

sentences.zh: 武密曰：「彗星出七星，狀如杵，爲兵。」

translations.literal: Wu Mi says: "When a comet emerges from the Seven Stars, shaped like a pestle, it presages war."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi says, "When a comet emerges from the Seven Stars shaped like a pestle, it presages war."

sentences.zh: 星孛於星，有亂兵起宮殿，貴臣戮，大臣相譖。

translations.literal: when a broom star appears upon the stars, disorderly armies rise in the palaces, noble officials are executed, and great ministers slander one another.
translations.idiomatic: When a broom star appears upon the stars, disorderly armies rise in the palaces, noble officials are executed, and great ministers slander one another.

translations.literal: if a shooting star transgresses it, there is war and anxiety;
translations.idiomatic: a shooting star encroaching upon it brings war and anxiety;

translations.literal: it is also said: when it enters, urgent envoys arrive.
translations.idiomatic: it is also said that when it enters, urgent envoys arrive.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：「流星入，庫官有喜，錦繡進，女工用。」

translations.literal: the Yisi Account says: "When a shooting star enters, treasury officials have cause for joy; brocades and embroideries are presented and women artisans are employed."
translations.idiomatic: The Yisi Account says, "When a shooting star enters, treasury officials rejoice; brocades and embroideries are presented and women artisans are put to work."

translations.literal: when pale white cloud vapor enters, nobles are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: Pale white cloud vapor entering troubles the nobles;

translations.literal: when it exits, the Son of Heaven employs urgent messengers.
translations.idiomatic: when it exits, the Son of Heaven employs urgent messengers.

translations.literal: red entering brings war;
translations.idiomatic: red entering brings war;

translations.literal: black: worthy gentlemen die;
translations.idiomatic: black means worthy gentlemen die;

translations.literal: yellow: distant peoples come to offer tribute;
translations.idiomatic: yellow means distant peoples come to offer tribute;

sentences.zh: 白，爲天子遣使賜諸侯帛。

translations.literal: white: the Son of Heaven dispatches envoys to bestow silks upon the feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: white means the Son of Heaven dispatches envoys to bestow silks upon the feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 按景祐測驗，七星七度，距大星去極九十七度。

translations.literal: according to the Jingyou Survey, the Seven Stars span seven degrees; the chief star stands ninety-seven degrees from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou Survey found the Seven Stars spanning seven degrees, with the chief star ninety-seven degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 軒轅十七星，在七星北，後妃之主，士職也。

translations.literal: Chariot Hub's seventeen stars, north of the Seven Stars, are masters of the empress and consorts—the domain of earth's office.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot Hub comprises seventeen stars north of the Seven Stars, governing empress and consorts—the domain of earth's office.

sentences.zh: 一曰東陵，一曰權星，主雷雨之神。

translations.literal: also called Eastern Mound, also called the Power Star; they govern the god of thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: also called Eastern Mound, also called the Power Star—they govern the god of thunder and rain.

translations.literal: the great southern star is the chief consort;
translations.idiomatic: the great southern star is the chief consort;

sentences.zh: 次北一星，夫人也，屏也，上將也；

translations.literal: the next star northward is the lady, the Screen, and the commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: the next star northward is the Lady, the Screen, and the commander-in-chief;

translations.literal: the next northward is the consort and lieutenant general;
translations.idiomatic: the next northward is the Consort and lieutenant general;

sentences.zh: 其次諸星，皆次妃之屬也。

translations.literal: the remaining stars below are all subordinate to secondary consorts.
translations.idiomatic: the stars below them all belong to secondary consorts.

translations.literal: a small star south of the chief consort is a palace woman;
translations.idiomatic: a small star south of the chief consort is a palace woman;

translations.literal: the star to the left, Lesser People, is the empress dowager's clan;
translations.idiomatic: the star to the left, Lesser People, is the empress dowager's clan;

translations.literal: the star to the right, Greater People, is the grand empress dowager's clan.
translations.idiomatic: the star to the right, Greater People, is the grand empress dowager's clan.

translations.literal: one desires their color yellowish, small, and bright.
translations.idiomatic: one desires their color yellowish, small, and bright.

sentences.zh: 武密曰：「後妃後宮之象，陰陽交合，感爲雷，激爲電，和爲雨，怒爲風，亂爲霧，凝爲霜，散爲露，聚爲雲氣，立爲虹蜺，離爲背璚，分爲抱珥，此二十四變皆權主之。」

translations.literal: Wu Mi says: "They image the empress and the inner palace. When yin and yang unite, the sensation becomes thunder, the surge becomes lightning, the harmony becomes rain, anger becomes wind, disorder becomes mist, congelation becomes frost, dispersion becomes dew, gathering becomes cloud vapor, uprearing becomes rainbow, separation becomes back-glow and cinnabar halos, division becomes embracing aureoles—these twenty-four transformations are all governed by the Power Star."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi says, "They image the empress and the inner palace. When yin and yang unite, sensation becomes thunder, surge becomes lightning, harmony becomes rain, anger becomes wind, disorder becomes mist, congelation becomes frost, dispersion becomes dew, gathering becomes cloud vapor, uprearing becomes rainbow, separation becomes back-glow and cinnabar halos, and division becomes embracing aureoles—all twenty-four transformations are governed by the Power Star."

translations.literal: when minute and faint, the empress is unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: When minute and faint, the empress is unsettled;

translations.literal: when black, anxiety falls upon elders;
translations.idiomatic: when black, anxiety falls upon elders;

translations.literal: when they shift position, the people disperse;
translations.idiomatic: when they shift position, the people disperse;

sentences.zh: 東西角大張而振，後族敗。

translations.literal: when the eastern and western horns gape wide and tremble, the empress's clan is ruined.
translations.idiomatic: when the eastern and western horns gape wide and tremble, the empress's clan is ruined.

sentences.zh: 月入之，女主失勢，或火災；

translations.literal: if the moon enters, the chief consort loses influence, or there is fire disaster;
translations.idiomatic: the moon entering means the chief consort loses influence—or fire disaster;

translations.literal: if it transgresses the left or right horn, great ministers are dismissed for their crimes;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing the left or right horn brings dismissal of great ministers for their crimes;

sentences.zh: 中犯乘守太民，爲饑，太后宗有罪；

translations.literal: if it transgresses the center and rides or stations at Greater People, there is famine and the grand empress dowager's clan is guilty;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing the center and riding or stationing at Greater People brings famine and guilt upon the grand empress dowager's clan;

sentences.zh: 守少民，小有饑，女主失勢；

translations.literal: if it stations at Lesser People, there is slight famine and the chief consort loses influence;
translations.idiomatic: stationing at Lesser People brings slight famine and the chief consort loses influence;

translations.literal: if it stations at Palace Woman, there is anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: stationing at Palace Woman brings anxiety.

translations.literal: a lunar halo: the chief consort suffers mourning.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar halo means mourning for the chief consort.

sentences.zh: 月、五星淩犯、環繞、乘守，皆爲女主有禍。

translations.literal: the moon or five planets crossing, encircling, riding, or stationing—all bode calamity for the chief consort.
translations.idiomatic: the moon or five planets crossing, encircling, riding, or stationing—all bode calamity for the chief consort.

translations.literal: a lunar eclipse: the chief consort is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse troubles the chief consort.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，女主失勢，一曰大臣當之；

translations.literal: if Jupiter transgresses it, the chief consort loses influence—or, by one reading, great ministers meet calamity;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter encroaching upon it strips the chief consort of influence—or, by one reading, great ministers bear the calamity;

sentences.zh: 乘守大民，爲大饑，太后宗黜；

translations.literal: if it rides or stations at Greater People, there is great famine and the grand empress dowager's clan is disgraced;
translations.idiomatic: riding or stationing at Greater People brings great famine and disgrace to the grand empress dowager's clan;

sentences.zh: 中犯乘守少民，爲小饑，後宮有黜者。

translations.literal: if it transgresses the center and rides or stations at Lesser People, there is slight famine and someone in the inner palace is disgraced.
translations.idiomatic: transgressing the center and riding or stationing at Lesser People brings slight famine and disgrace within the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯守勾巳，後妃離德；

translations.literal: if Mars transgresses and stations at Gou-si, empress and consorts sever their virtue;
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroaching and holding Gou-si means empress and consorts sever their virtue;

translations.literal: if it transgresses Palace Woman, the Son of Heaven's maidservants and concubines are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing Palace Woman troubles the Son of Heaven's maidservants and concubines;

translations.literal: if it transgresses Greater or Lesser People, anxiety lies in the empress dowager's clans;
translations.idiomatic: transgressing Greater or Lesser People brings anxiety to the empress dowager's clans;

translations.literal: if it stations there, there are executions within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: holding position there brings executions within the palace.

sentences.zh: 填星行其中，女主失勢，有喪。

translations.literal: if Saturn moves among them, the chief consort loses influence and there is mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn moving among them strips the chief consort of influence and brings mourning.

translations.literal: if Venus transgresses it, the empress loses influence.
translations.idiomatic: Venus encroaching upon it strips the empress of influence.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，近臣謀滅宗族。

translations.literal: if a guest star transgresses it, close ministers plot to extinguish clans.
translations.idiomatic: a guest star encroaching upon it means close ministers plot to extinguish clans.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛犯，女主爲寇，一曰兵起。

translations.literal: if a comet or broom star transgresses, the chief consort becomes a marauder—or, by one reading, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: a comet or broom star encroaching upon it makes the chief consort a marauder—or, by one reading, raises armies;

sentences.zh: 流星入之，後宮多讒亂《乙巳占》：「流星出之，後有中使出。」

translations.literal: if a shooting star enters, the inner palace is rife with slander and disorder. The Yisi Account says: "When a shooting star emerges, a palace eunuch is dispatched."
translations.idiomatic: a shooting star entering means the inner palace is rife with slander and disorder. The Yisi Account says, "When a shooting star emerges, a palace eunuch is dispatched."

translations.literal: or, by one reading, the Son of Heaven has joy in his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Or, by one reading, the Son of Heaven has joy in his descendants.

sentences.zh: 天稷五星，在七星南，農正也，取百穀之長以爲號。

translations.literal: Heavenly Mound's five stars, south of the Seven Stars, are the Minister of Agriculture—named from the chief among the hundred grains.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Mound comprises five stars south of the Seven Stars—the Minister of Agriculture, named from the chief among the hundred grains.

translations.literal: when bright, the harvest is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: when bright, the harvest is abundant;

translations.literal: when dim or incomplete, there is famine;
translations.idiomatic: when dim or incomplete, famine follows;

translations.literal: when they shift, the realm suffers dearth and failed harvests.
translations.idiomatic: when they shift, the realm suffers dearth and failed harvests.

translations.literal: if a guest star enters, there are sacrificial rites within;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star entering means sacrificial rites within;

translations.literal: when it exits, there are sacrificial rites abroad.
translations.idiomatic: when it exits, sacrificial rites are held abroad.

sentences.zh: 天相三星，在七星北，一曰在酒旗南，丞相大臣之象。

translations.literal: Heavenly Minister's three stars, north of the Seven Stars—or, by one reading, south of the Wine Banner—image the chancellor and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Minister comprises three stars north of the Seven Stars—or, by one reading, south of the Wine Banner—imaging the chancellor and great ministers.

translations.literal: Wu Mi says: "Its divination is the same as for the Minister Star."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi says, "Its divination is the same as for the Minister Star."

sentences.zh: 五星犯守之，後妃、將相憂。

translations.literal: if the five planets transgress or station, empress, consorts, generals, and ministers are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: The five planets transgressing or holding position trouble empress, consorts, generals, and ministers.

translations.literal: if a comet or guest star transgresses, great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: a comet or guest star encroaching upon it brings the execution of great ministers.

translations.literal: if cloud vapor enters, yellow: great ministers rejoice;
translations.idiomatic: cloud vapor entering, yellow, means great ministers rejoice;

translations.literal: black: generals are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: black means generals are troubled.

sentences.zh: 內平四星，在三台南，一曰在中台南，執法平罪之官。

translations.literal: Inner Balance's four stars, south of the Three Terraces—or, by one reading, south of the Middle Terrace—are officials who wield law and adjudicate crime.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Balance comprises four stars south of the Three Terraces—or, by one reading, south of the Middle Terrace—officials who wield law and adjudicate crime.

translations.literal: when bright, punishments are equitably applied.
translations.idiomatic: when bright, punishments are equitably applied.

sentences.zh: 按軒轅十七星，《晉志》在七星北，而列於天市垣；

translations.literal: regarding Chariot Hub's seventeen stars: the Jin Treatise places them north of the Seven Stars yet lists them within the Celestial Market Enclosure;
translations.idiomatic: Regarding Chariot Hub's seventeen stars, the Jin Treatise places them north of the Seven Stars yet lists them within the Celestial Market Enclosure;

sentences.zh: 武密以軒轅屬七星，又屬柳；

translations.literal: Wu Mi assigns Chariot Hub to the Seven Stars and also to the Willow;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi assigns Chariot Hub to the Seven Stars and also to the Willow;

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以西八星屬柳，中屬七星，末屬張。

translations.literal: the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns the western eight stars to the Willow, the middle to the Seven Stars, and the end to the Spread.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Images assigns the western eight stars to the Willow, the middle to the Seven Stars, and the end to the Spread.

sentences.zh: 天稷五星，《晉志》在七星南；

translations.literal: Heavenly Mound's five stars: the Jin Treatise places them south of the Seven Stars;
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Mound's five stars: the Jin Treatise places them south of the Seven Stars;

sentences.zh: 武密亦以天稷屬七星，又屬柳；

translations.literal: Wu Mi also assigns Heavenly Mound to the Seven Stars, and also to the Willow;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi also assigns Heavenly Mound to the Seven Stars and to the Willow;

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以西二星屬柳，餘屬七星。

translations.literal: the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns the western two stars to the Willow and the remainder to the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of Heavenly Images assigns the western two stars to the Willow and the remainder to the Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 天相三星，《晉志》在天市垣，武密書屬七星，《乾象新書》屬軫宿。

translations.literal: Heavenly Minister's three stars: the Jin Treatise places them in the Celestial Market Enclosure; Wu Mi's book assigns them to the Seven Stars; the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns them to the Crossbar Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Minister's three stars: the Jin Treatise places them in the Celestial Market Enclosure; Wu Mi's book assigns them to the Seven Stars; the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns them to the Crossbar Lodge.

sentences.zh: 內平四星，《晉志》在天市垣，武密書屬柳，《乾象新書》屬張，《步天歌》屬七星。

translations.literal: Inner Balance's four stars: the Jin Treatise places them in the Celestial Market Enclosure; Wu Mi's book assigns them to the Willow; the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns them to the Spread; the Song of Pacing the Heavens assigns them to the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Balance's four stars: the Jin Treatise places them in the Celestial Market Enclosure; Wu Mi's book assigns them to the Willow; the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns them to the Spread; the Song of Pacing the Heavens assigns them to the Seven Stars.

translations.literal: all accounts differ; the present text preserves them all.
translations.idiomatic: All accounts differ; the present text preserves them all.

sentences.zh: 張宿六星，主珍寶、宗廟所用及衣服，又主天廚飲食、賞賚之事。

translations.literal: the Spread Lodge comprises six stars; it presides over treasures, what the ancestral temples use, and garments, and also over the Celestial Kitchen's food and drink and over bestowals and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: The Spread Lodge comprises six stars. It presides over treasures, what the ancestral temples use, and garments, and also over the Celestial Kitchen's food and drink and over bestowals and rewards.

sentences.zh: 明，則王行五禮，得天下之中；

translations.literal: when bright, the king performs the five rites and attains the center of the realm;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the king performs the five rites and attains the center of the realm;

sentences.zh: 動，則賞賚不明，王者子孫多疾；

translations.literal: when they stir, rewards and grants are unclear and the king's descendants suffer many illnesses;
translations.idiomatic: when they stir, rewards and grants are unclear and the king's descendants suffer many illnesses;

translations.literal: when they shift position, rebellion rises in the realm;
translations.idiomatic: when they shift position, rebellion rises in the realm;

translations.literal: when they cluster close, armies take the field.
translations.idiomatic: when they cluster close, armies take the field.

sentences.zh: 日食，爲王者失禮，掌御饌者憂。

translations.literal: a solar eclipse portends the king's lapse in ritual and anxiety for those who manage the imperial viands.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse portends the king's lapse in ritual and anxiety for those who manage the imperial viands.

sentences.zh: 甘德曰：「後失勢，貴臣憂，期七十日。」

translations.literal: Gan De said: "The chief consort loses influence, eminent ministers are troubled—the term is seventy days."
translations.idiomatic: Gan De said: "The chief consort loses influence, eminent ministers are troubled—the term is seventy days."

sentences.zh: 暈及有黃氣抱日，主功臣效忠。

translations.literal: A halo and yellow vapor embracing the sun presage loyal service from meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: A halo and yellow vapor embracing the sun presage loyal service from meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「財寶大臣黜，將相憂。」

translations.literal: Another reading: "Treasure ministers are dismissed and generals and chancellors are troubled."
translations.idiomatic: Another reading: "Treasure ministers are dismissed and generals and chancellors are troubled."

sentences.zh: 月食，其分饑，臣失勢，皇后有憂。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse brings famine in its jurisdiction, ministers lose influence, and the empress is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse brings famine in its jurisdiction, ministers lose influence, and the empress is troubled.

translations.literal: a halo portends flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: A halo portends flood disaster.

translations.literal: Chen Zhuo said: "The five grains, fish, and salt grow costly."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhuo said: "The five grains, fish, and salt grow costly."

sentences.zh: 巫咸曰：「後妃惡之，宮中疫。」

translations.literal: Wu Xian said: "Empresses and consorts are ill-omened; pestilence in the palace."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xian said: "Empresses and consorts are ill-omened; pestilence in the palace."

translations.literal: When the moon encroaches upon it, generals and chancellors die and its realm is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, generals and chancellors die and its realm is troubled.

sentences.zh: 歲星入犯之，天子有慶賀事；

translations.literal: when Jupiter enters and encroaches upon it, the Son of Heaven has matters of celebration;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter enters and encroaches upon it, the Son of Heaven has matters of celebration;

translations.literal: if it stations there, the state is greatly abundant and sovereign and ministers are of one mind;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the state is greatly abundant and sovereign and ministers are of one mind;

sentences.zh: 三十日不出，天下安寧，其國升平。

translations.literal: if thirty days pass without it departing, the realm is tranquil and that state rises to peace.
translations.idiomatic: if thirty days pass without it departing, the realm is tranquil and that state rises to peace.

translations.literal: when Mars encroaches upon it, meritorious ministers are due for enfeoffment;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon it, meritorious ministers are due for enfeoffment;

translations.literal: if it enters, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, armies rise;

sentences.zh: 又曰色如四時休王，其分貴人安，社稷無虞；

translations.literal: another reading holds that if its color matches the prospering and declining of the four seasons, nobles in its jurisdiction are secure and the altars of soil and grain face no peril;
translations.idiomatic: another reading holds that if its color matches the prospering and declining of the four seasons, nobles in its jurisdiction are secure and the altars of soil and grain face no peril;

translations.literal: another reading holds that if Mars stations there in spring, the feudal lords rebel;
translations.idiomatic: another reading holds that if Mars stations there in spring, the feudal lords rebel;

sentences.zh: 逆行守之，爲地動，爲火災，又曰將軍驚，土功作，又曰會則不可用兵。

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and stations there, the earth quakes and fire disasters follow; another reading holds the generals are alarmed and earthworks begin; yet another holds that in conjunction one must not deploy armies.
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde and stations there, the earth quakes and fire disasters follow; another reading holds the generals are alarmed and earthworks begin; yet another holds that in conjunction one must not deploy armies.

sentences.zh: 填星犯之，爲女主飲宴過度，或宮女失禮；

translations.literal: when Saturn encroaches upon it, the chief consort indulges overmuch in feasting—or palace women lapse in propriety;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches upon it, the chief consort indulges overmuch in feasting—or palace women lapse in propriety;

translations.literal: if it enters, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, armies rise;

translations.literal: if it exits, its jurisdiction loses territory;
translations.idiomatic: if it exits, its jurisdiction loses territory;

translations.literal: if it stations there, earthworks are undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, earthworks are undertaken.

translations.literal: when Venus encroaches upon it, the state is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon it, the state is troubled;

sentences.zh: 守之，其國兵謀不成，石申曰：「國易政。」

translations.literal: if it stations there, that state's military plots come to nothing. Shi Shen said: "The state changes its government."
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, that state's military plots come to nothing. Shi Shen said: "The state changes its government."

translations.literal: If it lodges and remains, that state raises armies.
translations.idiomatic: If it lodges and remains, that state raises armies.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯守，五穀不成，兵起，大水，貴臣負國，民疫，多訟，芒角，臣傷其君；

translations.literal: when Mercury encroaches and stations, the five grains fail, armies rise, great floods come, eminent ministers betray the state, the people suffer pestilence and lawsuits multiply; if it shows rays, ministers wound their lord;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches and stations, the five grains fail, armies rise, great floods come, eminent ministers betray the state, the people suffer pestilence and lawsuits multiply; if it shows rays, ministers wound their lord;

translations.literal: if it enters, fire disaster follows;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, fire disaster follows;

translations.literal: if it exits;
translations.idiomatic: if it exits;

translations.literal: there are rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: there are rebellious ministers.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，天子以酒爲憂；

translations.literal: when a guest star encroaches upon it, the Son of Heaven is troubled over wine;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, the Son of Heaven is troubled over wine;

sentences.zh: 守之，周、楚之國有隱士出；

translations.literal: if it stations there, recluses emerge from the states of Zhou and Chu;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, recluses emerge from the states of Zhou and Chu;

translations.literal: if it enters the Spread, armies rise and the state suffers famine;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the Spread, armies rise and the state suffers famine;

translations.literal: if it lodges and does not depart, the Forward General harbors a plot.
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges and does not depart, the Forward General harbors a plot.

translations.literal: Another reading holds it favors whoever raises armies first.
translations.idiomatic: Another reading holds it favors whoever raises armies first.

translations.literal: when a comet encroaches upon it, the state deploys armies and the people scatter;
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, the state deploys armies and the people scatter;

translations.literal: if it stations there, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, armies rise;

translations.literal: if it exits, drought follows;
translations.idiomatic: if it exits, drought follows;

sentences.zh: 又曰犯守，君欲移徙宮殿。

translations.literal: Another reading holds that encroachment and stationing mean the ruler wishes to relocate the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Another reading holds that encroachment and stationing mean the ruler wishes to relocate the palace.

sentences.zh: 星孛于張，爲民流，爲兵大起。

translations.literal: a broom star at the Spread means the people disperse and armies rise on a grand scale.
translations.idiomatic: A broom star at the Spread means the people disperse and armies rise on a grand scale.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：「流星出入，宗社昌，有赦令，下臣入賀。」

translations.literal: the Yisi Occupations: "When a meteor enters and exits, the altars of ancestor and soil flourish, amnesty is proclaimed, and subordinate ministers come to offer congratulations."
translations.idiomatic: The Yisi Occupations: "When a meteor enters and exits, the altars of ancestor and soil flourish, amnesty is proclaimed, and subordinate ministers come to offer congratulations."

sentences.zh: 蒼白雲氣入之，庭中觴客有憂；

translations.literal: When pale cloud vapor enters it, those who toast guests in the court have cause for anxiety;
translations.idiomatic: When pale cloud vapor enters it, those who toast guests in the court have cause for anxiety;

translations.literal: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven grants gifts to guests in his joy;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven grants gifts to guests in his joy;

translations.literal: if black, flood disaster strikes its jurisdiction;
translations.idiomatic: if black, flood disaster strikes its jurisdiction;

translations.literal: if crimson, the Son of Heaven is about to deploy armies.
translations.idiomatic: if crimson, the Son of Heaven is about to deploy armies.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，張宿十七度，唐開元遊儀十八度。

translations.literal: according to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Spread Lodge was measured at seventeen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gave it as eighteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Spread Lodge was measured at seventeen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gave it as eighteen degrees.

translations.literal: the earlier measurement placed it ninety-seven degrees from the celestial pole.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier measurement placed it ninety-seven degrees from the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，張十八度，距西第二星去極一百三度。

translations.literal: the Jingyou survey and test: the Spread eighteen degrees; from the second star westward, distance from the pole one hundred three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey found the Spread at eighteen degrees; from the second star westward, the distance from the pole was one hundred three degrees.

sentences.zh: 天廟十四星，在張宿南，天子祖廟也。

translations.literal: Heavenly Temple comprises fourteen stars south of the Spread Lodge—the Son of Heaven's ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Temple comprises fourteen stars south of the Spread Lodge—the Son of Heaven's ancestral temple.

translations.literal: when bright, it is auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, it is auspicious;

sentences.zh: 微細，其所有兵，軍食不通。

translations.literal: when faint and fine, that region has armies and military provisions fail to reach the troops.
translations.idiomatic: when faint and fine, that region has armies and military provisions fail to reach the troops.

sentences.zh: 客星中犯之，有白衣會，兵起。

translations.literal: if a guest star encroaches upon it from within, there is a gathering of white-robed mourners and armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star encroaches upon it from within, there is a gathering of white-robed mourners and armies rise.

translations.literal: Another reading holds that sacrificial officers are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: Another reading holds that sacrificial officers are troubled.

translations.literal: Wu Mi said: "Its prognostications are the same as Void Beam's."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi said: "Its prognostications are the same as Void Beam's."

sentences.zh: 按天廟十四星，《晉志》雖列於二十八宿之外，而亦曰在張宿南，與《隋志》所載同，兼與《步天歌》合。

translations.literal: regarding Heavenly Temple's fourteen stars: though the Jin Treatise lists them outside the Twenty-eight Lodges, it also places them south of the Spread Lodge—the same as the Sui Treatise records and consistent with the Song of Pacing the Heavens.
translations.idiomatic: Regarding Heavenly Temple's fourteen stars, though the Jin Treatise lists them outside the Twenty-eight Lodges, it also places them south of the Spread Lodge—the same as the Sui Treatise records and consistent with the Song of Pacing the Heavens.

sentences.zh: 翼宿二十二星，天之樂府，主俳倡戲樂，又主外夷遠客、負海之賓。

translations.literal: the Wings Lodge comprises twenty-two stars—the Celestial Music Office; it presides over players, singers, and theatrical amusement, and also over distant guests from foreign tribes and visitors from lands beyond the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Wings Lodge comprises twenty-two stars—the Celestial Music Office. It presides over players, singers, and theatrical amusement, and also over distant guests from foreign tribes and visitors from lands beyond the sea.

translations.literal: when the stars are bright and large, rites and music flourish and the four quarters send envoys;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars are bright and large, rites and music flourish and the four quarters send envoys;

translations.literal: when they stir and tremble, envoys come from the southern and northern barbarians;
translations.idiomatic: when they stir and tremble, envoys come from the southern and northern barbarians;

translations.literal: when they scatter and shift, the Son of Heaven is about to raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: when they scatter and shift, the Son of Heaven is about to raise armies.

sentences.zh: 日食，王者失禮，忠臣見譖，爲旱災。

translations.literal: a solar eclipse means the king lapses in ritual, loyal ministers face slander, and drought disaster follows.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse means the king lapses in ritual, loyal ministers face slander, and drought disaster follows.

translations.literal: a halo means music officers are dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: A halo means music officers are dismissed;

translations.literal: if three embracing vapors appear above it, enemy hearts desire peace.
translations.idiomatic: if three embracing vapors appear above it, enemy hearts desire peace.

sentences.zh: 月食，亦爲忠臣見譖，飛蟲多死，北方有兵，女主惡之，石申曰：「大臣有謀。」

translations.literal: a lunar eclipse likewise means loyal ministers face slander, flying insects die in great numbers, armies rise in the north, and the chief consort is ill-omened. Shi Shen said: "Great ministers harbor a plot."
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse likewise means loyal ministers face slander, flying insects die in great numbers, armies rise in the north, and the chief consort is ill-omened. Shi Shen said: "Great ministers harbor a plot."

sentences.zh: 月犯之，國憂，其分有兵，大將亡，女主惡之。

translations.literal: When the moon encroaches upon it, the state is troubled, its jurisdiction sees armies, great generals perish, and the chief consort is ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon it, the state is troubled, its jurisdiction sees armies, great generals perish, and the chief consort is ill-omened.

translations.literal: when Jupiter encroaches, the five grains are harmed by wind;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches, the five grains are harmed by wind;

sentences.zh: 守之，王道具，將相忠，文術用；

translations.literal: if it stations there, the king's way is established, generals and chancellors are loyal, and literary arts are employed;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the king's way is established, generals and chancellors are loyal, and literary arts are employed;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde and enters, the ruler favors hunting.
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde and enters, the ruler favors hunting.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，其分民饑，臣下不從命，邊兵起；

translations.literal: when Mars encroaches upon it, the people in its jurisdiction suffer famine, subordinates disobey orders, and frontier armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon it, the people in its jurisdiction suffer famine, subordinates disobey orders, and frontier armies rise;

translations.literal: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, armies rise;

translations.literal: if it stations there, fawning ministers stir rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, fawning ministers stir rebellion.

translations.literal: when Saturn encroaches upon it, great ministers are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches upon it, great ministers are troubled;

sentences.zh: 守之，主聖臣賢，歲豐，後有喜；

translations.literal: if it stations there, the sovereign is sagely and ministers worthy, the harvest is abundant, and the chief consort has cause for joy;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the sovereign is sagely and ministers worthy, the harvest is abundant, and the chief consort has cause for joy;

translations.literal: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, armies rise;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde, the chief consort loses her hold on governance.
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde, the chief consort loses her hold on governance.

sentences.zh: 太白入或犯之，皆爲兵起；

translations.literal: whether Venus enters or encroaches upon it, armies invariably rise;
translations.idiomatic: Whether Venus enters or encroaches upon it, armies invariably rise;

sentences.zh: 出、入、留、舍，大風水災，其分君不安；

translations.literal: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, great wind and flood disaster follow and rulers in its jurisdiction are unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: whether it exits, enters, lingers, or lodges, great wind and flood disaster follow and rulers in its jurisdiction are unsettled;

translations.literal: if it lodges to the left, drought follows;
translations.idiomatic: if it lodges to the left, drought follows;

sentences.zh: 守犯、勾巳、淩突，則大臣專君令。

translations.literal: if it stations, encroaches, forms the gou-si hook, or dashes against it, great ministers monopolize the ruler's commands.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations, encroaches, forms the gou-si hook, or dashes against it, great ministers monopolize the ruler's commands.

sentences.zh: 辰星淩抵，下臣爲亂伏誅；

translations.literal: when Mercury brushes against it, subordinate ministers stir rebellion and are executed in secret;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury brushes against it, subordinate ministers stir rebellion and are executed in secret;

translations.literal: if it stations there, drought, famine, and a scattering of the people follow, and dragons and serpents appear;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, drought, famine, and a scattering of the people follow, and dragons and serpents appear;

translations.literal: if it stations at the center, armies rise on a grand scale;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations at the center, armies rise on a grand scale;

translations.literal: if they appear together in the west, great ministers are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If they appear together in the west, great ministers are troubled.

sentences.zh: 客星入犯之，國有兵，大臣憂，一曰負海國有使來；

translations.literal: when a guest star enters and encroaches upon it, the state has armies and great ministers are troubled—or, by one reading, a mission comes from a land beyond the sea;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star enters and encroaches upon it, the state has armies and great ministers are troubled—or, by one reading, a mission comes from a land beyond the sea;

translations.literal: if it stations there, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, armies rise.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，大臣憂，國有兵、喪。

translations.literal: when a comet encroaches upon it, great ministers are troubled and the state suffers armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, great ministers are troubled and the state suffers armies and mourning.

sentences.zh: 星孛於翼，亦爲大臣憂，其分失禮樂；

translations.literal: a broom star at the Wings likewise troubles great ministers, and its jurisdiction loses rites and music;
translations.idiomatic: A broom star at the Wings likewise troubles great ministers, and its jurisdiction loses rites and music;

sentences.zh: 出，則其地有謀，下有兵、喪；

translations.literal: if it exits, that region harbors plots and below come armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if it exits, that region harbors plots and below come armies and mourning;

translations.literal: whichever direction its tail points, people surrender.
translations.idiomatic: whichever direction its tail points, people surrender.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，亦爲憂在大臣；

translations.literal: when a meteor encroaches upon it, the trouble likewise falls upon great ministers;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor encroaches upon it, the trouble likewise falls upon great ministers;

translations.literal: if it exits, armies rise below;
translations.idiomatic: if it exits, armies rise below;

sentences.zh: 入，爲貴臣囚系，《乙巳占》曰：「流星入，天下賢士入見，南夷來貢，國有賢臣。」

translations.literal: if it enters, eminent ministers are imprisoned. The Yisi Occupations said: "When a meteor enters, worthy men throughout the realm come to audience, southern barbarians bring tribute, and the state has worthy ministers."
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, eminent ministers are imprisoned. The Yisi Occupations said: "When a meteor enters, worthy men throughout the realm come to audience, southern barbarians bring tribute, and the state has worthy ministers."

translations.literal: When crimson cloud vapor enters and exits, sudden armies appear;
translations.idiomatic: When crimson cloud vapor enters and exits, sudden armies appear;

translations.literal: if yellow and lustrous, feudal lords come with tribute;
translations.idiomatic: If it is yellow and lustrous, feudal lords come bearing tribute;

translations.literal: if black, the state has worry.
translations.idiomatic: If black, the state faces calamity.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，翼宿十九度，唐開元遊儀十八度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Wings Lodge was nineteen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary, eighteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Wings Lodge measured nineteen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan itinerant armillary gave eighteen.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was ninety-seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier measurement placed it ninety-seven degrees from the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，翼宿一十八度，距中行西第二星去極百四度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and test: the Wings Lodge eighteen degrees; from the second star west along the central sequence, distance from the pole one hundred four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey found the Wings Lodge at eighteen degrees and placed the second star west along the central sequence one hundred four degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 東甌五星，在翼南，蠻夷星也。

translations.literal: Eastern Ou comprises five stars south of the Wings—a barbarian star.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Ou comprises five stars south of the Wings—it is a star of the southern and northern barbarians.

sentences.zh: 《天文錄》曰：「東甌，東越也，今永嘉郡永寧縣是也。」

translations.literal: The Records of Astronomy said: "Eastern Ou is Eastern Yue; today that is Yongning county in Yongjia commandery."
translations.idiomatic: The 《Records of Astronomy》 says, "Eastern Ou is Eastern Yue; today that is Yongning county in Yongjia commandery."

translations.literal: If its rays are sharp and it trembles, the barbarians rebel.
translations.idiomatic: When its rays sharpen and it trembles, the barbarians rebel.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守之，其地有兵。

translations.literal: If Venus or Mars stations there, that region has armies.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus or Mars stations there, that region sees armies.

sentences.zh: 按東甌五星，《晉志》在二十八宿之外，《乾象新書》屬張宿；

translations.literal: Examining Eastern Ou's five stars: the Jin Treatise places them outside the Twenty-eight Lodges; the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns them to the Spread Lodge;
translations.idiomatic: Examining Eastern Ou's five stars, the Jin Treatise places them outside the Twenty-eight Lodges, while the 《New Book of Heavenly Images》 assigns them to the Spread Lodge;

sentences.zh: 武密書屬翼宿，與《步天歌》合。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's book assigns them to the Wings Lodge, agreeing with the Song of Pacing the Heavens.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's book assigns them to the Wings Lodge, in agreement with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 軫宿四星，主塚宰、輔臣，主車騎，主載任。

translations.literal: The Crossbar Lodge comprises four stars; it presides over the Director of Victuals and assisting ministers, over chariots and cavalry, and over bearing burdens.
translations.idiomatic: The Crossbar Lodge comprises four stars. It presides over the Director of Victuals and assisting ministers, chariots and cavalry, and the bearing of heavy loads.

translations.literal: When armies go out or come in, all prognostications are read from the Crossbar.
translations.idiomatic: When armies go out or come in, all prognostications are read from the Crossbar.

translations.literal: It also presides over wind and prognosticates death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: It also presides over wind and prognosticates death and mourning.

translations.literal: if bright and large, the imperial carriage is fully equipped;
translations.idiomatic: When bright and large, the imperial equipage stands fully ready;

translations.literal: if it shifts position, the Son of Heaven has worry;
translations.idiomatic: when it shifts position, the Son of Heaven faces trouble;

translations.literal: if they draw together, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: when they cluster close together, armies rise.

sentences.zh: 轄二星，傅軫兩旁，主王侯，左轄爲王者同姓，右轄爲異姓。

translations.literal: The Brackets are two stars attached on either side of the Crossbar; they govern kings and marquises—the left Bracket for the king's agnates, the right Bracket for those of other surnames.
translations.idiomatic: The Brackets are two stars flanking the Crossbar on either side. They govern kings and marquises: the left Bracket for the king's agnates, the right Bracket for those of other surnames.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, armies rise on a grand scale;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars blaze bright, armies rise on a grand scale;

translations.literal: if far from the Crossbar, ill-omen;
translations.idiomatic: when far from the Crossbar, misfortune follows;

translations.literal: if the Brackets lift, southern barbarians invade;
translations.idiomatic: when the Brackets lift, southern barbarians invade;

translations.literal: if a chariot lacks its brackets, the state has worry.
translations.idiomatic: when a chariot lacks its brackets, the state faces calamity.

sentences.zh: 日食，憂在將相，戒車駕之官，一曰後不安。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: worry falls upon generals and ministers; officials of the imperial carriage are warned—one reading says the empress is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse means worry for generals and ministers and a warning to officials of the imperial equipage—or, by one reading, the empress is unsettled.

sentences.zh: 暈而生背氣，其下兵起，城拔，視背所向擊之勝，又曰王者惡之。

translations.literal: A halo with opposing vapor born below it: armies rise, cities are stormed; strike toward where the opposing vapor points and victory follows—another reading says the king is ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: When a halo forms and opposing vapor appears, armies rise below and cities are stormed; strike toward where the opposing vapor points and victory follows—or, by another reading, the king is ill-omened.

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: the empress and great ministers face worry.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse brings worry upon the empress and great ministers.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: armies rise, the year brings drought, and great winds are many.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo presages armies, drought in the year, and many great winds.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，爲火災，爲民疫，大臣憂，主庫者有罪；

translations.literal: When Jupiter encroaches upon it: fire disaster, epidemic among the people, great ministers troubled, the director of treasuries is guilty;
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter encroaches upon it, there is fire disaster and epidemic among the people; great ministers are troubled and the director of the treasuries is held guilty;

translations.literal: if it enters, that state's general perishes;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, that state's general perishes;

translations.literal: if it stations there, the state has mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, the state has mourning;

sentences.zh: 七日不移，有赦，又曰君有憂。

translations.literal: if it does not shift for seven days, there is an amnesty—another reading says the ruler has worry.
translations.idiomatic: if it lingers seven days without shifting, an amnesty is proclaimed—or, by another reading, the ruler faces trouble.

translations.literal: When Mars encroaches upon it, rebellious armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars encroaches upon it, rebellious armies rise;

sentences.zh: 入軫，將軍爲亂，水傷稼，民多妖言；

translations.literal: if it enters the Crossbar, generals rebel; water harms the crops and the people utter much ominous talk;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters the Crossbar, generals rebel, water harms the crops, and ominous talk spreads among the people;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde, fire and armies follow.
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde, there is fire and warfare.

translations.literal: When Saturn encroaches upon it, armies rise and earthworks are undertaken;
translations.idiomatic: When Saturn encroaches upon it, armies rise and earthworks are undertaken;

translations.literal: if it enters, armies are defeated;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, armies are defeated;

translations.literal: if it moves retrograde, the chief consort is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde, the chief consort is troubled;

sentences.zh: 出、入、舍、留，六十日兵起，大旱。

translations.literal: whether it exits, enters, lodges, or lingers—for sixty days armies rise and great drought follows.
translations.idiomatic: whether it exits, enters, lodges, or lingers, within sixty days armies rise and a great drought follows.

translations.literal: When Venus encroaches upon it, armies rise and territory is gained;
translations.idiomatic: When Venus encroaches upon it, armies rise and territory is gained;

translations.literal: if it enters, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, armies rise;

translations.literal: if it stations there, territory is lost and generals are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, territory is lost and generals face worry;

translations.literal: if it rises at the left horn and moves retrograde to the Crossbar, territory is lost;
translations.idiomatic: if it rises at the left horn and moves retrograde to the Crossbar, territory is lost;

translations.literal: if it crosses heaven, armies fill the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: if it crosses heaven, armies fill the countryside.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，民疫，大臣憂，中國有貴喪；

translations.literal: When Mercury encroaches upon it, the people suffer epidemic, great ministers are troubled, and there is noble mourning in the central states;
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury encroaches upon it, epidemic afflicts the people, great ministers are troubled, and eminent persons mourn within the central states;

translations.literal: if it stations there, great flood follows;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, great flood follows;

sentences.zh: 入，則天下以火爲憂，一曰國有喪。

translations.literal: if it enters, the realm takes fire as its worry—one reading says the state has mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, the realm is troubled by fire—or, by one reading, the state falls into mourning.

translations.literal: When a guest star encroaches upon it, armies rise and mourning follows;
translations.idiomatic: When a guest star encroaches upon it, armies rise and mourning follows;

sentences.zh: 入，則有土功，糴貴，諸侯使來；

translations.literal: if it enters, earthworks are undertaken, grain is dear, and feudal envoys arrive;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, earthworks are undertaken, grain grows dear, and envoys from the feudal lords arrive;

translations.literal: if it exits, the ruler sends envoys to the feudal lords;
translations.idiomatic: if it exits, the ruler dispatches envoys to the feudal lords;

translations.literal: if it stations there, frontier armies rise and the people suffer famine;
translations.idiomatic: if it stations there, frontier armies rise and the people suffer famine;

translations.literal: if it stations at the Brackets, military officers are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: if it stations at the Brackets, military officers face worry.

translations.literal: When a comet encroaches upon it, armies rise and mourning follows;
translations.idiomatic: When a comet encroaches upon it, armies rise and mourning follows;

sentences.zh: 色赤，爲君失道，又曰天子起兵，王公廢黜。

translations.literal: if its color is red, the ruler loses the Way; another reading says the Son of Heaven raises armies and kings and dukes are deposed.
translations.idiomatic: if its color is red, the ruler has lost the Way—or, by another reading, the Son of Heaven raises armies and kings and dukes are deposed.

sentences.zh: 星孛於軫，亦爲兵、喪，又曰下謀上，主憂。

translations.literal: A broom star at the Crossbar likewise presages armies and mourning; another reading says subordinates plot against superiors and the ruler is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A broom star at the Crossbar likewise presages armies and mourning—or, by another reading, subordinates plot against their superiors and the ruler faces trouble.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，有兵起，亦有喪，不出一年，庫藏空；
