translations.literal: When a meteor encroaches upon it, armies rise and mourning also follows; within one year the treasuries stand empty;
translations.idiomatic: When a meteor encroaches upon it, armies rise and mourning follows as well; within one year the treasuries stand empty;

translations.literal: if it encroaches in spring or summer, leather goods are consumed;
translations.idiomatic: if it encroaches in spring or summer, leather goods are consumed;

translations.literal: if in autumn or winter, flood and drought fall out of balance.
translations.idiomatic: if in autumn or winter, flood and drought fall out of balance.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以軫宿爲十八度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Crossbar Lodge was taken as eighteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Han dynasty's Yongyuan bronze armillary sphere, the Crossbar Lodge was reckoned at eighteen degrees.

translations.literal: Formerly its distance from the pole was ninety-eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier measurement placed it ninety-eight degrees from the celestial pole.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，亦十八度，去極一百度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and test also gives eighteen degrees, one hundred degrees from the pole.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou-era survey likewise found eighteen degrees and one hundred degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 長沙一星，在軫宿中，入軫二度，去極百五度，主壽命。

translations.literal: Changsha is one star within the Crossbar Lodge, two degrees into the Crossbar, one hundred five degrees from the pole—it presides over lifespan.
translations.idiomatic: Changsha is a single star within the Crossbar Lodge, two degrees within the Crossbar and one hundred five degrees from the pole; it presides over lifespan.

translations.literal: if bright, the ruler enjoys a long life and descendants flourish.
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the ruler enjoys long life and his descendants flourish.

sentences.zh: 青丘七星，在軫東南，蠻夷之國號。

translations.literal: Green Mound comprises seven stars southeast of the Crossbar—the designation of barbarian states.
translations.idiomatic: Green Mound comprises seven stars southeast of the Crossbar—they mark the names of barbarian states.

translations.literal: if the stars are bright, barbarian armies are strong;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars blaze bright, barbarian armies grow strong;

translations.literal: if they tremble, barbarian armies rise in rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: when they tremble, barbarian armies rebel;

translations.literal: if they maintain their stations steadily, it is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: when they hold steady in their places, the omen is auspicious.

sentences.zh: 軍門二星，在青丘西，一曰在土司空北，天子六宮之門。

translations.literal: Army Gate comprises two stars west of Green Mound—or, by one reading, north of the Earth Director—the gate of the Son of Heaven's six palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Army Gate comprises two stars west of Green Mound—or, by one reading, north of the Earth Director—the gate of the Son of Heaven's six palaces.

sentences.zh: 主營候，設豹尾旗，與南門同占。

translations.literal: It presides over encampment watch and the setting of the leopard-tail banner; its prognostications are the same as the South Gate's.
translations.idiomatic: It presides over encampment watches and the raising of the leopard-tail banner, sharing the same prognostications as the South Gate.

sentences.zh: 星非其故，及客星犯之，皆爲道不通。

translations.literal: If the stars depart from their proper state, or a guest star encroaches upon them, in every case roads are impassable.
translations.idiomatic: If the stars depart from their proper state, or a guest star encroaches upon them, roads everywhere become impassable.

sentences.zh: 器府三十二星，在軫宿南，樂器之府也。

translations.literal: Instrument Repository comprises thirty-two stars south of the Crossbar Lodge—it is the repository of musical instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Instrument Repository comprises thirty-two stars south of the Crossbar Lodge—the treasury of musical instruments.

translations.literal: if bright, the eight tones are harmonious and ruler and ministers are at peace;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, the eight tones harmonize and ruler and ministers live at peace;

translations.literal: if not bright, the opposite holds.
translations.idiomatic: when not bright, the opposite holds.

translations.literal: If guest stars or comets encroach upon it, music officers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: When guest stars or comets encroach upon it, music officers are executed.

sentences.zh: 赤雲氣掩之，天下音樂廢。

translations.literal: If crimson cloud vapor veils it, music throughout the realm is abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When crimson cloud vapor veils it, music throughout the realm is abolished.

sentences.zh: 土司空四星，在青丘西，主界域，亦曰司徒。

translations.literal: The Earth Director comprises four stars west of Green Mound; it presides over territorial boundaries and is also called Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: The Earth Director comprises four stars west of Green Mound. It presides over territorial boundaries and is also known as the Minister of Education.

translations.literal: if evenly bright, the realm is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: When evenly bright, the realm is abundant;

translations.literal: if faint and dim, the crops do not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: when faint and dim, the crops fail to ripen.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑犯之，男女廢耕桑。

translations.literal: If Venus or Mars encroach upon it, men and women abandon farming and sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: When Venus or Mars encroach upon it, men and women abandon plowing and sericulture.

translations.literal: If guest stars or comets encroach upon it, armies rise and the people disperse.
translations.idiomatic: When guest stars or comets encroach upon it, armies rise and the people scatter.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，以左轄右轄二星、長沙一星、軍門二星、土司空四星、青丘七星、器府三十二星俱屬軫宿；

translations.literal: According to the Song of Pacing the Heavens, the two stars of the left and right Brackets, the one star of Changsha, the two stars of Army Gate, the four stars of Earth Director, the seven stars of Green Mound, and the thirty-two stars of Instrument Repository are all assigned to the Crossbar Lodge;
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, the left and right Brackets (two stars), Changsha (one star), Army Gate (two stars), Earth Director (four stars), Green Mound (seven stars), and Instrument Repository (thirty-two stars) are all assigned to the Crossbar Lodge;

sentences.zh: 《晉志》惟轄星、長沙附于軫，餘在二十八宿之外；

translations.literal: the Jin Treatise assigns only the Bracket stars and Changsha to the Crossbar, the rest lying outside the Twenty-eight Lodges;
translations.idiomatic: the Jin Treatise assigns only the Bracket stars and Changsha to the Crossbar, placing the rest outside the Twenty-eight Lodges;

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以軍門、器府、土司空屬翼，青丘屬軫；

translations.literal: the New Book of Heavenly Images assigns Army Gate, Instrument Repository, and Earth Director to the Wings, and Green Mound to the Crossbar;
translations.idiomatic: the 《New Book of Heavenly Images》 assigns Army Gate, Instrument Repository, and Earth Director to the Wings, and Green Mound to the Crossbar;

sentences.zh: 武密書以軍門屬翼，餘皆屬軫。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's book assigns Army Gate to the Wings and all the rest to the Crossbar.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's book assigns Army Gate to the Wings and all the rest to the Crossbar.

sentences.zh: 今從《步天歌》，而附見諸家之說。

translations.literal: The present text follows the Song of Pacing the Heavens, while appending the various schools' traditions.
translations.idiomatic: The present text follows the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, while appending the traditions of the various schools.
